Title: Analista de datos
Description:
Take your career to the next level with Amaris Consulting as a Data Analyst. Be part of an international team, thrive in a global group with a €800M turnover and over 1,000 clients worldwide, and an agile environment. You will join the Data team of one of our clients, working closely with business stakeholders to transform data into actionable insights. Spanish fluency is required as part of this role.




✍️ WHAT WOULD YOU NEED? ✍️

2-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar role.
Strong proficiency with SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Solid knowledge of relational databases, data modelling, and version control tools such as Git.
Familiarity with Python for data analysis and automation.
Proven experience working with reporting solutions, dashboards, and business intelligence tools.
Advanced proficiency in Spanish (written and spoken).
Intermediate level of English.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work both independently and as part of a team.




👉 WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions to support business decision-making.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Design, optimize, and maintain database structures to ensure data integrity and performance.
Analyse large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
Participate in data quality, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Implement reporting and monitoring solutions that provide meaningful business insights.
Stay current with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in Data Analytics and Business Intelligence.




🚀 WHY US? 🚀

Join our dynamic team of talented people and discover a world full of growth and opportunity. Here's what we offer:

Rapid growth through a personalised career path and salary assessment. 70% of our senior leaders started in entry-level positions.
Improve your skills through our Technology Academy catalogue, Udemy platform, language classes, webinars and workshops.
Take control of your training with a personal annual budget and company-paid certifications.
Enjoy flexible policies, remote work options and excellent social benefits such as transport and restaurant tickets, childcare support and private health insurance.
Benefit from our WeCare programme, which supports employees in critical situations.
Unlock your full potential, both professionally and personally.




Amaris Consulting prides itself on being an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive work environment. To this end, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, creed, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

Title: Data Analyst - Las Rozas
Place: Las Rozas de Madrid, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Desde E-Frontiers estamos buscando un perfil de Data Analyst para formar parte de uno de nuestros clientes: una empresa de datos y analítica que ayuda a tomar decisiones en el sector inmobiliario. Ofrecen soluciones como análisis de datos, modelos predictivos y servicios de datos escalables para optimizar inversiones, riesgos y rendimiento.

​​​​​​Formarás del equipo AVM Regulado y participarás en el ​​​​​desarrollo, mantenimiento y entrega de modelos automáticos de valoración, proporcionando valoraciones masivas de activos inmobiliarios.


Tareas:

Diseño, calibración y actualización de modelos estadísticos para la valoración automática masiva de activos inmobiliarios.
Control de la calidad del dato: Exploración, limpieza y validación de bases de datos inmobiliarias.
Monitorización y estudio del error de los modelos.
Elaboración de análisis de mercado y resultados de valoración de carteras.
Automatización de procesos con Python/SQL.
Reporting e interpretación de resultados.


Requisitos:

Grado en Economía, ADE, Ingeniería o Matemáticas.
Experiencia profesional mínima de 3 años como Data Analyst.
Conocimiento del mercado de carteras NPL.
Nivel básico de Python, y nivel avanzado de Excel y PPT.
Inglés C1.


Se ofrece:

Contrato indefinido.
Oportunidad de desarrollo profesional.
Híbrido en Las Rozas (3 días oficina, 2 días de teletrabajo).
​​​​​​​Horario flexible.
Servicio de menú diario incluido.



Sobre E-Frontiers: Somos una agencia de reclutamiento especializada en perfiles IT, de origen Irlandés y con presencia en España desde hace 10 años. La contratación será directamente con el cliente y te estaremos dando acompañamiento durante todo el proceso de selección. Trabajamos con diferentes clientes desde Start-Ups hasta multinacionales.

Title: Data Analyst Engineer
Place: San Fernando de Henares, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Data Analyst

📍 San Ferfnando de Henares | Modelo híbrido

Buscamos un/a Data Analyst con experiencia en análisis de datos y visualización de información mediante Power BI, capaz de transformar grandes volúmenes de datos en información útil para apoyar la toma de decisiones de negocio.

💡 ¿Qué harás?

• Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener cuadros de mando e informes en Power BI.

• Recopilar, depurar, validar y consolidar datos procedentes de diferentes fuentes.

• Analizar tendencias, patrones e indicadores para identificar oportunidades de mejora.

• Definir, calcular y dar seguimiento a KPIs de negocio y operativos.

• Automatizar procesos de reporting y generación de informes.

• Elaborar análisis e informes para apoyar la toma de decisiones.

• Presentar conclusiones y recomendaciones a responsables de área.

• Garantizar la calidad, integridad y consistencia de los datos.

• Colaborar con diferentes departamentos para comprender necesidades de información y análisis.

🎯 ¿Qué buscamos en ti?

No te preocupes si no cumples el 100% de lo que buscamos. ¡Anímate, queremos conocer tu experiencia y lo que puedes aportar! 🚀

✅ +3 años de experiencia en análisis y explotación de datos.

✅ Experiencia avanzada en Power BI para la creación de dashboards e informes interactivos.

✅ Conocimientos avanzados de Microsoft Excel.

✅ Capacidad para analizar e interpretar grandes volúmenes de datos.

✅ Experiencia en definición y seguimiento de KPIs.

✅ Experiencia en depuración, validación y transformación de datos.

✅ Conocimientos en automatización de reporting y generación de informes.

✅ Pensamiento analítico y orientación a la resolución de problemas.

✅ Capacidad de síntesis y comunicación de resultados a públicos no técnicos.

✅ Atención al detalle y orientación a la calidad del dato.




Lo que te ofrecemos

Estabilidad y Futuro 🏢✨: Proyectos a largo plazo en una empresa líder de Defensa con más de 50.000 profesionales, con seguridad financiera.
Proyectos Innovadores y de Alto Alcance 🚀: Trabajarás con tecnologías de vanguardia, con un impacto tanto a nivel nacional como internacional.
Ambiente Cercano y Transparente 🤝: Disfrutarás de una comunicación directa y fluida con responsables y compañeros, en un entorno colaborativo y abierto.
Autonomía y Flexibilidad ⏳: Tendrás libertad para organizar tu trabajo, con una conciliación real y adaptada a tu ritmo.
Plan de carrera adaptado a ti 📈: Diseñado para impulsar tu crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.
Formación continua 📚: en Open University y Udemy for Business (¡más de 6.000 cursos para especializarte!).
Descuentos exclusivos para tu bienestar 🎁: Disfruta de ventajas en gimnasios, restaurantes, tiendas, ocio y mucho más al ser empleado de Indra.
Retribución competitiva 💰 y planes de compensación flexibles 💸📊a tus necesidades.




🕓¿Cómo es nuestro proceso de selección?

Revisión de tu perfil 🔍: Evaluamos tu experiencia y habilidades para determinar si encajas con lo que buscamos.
Primera toma de contacto (5-10 min) 📞: Si recibes una llamada de un número desconocido, ¡es nuestro equipo! Será una conversación rápida para conocerte y resolver cualquier duda.

Oferta y bienvenida 🎉: Si todo va bien, ¡te incorporas a nuestro equipo y comenzamos esta nueva etapa juntos!

Title: Sr Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Location: Madrid, Spain

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

At PMI, we're transforming our business and building our future around one clear purpose: delivering a smoke-free future.

As part of our Data, Insights & Analytics (DI&A) team, you'll help turn data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge business strategy and analytics by translating complex business challenges into data-driven insights and solutions.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, uncover trends, develop dashboards and analytical products, and enable better, faster, and more informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze commercial, consumer, and digital data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and define analytical requirements.
Design, build, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
Drive visibility of key performance indicators across multiple functions.
Support continuous improvement through experimentation, performance measurement, and insight generation.
Promote data quality, analytics adoption, and evidence-based decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


3+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related fields.
Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development and data modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar cloud-based analytics environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Experience translating business questions into analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Advanced English communication skills.


Nice to Have


Experience with advanced or predictive analytics using Python, R, or similar programming languages.


Why PMI?

At PMI, you'll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues from around the world, and contribute to the transformation of a global organization.

We offer the opportunity to learn, innovate, grow your career, and make an impact from day one.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We believe diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Relocation support and visa sponsorship are not provided. Candidates must have the legal right to work in Spain to be considered for this role.

Title: Data Analyst Support Engineer
Description:
Job Description:

An opportunity for a Data Analyst has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).

The selected candidate will join our Data & Analytics Team, acting as a key interface between business functions, our data ecosystem, and requested solutions. The team is multidisciplinary and focused on driving a data-driven mindset across the organization. The jobholder will reinforce our capabilities in transforming large datasets into strategic assets, collaborating closely with various departments to understand their needs, deliver actionable insights, and ensure top-tier data governance in our complex defense and space programs.

Responsibilities

The main tasks of the jobholder will be:


Perform end-to-end data processing, from gathering relevant data from various internal and external sources to cleaning and processing raw data to ensure the highest data quality.
Apply advanced statistical and analytical techniques to extract meaningful insights, draw accurate conclusions from data, and prevent biases in decision-making.
Design and deliver high-impact data visualizations, charts, and dashboards to communicate findings effectively through clear storytelling, while advising users on best practices.
Prepare and present comprehensive reports to share key insights with stakeholders and support informed, data-driven business decisions.
Manage and maintain analytical tools and software ecosystem for data analysis, ensuring data security, privacy, and full compliance with internal requirements and external regulations.
Foster a data-driven mindset by coaching business functions, collaborating with other teams, and actively sharing best practices and techniques with the wider Airbus data community.


Skills

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you:


Education: Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Experience: Proven experience in data analysis, data preparation, and working with complex datasets.
Technical knowledge:
Strong command of statistics and probability concepts (e.g., hypothesis testing, Monte Carlo simulations, expected values, standard errors, Central Limit Theorem, confidence intervals).
Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Python/R, SQL, Tableau, PowerBI, QlikSense, or similar software).
Soft skills: Excellent communication and storytelling skills, high adaptability to work in a networking mode, coaching mindset, and ability to act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams.
Languages: Advanced level in English.
Valuable / Nice to have: Experience within the aerospace, defense, or industrial manufacturing sectors; knowledge of big data technologies or advanced machine learning models.

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:


Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year.
Attractive salary.
Hybrid model of working when possible.
Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location.
Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.
On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office.
Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives.
Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environ ment.
Option to access special rates in products & benefits.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Fraud
Description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What you will get to do


Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate


To succeed in this role, you should have


Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (4+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
Strong problem solving skills
Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets
Experience in fraud, risk, or financial services; you understand how fraud attacks work and how to think about mitigation trade-offs
A proactive mindset — you don't wait to be asked; you spot something unusual and you dig in
Some exposure to Python or scripting for data manipulation and analysis
Proficiency with a BI tool (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, Superset, Redash, or any other alternative)
Strong stakeholder management skills; you can communicate findings clearly to fraud operations, product managers, engineers, and senior leadership — and you know how to influence decisions with data across all of them.
Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams where priorities shift quickly.
Proficiency with a spreadsheet tool (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, or any other alternative)
Enjoy autonomy and a flat structure: we have millions of customers and a flat hierarchy so any individual can have an outsized impact
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or any other related field


Experience with the following would be a plus


Data governance
Python or any other scripting language
Git or any other version control tool


What we can offer you


Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.


What to expect in the hiring process


A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
Technical take-home task (SQL test).
Technical Interview with hiring manager.
A behavioural interview with the Head of Data Analytics/Science and Fraud Team.


Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Treasury
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

Senior Data Analyst - Treasury

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Reporting team and we are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Treasury domain!

Our data mission is to develop and maintain Ebury’s Data Platform and serve it to the whole company. This platform is the backbone of Ebury: it supports internal decision making, allows us to monitor our Treasury positions and risks, comply with regulatory reporting obligations and enables commercial opportunities globally.

The Data team works closely with Treasury, Product and Tech teams to coordinate and implement data analysis initiatives helping the Cash management, ALM and Treasury Reporting teams. Some of the projects we are currently working on include: MtM valuations reconciliation with our Treasury reporting system to ensure completeness and accuracy in our Financial statements, cash operational charges data analysis to reduce Treasury costs, liquidity data analysis to help ALM team manage daily liquidity obligations, and building AI agentic workflows to automate routine data operations and decision support, and many many more!

As part of the team you will


Work closely with the rest of the Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineering, Treasury and Product teams
Be responsible for modelling data in our collaborative data platform to perform critical Treasury data analysis and build reports and reconciliations for the Treasury domain
Design, build, and maintain robust AI agentic workflows and analytical tools to automate and enhance Treasury data processes and decision-making
Manage end-to-end treasury solutions across all jurisdictions of the company from requirements gathering, building optimised data models and delivering the reports to our treasury stakeholders and auditors
Maintain and build dashboards and visualisations on the data platform using our BI tools for Treasury teams to monitor reporting and controls


What we’re looking for


6+ years of experience in Data/Business Analytics - applied to Treasury or Finance is a plus!
Advanced SQL skills - must be able to read and write complex SQL queries
Experience working with AI and building agentic workflows
Experience with our modern data stack tools (a plus!) We use dbt, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, DataStudio), Sigma
Strong problem solving and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail
The ability to manage, organise and present data in a clear, concise and actionable format
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and demanding work environment
Track record of working autonomously with time management skills
Fluency in English
Financial Services and Capital Markets Experience (FX, Payments, Money Markets, Treasury Management, etc) is a good plus!


What Ebury offers you


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses


About Us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Sales (All Genders)
Description:
Company Description

With over 25 years’ experience, plus the same enormous passion and ambition we had on day-one, we’re trailblazers in the pet e-commerce industry. Our solutions make over 12 million customers genuinely happier – and that’s something we really care about. We work together to continually adapt; embracing change and the challenges it brings so that we can keep doing better. Join us and discover a place where your potential meets your passion for pets. That’s the power of plus.

Job Description

As a Senior Sales Analyst at zooplus, you will join our Shopping & Markets Analytics team within the Data & Analytics division acting as a strategic analytics partner for our Regional Sales and Commercial teams across Europe.

You will own a portfolio of analytical products, reporting solutions and business insights that support commercial decision-making across multiple markets and functions. Working closely with Sales, Growth / Category managers, Pricing and Leadership stakeholders, you will identify growth opportunities, challenge assumptions, drive KPI governance and provide actionable recommendations that drive business performance and support the future growth of zooplus.

Shopping & Markets Analytics mission

The Shopping & Markets Analytics team empowers product and business teams to make better decisions by transforming transactional and behavioral data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.

We partner closely with stakeholders across the full commercial lifecycle, from performance analysis and opportunity identification to impact assessment and business steering. By combining business understanding with advanced analytics, we help teams unlock growth opportunities, accelerate decision-making and foster a strong data-driven culture across zooplus.

Key Responsibilities


Act as a strategic analytics partner for Regional Sales stakeholders across Europe, supporting data-driven decision-making and business growth.
Identify commercial opportunities and performance drivers through in-depth analysis of sales, pricing, promotions, customer behavior and market trends.
Own and continuously improve dashboards, reporting solutions and KPI frameworks that support business steering and performance monitoring.
Design and maintain scalable analytical datasets and data marts, ensuring reliable and efficient access to business insights.
Lead complex analytical projects in collaboration with cross-functional teams including Sales, Pricing, CRM, Category Management and Data Science.
Leverage AI, automation and modern analytics tools to improve analytical efficiency and enable self-service analytics.
Communicate insights and recommendations effectively to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
Promote a data-driven culture by helping stakeholders understand, access and act on data.


Qualifications

Skills and experience:


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business Administration, Computer Science or a related analytical field.
5+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence or Commercial analytics roles, preferably within e-commerce, retail or digital businesses.
Advanced SQL expertise, including large-scale data analysis, query optimization and development of analytical datasets.
Strong experience with Tableau, Power BI or similar BI and data visualization tools.
Strong commercial acumen and understanding of sales, pricing, promotions, customer behavior and e-commerce performance metrics.
Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations and influence stakeholder decisions.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging senior business stakeholders.
Experience working with cloud-based analytics environments and modern data platforms.
Proactive, business-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Strong prioritization skills and the ability to adapt quickly to evolving business needs and stakeholder priorities.


Nice to Have


Experience working with digital behavioral or event-based data and translating customer interactions into actionable business insights.
Experience with Python or R for analytics, automation or modelling.
Experience building self-service analytics solutions and scalable reporting frameworks.
Experience with forecasting, experimentation or other advanced analytical methodologies.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled analytics tools to improve analytical efficiency and business decision-making.
Experience leading cross-functional analytics initiatives or mentoring other analysts.


Additional Information

Headquartered in Munich, with offices across Madrid, Krakow, Wroclaw, London and Vienna, we collaborate because we genuinely love working together - so you’ll be at the heart of an incredible, multinational team. We trust each other to get the job done, which means you’ll benefit from hybrid working, spending 60% of your time in the office and 40% at home. There’s an option to work for 20 days abroad in approved countries too.

Add to that development opportunities that help you to shape your own career path, excellent training and support, wellbeing offers, subsidised transport or bike leasing, plus 20% discount across all our products, and you’ll begin to get a sense of what sets us apart. Find out more about the specific benefits at your local office in our blog posts.

A note on compensation: We believe in being transparent about salary ranges. The range shown reflects the full scope that the role can grow into over time, depending on experience, skills, and impact. Most offers are positioned around the midpoint of the range, ensuring a fair and consistent approach across our teams.

At zooplus, we believe in equal opportunity and support everyone to fulfil their potential. We recognise the power of listening and learning from each other and embrace diversity and inclusion of all.

Title: Senior Data Analyst: Multiple Teams
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Analyst: Multiple Teams based in Spain.

You will work at the intersection of data, product, and machine learning, helping teams turn complex datasets into actionable business and product insights.

Your analysis will support a range of teams working across data science, ranking, recommendations, personalization, AI-powered shopping, search optimization, and retail media.

You will investigate user behavior, identify opportunities, and evaluate how product changes affect both customer experience and business performance.

A key part of the role will be designing experiments, defining meaningful metrics, and using statistical analysis to guide product decisions.

You will work with large-scale datasets using SQL and Python while building dashboards and analytical tools that make data accessible to decision-makers.

The role offers broad exposure to engineers, data scientists, product managers, customers, and business stakeholders.

You will join a collaborative, fast-moving environment where analytical thinking, ownership, clear communication, and measurable impact are highly valued.

Accountabilities


Analyze user behavior and large-scale datasets to uncover patterns, identify issues, and surface opportunities for product and business improvement.
Design, run, and analyze A/B tests to evaluate product changes and quantify their impact on key business metrics.
Define, validate, and monitor metrics that capture both user experience and business outcomes.
Build dashboards, reports, analytical tools, and other data resources that support informed decision-making across multiple teams.
Partner with engineers, data scientists, product managers, customers, and business stakeholders to translate analytical findings into actionable product improvements.
Investigate product funnels, performance trends, and user behavior to identify opportunities for optimization.
Apply SQL, Python, and distributed data systems to process, explore, and analyze large volumes of data.
Contribute analytical expertise across different domains, which may include data science integrations, ranking, recommendations, AI shopping agents, search optimization, personalization, and retail media.
Help teams understand machine learning-related data, including training data quality, model evaluation, and relevant performance metrics.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly, adapting the level of technical detail to different audiences and stakeholders.
Take ownership of analytical projects from problem definition and investigation through to recommendations and measurable outcomes.


Requirements


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated experience using data to address business and product questions.
Solid knowledge of SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets.
Professional experience using Python for data analysis, including tools such as pandas, NumPy, and data visualization libraries.
Good understanding of A/B testing, experimentation methodologies, and core statistical concepts.
Experience defining and analyzing product metrics, metric trees, funnels, and other frameworks for measuring product performance.
Understanding of machine learning pipelines, training data quality, and model evaluation.
Familiarity with search relevance, ranking, or recommendation systems is a plus.
Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable collaborating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Ability to work autonomously, take ownership of projects, and proactively identify opportunities to improve products and processes.
Experience in a customer-facing role is a plus.
Previous experience in e-commerce or product analytics is a plus.


Benefits


Fully remote working environment, giving you flexibility over where you live and work.
Unlimited vacation time, with employees strongly encouraged to take at least 3 weeks per year.
Work-from-home stipend to help you create an effective home-office setup.
Apple laptop provided for new employees.
Annual training and professional development budget.
Maternity and paternity leave for eligible employees.
Opportunity to work with talented and empathetic colleagues while contributing to meaningful, high-impact projects.
Regular team offsite events to connect and collaborate.
Base salary of $80,000–$120,000 USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results.
Stock options offered in addition to the base salary.


How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Data Analyst - Fincrime Reporting
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Data Analyst - FCC Reporting

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Compliance team and we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Regulatory FinCrime Compliance domain!

Our data mission is to enable effective risk detection, monitoring and regulatory compliance through robust data models, scalable analytics and high quality reporting.

The team works closely with Compliance, Risk and Product to design and implement data-driven controls, detection mechanisms, and investigative tools across multiple jurisdictions.

Projects range from building curated data models to cover global key risk indicators for financial crime compliance and automating into standardised board packs, to scaling our regulatory reporting engine to incorporate datasets specific to transaction monitoring, screening and client KYC.

As part of the team you will


Design and maintain data models and datasets used for transaction monitoring, customer risk scoring, and financial crime investigations.
Own end-to-end delivery of FinCrime analytics solutions: requirements gathering, data extraction, transformation, validation, and deployment.
Develop and optimise detection logic and monitoring rules (e.g. transaction monitoring scenarios, anomaly detection, behavioural patterns).
Perform data quality checks and controls to ensure completeness, accuracy, and auditability of FinCrime datasets.
Build dashboards and analytical tools (Looker / Looker Studio or similar) for monitoring risk exposure, alerts, and investigation pipelines.
Support regulatory and internal audits, providing traceability of data, methodologies, and controls.
Contribute to the automation and continuous improvement of FinCrime processes (screening, monitoring, alert handling).


What We’re Looking For


2-5 years Experience in Data/Business Analytics – preferably within FinCrime, Compliance, Risk, or Financial Services.
Advanced SQL skills – able to read and write queries across complex datasets.
Experience with our modern data stack tools is a plus: dbt, Google Cloud BigQuery, Looker / Looker Studio, Git.
Experience building data pipelines, transformations, and analytical datasets.
Solid understanding of financial crime frameworks.
Experience working with Python is desirable.
Knowledge of payment flows, FX, or banking products is desirable.
Strong analytical thinking with focus on data quality, controls, and risk interpretation.
Experience working with transaction monitoring systems or alerting frameworks is a plus.
Ability to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into data logic.
Fluency in English (Spanish, a plus)


What Ebury Offers You


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment (hybrid model, 4 days office / 1 day remote)
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off and all the Málaga public holidays.
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses


About Us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

Title: Finance Reporting & Data Analyst
Description:
Desde LHH nos encontramos en búsqueda de un perfil Finance Reporting & Data Analyst para una compañía que pertenece al sector tecnológico, con oficinas en la zona oeste de Madrid.




Buscamos una persona con experiencia en análisis de datos, reporting financiero y automatización de informes, que se incorpore al área de BI/Finanzas para dar soporte a la toma de decisiones de negocio.




La posición estará orientada al desarrollo, mantenimiento y optimización de informes financieros y cuadros de mando, trabajando con información clave de la compañía y asegurando la calidad, consistencia e integridad de los datos.

Buscamos un perfil con al menos 3 años de experiencia en posiciones similares, con conocimientos avanzados de Power BI y Excel siendo muy valorable SQL Server / T-SQL, Power Query, macros y Microsoft Report Builder, además de aportar experiencia previa en reporting financiero, control de gestión, análisis de KPIs, automatización de procesos o entornos con alto volumen de datos.




Se ofrece una banda salarial de 37.000€ - 40.000€ b/a dependiendo de la experiencia de la persona, además de beneficios sociales.

Title: Analytics Engineer / Data Analyst
Description:
Como empresa de servicios estratégicos, Ayming trabaja con empresas e instituciones de todo el mundo para generar valor sostenible año tras año en Innovación, Estrategia y Fiscalidad. Con un equipo de más de 1.500 expertos en Innovación, RRHH y Fiscalidad en 14 países; nuestras 3 soluciones de servicios: Consultoría, Servicios Digitales y Servicios Gestionados.

Ayming España, trabaja en estrategia y financiación de la innovación de todo tipo de organizaciones, del sector publico y privado.

Job Description

What will your responsibilities be at Ayming?


Partner with business stakeholders to understand processes, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
Translate business requirements into data models, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics solutions.
Build and maintain analytical datasets using Databricks, SQL, and Python.
Develop and enhance BI reports, dashboards, and self-service analytics capabilities.
Analyze local data sources and integrate them into the broader data ecosystem.
Support the identification, design, and deployment of Data & AI use cases.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and documentation of KPIs.
Act as a bridge between business users and the central Data & AI team.
Promote data-driven decision making across the Spain organization.
Collaborate closely with the Data Engineer to industrialize analytics products.


You are


Business-oriented and interested in understanding how the company operates.
Comfortable working directly with operational teams, managers, and leadership.
Curious about how Data & AI can solve real business problems.
Proactive, autonomous, and solution-oriented.
A strong communicator able to bridge business and technical teams.
A collaborative team player with an international mindset.


Qualifications

You have


3+ years of experience in analytics, BI, analytics engineering, or related fields.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Good Python programming skills for data preparation, analysis, and automation.
Experience with Power BI or similar BI platforms (Looker, Tableau).

Title: Business Intelligence Specialist
Description:
Formar parte de Aire es unirte a una compañía tecnológica ágil e innovadora. Tenemos el propósito de impulsar a nuestros clientes B2B para que hagan crecer su negocio.

Ofrecemos soluciones avanzadas de Cloud, telecomunicaciones, UCaaS, ciberseguridad y servicios gestionados para empresas, con un modelo centrado en pymes, corporaciones, administraciones públicas y operadores de telecomunicaciones en España y Portugal.

Nos diferenciamos por desarrollar soluciones tecnológicas propias, buscando la excelencia y la cercanía con nuestros clientes. Para ello apostamos por el talento como motor de este proyecto.

¿Cómo será tu día a día?

El analista senior de datos, deberá reforzar el equipo de BI aportando un alto nivel técnico en el desarrollo y evolución del ecosistema de datos de negocio y en la generación de informes para dirección y otras áreas, garantizando el cumplimiento de los entregables. Trabajar sobre las tablas y el modelo del ecosistema de datos de negocio, colaborando con el equipo en su evolución y mantenimiento.

Garantizar la entrega de los informes y análisis en plazo, recurriendo a soluciones manuales cuando sea necesario para no comprometer el entregable.

Identificar de forma proactiva procesos manuales o repetitivos del equipo susceptibles de automatización, y proponer e implementar soluciones.
Apoyar y coordinarse con el resto del equipo (ETL/Python y Power BI) para repartir y sacar adelante la carga de trabajo mensual.


¿Qué requisitos necesitamos?


Entre 4 y 5 años de experiencia en Business Intelligence, analítica de datos o similar.
Nivel avanzado de SQL y MySQL.
Nivel medio de Python.
Nivel avanzado de Power BI (modelado de datos y DAX).
Nivel avanzado de Excel.
Inglés nivel medio (uso ocasional, no intensivo).
Capacidad de interlocución con dirección y con responsables de otras áreas.
Experiencia demostrable automatizando procesos de datos e informes (scripting, programación de tareas, herramientas de automatización).


¿Qué valoramos?


Conocimiento o experiencia aplicando IA para la automatización de procesos (por ejemplo, generación de scripts, agentes o herramientas de IA aplicadas a tareas repetitivas).
Experiencia previa liderando o coordinando equipos.
Experiencia en el sector de las telecomunicaciones (Telco).

Contrato indefinido y jornada completa.
Modalidad de trabajo híbrido
Flexibilidad de entrada
Jornada intensiva durante los meses de verano

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Link’s vision is to become the global leader for deep data in life sciences. We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Data Analyst to join our product team.

In this role, you will play a key part in developing and implementing a data governance framework, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and integrity. Your main responsibilities include establishing data quality monitoring processes, identifying root causes of inconsistencies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve data gaps.

To thrive in this role, you need expertise in SQL and Python for data manipulation and automation. You should be comfortable working with large datasets, designing dashboards with actionable recommendations, and applying statistical techniques to assess and enhance data quality.

The ideal candidate has experience in creating documentation (process documentation, data collection guidelines) and in contributing to data governance policies and best practices.

What You'll Do


Implement a data governance framework
Establish and maintain robust processes for tracking and assessing data quality
Develop automated checks to proactively detect data inconsistencies
Apply statistical techniques to enhance data quality
Create customized reports and dashboards
Extract data from databases (e.g., Redshift, MongoDB)
Identify and resolve root causes of quality issues
Collaborate in cross-functional teams of product managers, engineering, and operations
Create and maintain documentation


Requirements


5+ years of work experience in data analysis or data quality role
Strong technical skills in data analysis, with proficiency in SQL and Python
Experience in data storage and processing on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
Strong problem-solving skills and experience working with cross-functional teams
Experience writing process documentation and data collection guidelines


Nice to Have


University degree in medicine or life sciences
Understanding of healthcare, life sciences, or pharmaceutical industry data
Experience with data visualization tools to create dashboards and reports
Understanding of data engineering concepts (ETL, data pipelines)
Experience with workflow automation tools such as Apache Airflow
Experience working in an Agile or product-driven environment
Familiarity with data privacy and compliance regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA)


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


1% charitable giving program
Life insurance
Pension contribution
Fitness reimbursement


Compensation


Total compensation: 50,000 - 70,000 EUR
The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.


#RemoteSpain

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
🚨 ¡Busco a mi mano derecha en el equipo de Data de Newry! 🚨

Como Head of Data, acabo de consolidar nuestro primer gran hito: el Data Warehouse centralizado ya es una realidad. Los cimientos tecnológicos están listos, y ahora arranca la fase más ambiciosa. Necesito a un/a Data Analyst con ganas de tener un impacto real desde el primer mes.




El reto actual (Gobierno y Calidad): El DWH está construido, pero centralizar la información es sólo el principio. Nuestro foco absoluto ahora es el Data Quality y la Gobernanza. El reto es auditar los procesos, asegurar que nuestra única fuente de verdad sea inquebrantable y sacar definitivamente a las áreas de negocio del "caos del Excel manual" hacia un modelo estructurado.




Hacia dónde vamos (La visión de IA): No queremos ser una fábrica de reportes. El objetivo de tener una gobernanza impecable es desplegar una capa de Inteligencia Artificial por encima. La meta es que el negocio sea 100% autónomo (Self-Service) y que esta IA resuelva sus preguntas del día a día basándose en nuestros modelos. Pero para que la IA sea útil, la calidad del dato por debajo debe ser perfecta. Ahí es donde entras tú.




¿Qué busco en ti?

✔️ Dominio sólido de SQL: Será tu herramienta principal de batalla.

✔️ Obsesión por el Data Quality: Que no te conformes con que el dato "llegue", sino que garantices que es exacto, auditable y escalable.

✔️ Entendimiento de negocio: Que no te limites a extraer números, sino que preguntes "para qué" y entiendas cómo afectan a la cuenta de resultados.

✔️ Ganas de innovar: Cero miedo a asentar las bases que alimentarán los futuros productos de IA de la compañía.

¿Qué te ofrezco? Trabajar mano a mano conmigo, exposición directa a la dirección de negocio y ser una pieza clave en la transición real de la empresa hacia la IA.

Title: Regional Data Analyst
Description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About The Role

Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team and play a key role in accelerating our data transformation across the Services Division. This position sits at the crossroads of business intelligence, analytics, and technology, providing an exciting opportunity to influence how data is leveraged to support strategic and operational decisions across the region.

We are looking for a proactive and business-oriented data professional who enjoys turning complex data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with a builder mindset, constantly seeking smarter, faster, and more effective ways of working through technology and innovation.

In this highly visible role, you will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain, helping teams unlock the full value of data while promoting a culture of data-driven decision making.

What You Will Do


Gather and translate business requirements into clear, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses.
Develop, enhance, and maintain business intelligence dashboards, ensuring consistency, usability, and high-quality user experiences.
Manage analytics and dashboard development projects from scope definition through delivery and continuous improvement.
Build a strong understanding of data sources, structures, and flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms.
Ensure dashboards are intuitive, actionable, and accessible to business users with minimal training.
Maintain documentation for dashboards, data models, and related processes.
Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance activities and serve as a regional point of reference for business users.
Identify data quality issues and collaborate with stakeholders to implement sustainable improvement solutions.
Analyze trends across regions, product lines, and business areas to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.
Support stakeholders with ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to address complex business questions.
Partner with regional and sub-regional management teams to understand business priorities and enable informed decision-making.
Guide and support regional users in adopting and effectively utilizing BI tools and dashboards.
Design and deliver training sessions that increase data literacy and user adoption.
Support leadership teams with compelling, data-driven narratives and recommendations.
Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve existing reporting and analytics processes through emerging technologies and tools.


Required

What you need to succeed:


3 to 6 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or related role.
Proven experience developing dashboards that support real business decision-making.
Advanced Excel and Power Pivot skills, including complex data models, pivot tables, and data analysis techniques.
Hands-on experience with a major BI platform such as Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Strong understanding of data structures, data modelling, and working with multiple data sources.
Experience partnering with business functions such as Sales, Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
Experience collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical or IT teams.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Excellent written and spoken English.


Preferred


Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, B2B environment, or consultancy.
Exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.
Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and data warehouses such as Snowflake.
Spanish language skills.
Portuguese language skills.
Experience identifying and implementing technology-driven process improvements and automations.
Project management experience or a strong project management mindset.
Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, and business environments.


What we offer you


A permanent contract.

Description:
Senior Business Analyst

Location: Madrid, Spain

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

At PMI, we're transforming our business and building our future around one clear purpose: delivering a smoke-free future.

As part of our Data, Insights & Analytics (DI&A) team, you'll help turn data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge business strategy and analytics by translating complex business challenges into data-driven insights and solutions.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, uncover trends, develop dashboards and analytical products, and enable better, faster, and more informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze commercial, consumer, and digital data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and define analytical requirements.
Design, build, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
Drive visibility of key performance indicators across multiple functions.
Support continuous improvement through experimentation, performance measurement, and insight generation.
Promote data quality, analytics adoption, and evidence-based decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related fields.
Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development and data modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar cloud-based analytics environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Experience translating business questions into analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Advanced English communication skills.


Nice to Have


Experience working with consumer, CRM, loyalty, or customer lifecycle data.
Understanding of consumer behavior from acquisition to retention.
Experience with advanced or predictive analytics using Python, R, or similar programming languages.


Why PMI?

At PMI, you'll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues from around the world, and contribute to the transformation of a global organization.

We offer the opportunity to learn, innovate, grow your career, and make an impact from day one.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Title: Analista de Datos Junior
Description:
¿Te gustaría unirte a un proyecto tecnológico puntero con un impacto positivo?




Desde Newtral nace Trueflag, una spin-off con el propósito de utilizar la IA como herramienta para combatir la desinformación y las fake news.




Estamos buscando a una persona que se incorpore como Data Analyst que combine la habilidad de manejar grandes volúmenes de datos con una fuerte orientación al negocio y al cliente.




¿Cuáles serían tus principales responsabilidades?

Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos provenientes de diversas fuentes para identificar tendencias, patrones e información relevante para los diferentes stakeholders.
Diseñar y construir informes y dashboards efectivos que comuniquen resultados de forma clara a los clientes y al equipo interno.
Buscar en los datos las historias que importan a cada cliente y convertirlas en entregables listos para enviar.
Identificar oportunidades de automatización en análisis de datos, informes y generación de alertas en tiempo real.
Garantizar la integridad y precisión de los datos mediante procesos de validación y limpieza.




¿Qué buscamos?

Formación en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas o similar.
Experiencia previa de +2 años en consultoría de BI o analista de datos. Importante haber trabajado con grandes volúmenes de datos.
Experiencia en análisis de datos, elaboración de informes y cuadros de mando.
Conocimientos en bases de datos SQL (OLTP y OLAP)
Experiencia básica con Python para análisis y manipulación de grandes volúmenes de datos
Experiencia con herramientas de visualización como Tableau, Metabase, Power BI, Looker u otras similares.
Familiaridad con procesos ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)
Español nativo e inglés alto.




Bonus:

Se valorará experiencia trabajando con dbt.
Se valorará haber trabajado con equipos de Data Science.
Se valorará experiencia trabajando con bases de datos NoSQL.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Trabajo 100% remoto desde cualquier parte de España.
Posibilidad de un espacio de coworking en Madrid o Vigo.
La posibilidad de trabajar en un equipo técnico de primer nivel.
Flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salida
23 días de vacaciones además del 24 y 31 de Diciembre.
Plan de retribución flexible.
Dos offsites de empresa al año.
Condiciones competitivas: fijo anual bruto de 35-42k € + Variable.

Title: Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Marketing & Communication Senior Consultant

Fundada en 2008, HipoGes es una de las plataformas líderes en Asset Management para activos distressed, con más de 48.500 millones de euros en activos bajo gestión. Con oficinas en España, Portugal, Grecia e Italia y más de 1.700 empleados, HipoGes como plataforma independiente trabaja con más de 30 clientes diferentes, instituciones financieras e inversores internacionales especializados en el sector de activos distressed. HipoGes proporciona soluciones a lo largo de todo el ciclo de inversión:
Due diligence y valoración
Cierre de operaciones y reestructuración
Gestión amistosa de préstamos / gestión legal, real estate management, estrategia de comercialización y venta, reporting ; portfolio management
En el área de asset management, HipoGes gestiona una amplia gama de activos incluyendo hipotecas residenciales, préstamos a grandes corporaciones y PYMES, activos de real estate y préstamos sin garantía.



Descripción

El departamento de Marketing & Communication es el encargado de velar por la imagen de marca de la compañía (y marcas del grupo). Gestionar y desarrollar la comunicación externa e impulsar la comunicación interna. Dando soporte a todos los departamentos de la empresa.


Perfil

Descripción del puesto:

Buscamos un/a Analista Digital de Datos e Insights para el área de Marketing, con responsabilidad directa sobre la calidad, coherencia e interpretación del dato de marketing y comercial, y un papel clave como puente entre negocio y los equipos de Data/BI.

Su misión será asegurar que los datos sean fiables, comprensibles y accionables, transformándolos en análisis claros que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas y operativas del área de Marketing de la compañía, así como la elaboración de informes y reportes para dirección.

Funciones:

· Seguimiento diario de KPIs de negocio y marketing mediante herramientas de Business Intelligence.
· Ownership de la calidad del dato de marketing (definición, control y mejora continua).
· Detección de inconsistencias entre fuentes (CRM, BI, marketing, comercial) y coordinación para su corrección.
· Definición de KPIs claros, homogéneos y compartidos entre equipos.
· Traducción de datos complejos en insights accionables para perfiles no técnicos.
· Elaboración de recomendaciones basadas en datos.
· Identificación temprana de alertas y cambios de tendencia.
· Elaboración de informes de seguimiento y análisis.
· Diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de dashboards en Power BI.
· Cruce, revisión y validación de datos procedentes de Marketing, Comercial y CRM.
· Colaboración continua con los equipos implicados para mejorar procesos y calidad del dato.

Requisitos:

Imprescindibles:
· Experiencia previa como Analista de Datos / BI / Reporting.
· Capacidad demostrada para interpretar datos.
· Perfil analítico, riguroso y ágil en el análisis.
· Buen manejo de Power BI.
· Conocimientos de SQL.
· Atlo nivel de Excel.
· SQL para exploración y validación de datos.

Valorable:
· Experiencia con datos de CRM.
· Experiencia previa en marketing, ventas, comercial.
· Experiencia colaborando con equipos de Data/Engineering.
· Experiencia en entornos con múltiples fuentes de datos.
· Experiencia en Real Estate, Finance en entornos digitales.

Title: Social Listening - Data Analyst
Description:
About SAMY

We weren't built to follow, we were built to lead.

SAMY is the global powerhouse redefining brand communication for a social-first world—helping brands stay relevant, shape culture, and build real connections at the speed the world moves.

Since 2013, we've grown from a bold idea into a global force: 1,200+ experts, 17+ offices, 55 markets, 22+ countries. We launch 40+ campaigns a week, create one piece of content every minute, and generate +$500K in revenue every day.

We are Path Finders: curious, ambitious, and never afraid to challenge what’s next.

We don't play it safe. We build what's next.

Link instagram, tiktok, cultura.

Role Mission

As a Social Listening - Data Analyst at SAMY, you’ll transform campaign and business data into clear, actionable insights that help teams and clients make better decisions and improve performance.

New project coming!

Join the team behind one of the world's most iconic beauty portfolios and help define how global brands win in today's creator economy.

Beauty is one of the fastest-moving and most influential industries in the world. Trends are born overnight, creators shape consumer behaviour, and communities decide what products become tomorrow's icons. Working on this account means having a front-row seat to everything happening across social, culture, creators and innovation.

At SAMY, you'll help global beauty brands stay ahead of what's next. You'll turn cultural shifts into strategy, identify the creators driving conversations, and build advocacy programmes that connect brands with millions of people in authentic ways.

You'll work at the intersection of social, culture, AI, technology and creativity, where every day brings new trends, new platforms and new opportunities to shape the future of beauty marketing.

If you're passionate about creators, obsessed with culture and excited by the idea of working on one of the most prestigious global beauty accounts in the industry, we'd love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze campaign and business performance data to identify trends, patterns, drivers, and optimization opportunities.
Utilize tools like Sprinklr and Brandwatch to gather consumer, cultural, and competitive intelligence.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights and actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
Develop and maintain benchmarks, KPIs, and measurement frameworks aligned with client and business objectives.
Prepare regular and ad-hoc performance reports, turning data into compelling and easy-to-understand narratives.
Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance through data-driven recommendations.
Collaborate with Strategy, Creative, Account, and other teams to ensure data informs decision-making.
Contribute to improving reporting methodologies, analytical processes, and data storytelling standards.


,

Skills & Experience


Experience in data analysis, digital marketing analytics, or a similar role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insights.
Understanding of digital marketing, social media, and campaign performance metrics.
Strong communication skills and ability to present insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Proactive, curious, and solution-oriented mindset.
English full working proficiency (written and verbal).


Benefits


Work your way – Flexible schedule, hybrid work, and the opportunity to work up to 3 weeks a year from any SAMY office around the world.
Time that matters – Celebrate your birthday with a day off, plus company holidays on December 24th and 31st to recharge.
Grow with us – Global mobility opportunities, mentorship, parenthood support, and a transparent performance-driven compensation framework.
Be part of the journey – – Help shape our team through our referral program and enjoy a collaborative, social culture, backed by a transparent, performance-driven compensation framework that rewards impact and supports your growth.


The SAMY Mindset

Forget the job description for a second. The real question is: are you a Path Finder?

Bold enough to challenge what's possible. Collaborative enough to build it together. Driven enough to make it happen.

We don't just hire for roles, we hire for mindset. We look for people who communicate with honesty, collaborate without ego, embrace change with energy, and take real ownership of what they build.

We’re not looking for people who think the same, we’re looking for people who want to grow with us.

Here's What It Actually Looks Like To Belong Here

Be Kind — because respect, trust, and honest feedback make great teams stronger.

Go Beyond — because good is never enough when excellence is the standard.

Craft Together — because the best ideas don't happen in silos.

Enjoy the Journey — because growth lives outside the comfort zone.

Own It — because real impact starts with accountability.

If this feels like your kind of adventure, let's build something together.

Diversity & Inclusion

At SAMY, difference is not something we accommodate, it’s what makes us stronger.

With a team made up of 70% women and more than 35 different nationalities, our different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences challenge our thinking, sharpen our creativity, and push us to build better work, and a better company.

We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and barrier-free environment where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to thrive. And if you need support or adjustments along the way, we’ll make sure you have what you need to do your best work.

Title: Data & IA Analyst
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Sobre Nosotros

Scuffers es una marca de ropa inspirada en la estética urbana mediterránea, con un estilo y carácter distintivo impulsado por los valores de autenticidad y autoexpresión.

Nuestra filosofía se centra en el desarrollo de producto, investigamos y exploramos cuidadosamente materiales y fits únicos, para ser capaces de ofrecer ropa que no solo se ve bien, sino que también te haga sentir bien.

Ya llevamos seis años construyendo nuestro lifestyle. Comenzamos creando ropa con la que nos gustaría vestirnos a nosotros y fuimos creciendo gracias a una comunidad de personas que buscaban lo mismo.

Si te apasionan los retos y quieres formar parte de nuestro equipo dinámico y joven, buscamos nuevos perfiles para unirse a nuestro equipo.

El Rol

Buscamos un/a Data & IA Analyst que se incorpore a nuestro equipo para ayudarnos a ordenar, estructurar y analizar los datos de Scuffers, convirtiéndolos en información útil para la toma de decisiones de negocio.

Buscamos un perfil híbrido entre análisis de datos y tecnología: alguien que no solo sepa analizar información, sino que sea capaz de utilizar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para construir sus propias soluciones, automatizaciones y dashboards.

Trabajarás de forma muy cercana con el IA Builder, participando en la construcción y evolución de herramientas internas que nos permitan trabajar con nuestros datos de forma más ágil, fiable y autónoma.

Es un rol muy dinámico, ideal para alguien analítico, curioso, resolutivo y con ganas de construir cosas.

Funciones y Responsabilidades

Data & Analytics (core del rol):


Estructuración y modelado de los datos de la empresa:
Definir cómo se organizan y relacionan las diferentes fuentes de información.
Trabajar con datos de ventas, inventario, pedidos, colaboradores, marketing, etc.
Asegurar que los datos sean consistentes, fiables y fáciles de consultar.
Análisis de datos para extraer conclusiones útiles para el negocio:
Identificar tendencias, oportunidades y posibles problemas.
Analizar qué funciona, qué no y por qué.
Convertir datos en conclusiones claras y accionables.
Creación y mantenimiento de dashboards y herramientas de reporting que permitan al equipo consultar la información de forma autónoma.
Integración y conexión de diferentes fuentes de datos para crear una visión global del negocio.

IA & Product Building


Utilización de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para construir soluciones de análisis, reporting y automatización.
Trabajar con asistentes de IA para programar y desarrollar herramientas, siendo capaz de:
Dar contexto y definir correctamente los problemas.
Revisar y validar el código generado.
Detectar errores y corregirlos.
Iterar hasta conseguir soluciones fiables.
Colaboración con el responsable de IA en el desarrollo y evolución de las plataformas internas de Scuffers.
Integración de herramientas de reporting dentro de las plataformas existentes cuando sea necesario.
Automatización de procesos repetitivos relacionados con la gestión y preparación de datos.

Requisitos


Experiencia trabajando con SQL y bases de datos.
Conocimientos de modelado de datos y capacidad para estructurar y relacionar diferentes fuentes de información.
Experiencia sólida utilizando Python para limpiar, transformar, cruzar y automatizar datos.
Experiencia real utilizando herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para programar y construir herramientas, más allá de utilizar IA únicamente para consultas o generación de contenido.
Capacidad para construir dashboards, aplicaciones o herramientas de reporting.
Conocimientos de PostgreSQL será un plus.
Capacidad para leer y realizar modificaciones sencillas en Next.js.
Mentalidad analítica y capacidad para convertir datos en conclusiones de negocio.
Mentalidad proactiva y resolutiva.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma y avanzar de manera ordenada.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación para explicar información técnica y conclusiones de forma sencilla.


Será Un Plus


Experiencia trabajando con datos de e-commerce.
Experiencia con herramientas de Business Intelligence y visualización de datos.
Conocimientos de estadística aplicada.
Experiencia analizando tendencias, comportamiento de clientes o realizando previsiones.
Experiencia trabajando con APIs y conectando diferentes fuentes de datos.


¿Qué ofrecemos?

🫰🏻Una filosofía de trabajo marcada por el crecimiento de grupo y marca de forma paralela. Cada semana supone un nuevo reto, para ti y para el resto.

🎢 Crecimiento profesional: Tenemos un camino muy largo por delante, con muchos retos que cumplir y tú serás una parte fundamental, por lo que iremos creciendo juntos.

🔝Impacto: Nos movemos rápido y eso hará que cada paso cuente y se note.

🫂Dream team: Somos un equipo joven con buena comunicación y muchas ganas de aprender unos de otros.

👖Presupuesto mensual para renovar tu armario: Queremos que seas un auténtico embajador de Scuffers.

🍑 Fruta fresca, café y snacks en nuestra oficina en Pozuelo de Alarcón.

🏋️‍♀️ Descuento en gimnasios para que puedas mantener una vida activa y saludable.
