Title: Analista de datos
Description:
En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo.

Por eso, si tienes experiencia como Analista de Datos / Analista Digital y te apasiona transformar datos en insights que impulsen la toma de decisiones, nos comprometemos a potenciar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa. ¿Quieres construir hoy el mundo de mañana? ¡Sigue leyendo!




Formarás parte de un proyecto estratégico de analítica digital, enfocado en el análisis de tráfico, consumo y engagement de usuarios, colaborando con diferentes áreas de negocio para convertir los datos en conocimiento accionable y generar impacto real en la estrategia digital.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?

Dar apoyo al equipo en la elaboración y presentación en PowerPoint de los resultados obtenidos a través del análisis de datos de Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
Coordinar peticiones y solicitudes de análisis, manteniendo un inventario actualizado de las mismas y estimando los tiempos de entrega.
Colaborar en la documentación y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado completas (eventos, parámetros, conversiones y dimensiones personalizadas), garantizando la coherencia y escalabilidad de la medición.
Gestionar y explotar Google Analytics 4 (GA4) como principal herramienta de análisis mediante datos almacenados en BigQuery dentro de un entorno Data Proc.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards en Looker Studio orientados tanto a negocio como a perfiles no técnicos.
Validar la calidad del dato, identificando incidencias y asegurando su consistencia y trazabilidad.
Analizar datos para detectar tendencias, desviaciones e identificar oportunidades de mejora mediante insights accionables.
Trabajar de forma transversal con equipos de negocio, SEO y redacción para garantizar una medición y análisis adecuados de los resultados.
Elaborar informes y reportes de rendimiento de redes sociales.
Documentar procesos, metodologías y buenas prácticas del área de analítica digital.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia demostrable presentando resultados e insights a clientes internos o externos mediante el análisis del consumo de sitios digitales con Google Analytics 4.
Experiencia en la creación, gestión y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado avanzadas.
Conocimiento y experiencia en la implementación y uso de Looker Studio.
Conocimiento de BigQuery en entornos Data Proc (contando con el apoyo de equipos técnicos especializados).
Capacidad para transformar datos en información clara, útil y orientada a la toma de decisiones.
Experiencia trabajando con KPIs y métricas enfocadas a objetivos de negocio.
Dominio de Excel y PowerPoint.
Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y excelentes habilidades de comunicación.
Alta capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico y atención al detalle.




Modalidad: Híbrido en Madrid.




¿Quiénes somos?

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Si te gustan las cifras, te diremos que en España contamos con una facturación de 217 millones de euros, 9 sedes y un equipo formado por más de 5.240 profesionales.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullecemos de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades con independencia de género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

Si crees que eres talento, ¡apúntate! 🚀

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Tus tareas

El equipo de Asesoria AVM forma parte de la unidad de Inteligencia Inmobiliaria de Accumin Intelligence y es el responsable del desarrollo, mantenimiento y entrega de modelos automáticos de valoración (AVM) bajo el marco normativo vigente en España, principalmente de la Orden ECO 805/2003 y la regulación del Banco de España aplicable a entidades tasadoras homologadas.




El departamento trabaja en estrecha colaboración con entidades financieras, fondos y servicers, proporcionando valoraciones masivas de activos inmobiliarios con los estándares de calidad, trazabilidad y documentación exigidos por el regulador. La apertura de este proceso responde a la necesidad de reforzar el equipo con un perfil senior que contribuya al análisis y mejora continua de los modelos, la validación de datos y la elaboración análisis de las valoraciones, en un contexto de crecimiento de la demanda por parte de nuestros clientes y de expansión de las capacidades del área. Además que contribuya al crecimiento del equipo tanto en España como internacional, ampliando capacidades y clientes.




Tu perfil




¿En qué consistirán sus tareas principales?

Gestión, apoyo y supervisión al equipo de asesoría de carteras y AVM consistente en 6 personas.
Análisis y revisión de resultados de valoración inmobiliaria AVM. Participación en el diseño, calibración y actualización de modelos estadísticos para la valoración automática masiva de activos inmobiliarios (residencial, terciario, suelo).
Análisis y control de calidad del dato. Exploración, limpieza y validación de bases de datos inmobiliarias (testigos de mercado, registros públicos, datos internos), identificando inconsistencias, outliers y gaps que puedan afectar a la representatividad y fiabilidad de los modelos.
Monitorización y estudio del error de los modelos. Seguimiento periódico de las métricas de desempeño de los modelos en producción (MAPE, mediana de error, ratio hit rate, etc.), detección de desviaciones y elaboración de propuestas de mejora.
Elaboración de análisis de mercado y resultados de valoración de carteras. Redacción de dossieres de modelo, fichas metodológicas, informes de validación y registros de cambios.
Automatización de procesos. Desarrollo de scripts y flujos de trabajo en Python y/o SQL para la automatización de cargas de datos, ejecución de modelos y generación de informes de calidad, contribuyendo a la puesta en producción de los procesos del área.
Análisis ad-hoc para clientes. Soporte en la elaboración de estudios y análisis específicos requeridos por entidades financieras, fondos o servicers, incluyendo segmentaciones de cartera, análisis de mercado local y comparativas de valor.
Reporting e interpretación de resultados. Preparación de presentaciones y reportes que trasladen de forma clara los outputs de los modelos y los análisis realizados, tanto para uso interno como para interlocutores externos no técnicos.




¿Qué esperamos de tí?

Titulación de Grado en Economía, ADE, Ingeniería o Matemáticas.
Valorable otros cursos relacionados con este ámbito.
Experiencia profesional mínima de 3 años en puesto similar.
Conocimiento del mercado de carteras NPL
Nivel básico de Python, y nivel avanzado de Excel y PPT.
Valorable el uso de herramientas de visualización de datos.
Inglés C1 y español C2.




¿Qué tipo de persona buscamos?

Buscamos a una persona con alta capacidad analítica y de razonamiento.
Que sea planificada y organizada.
Capaz de adaptarse a cambios, adoptando una actitud flexible.
Tenga gran capacidad comunicativa.
Orientada a la calidad en su trabajo y mucha iniciativa.




¿Por qué nosotros?

Contrato indefinido.
Incorporación inmediata.
Trabajo en equipo que permite estar en continuo aprendizaje.
Modalidad de teletrabajo híbrida al 40%, que permanecerá vigente mientras la empresa no decida modificarlo de manera general, en base a la productividad de la Compañía.
Horario flexible de 9:00 a 19:00 de lunes a viernes.
Servicio de menú diario incluido.
Compromiso a fomentar un entorno inclusivo donde todas las personas puedan desarrollarse y alcanzar su máximo potencial, porque creemos en la igualdad de oportunidades

Title: Data Analyst (with focus on AI)
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Role purpose

We are looking to add to the Analytics team a profile 100% focused on data analysis and business impact, with a strong sensitivity towards the world of applied Artificial Intelligence, capable of transforming complex data into actionable insights, driving continuous improvement, and clearly communicating conclusions in an executive manner to different stakeholders.

We are not looking for a purely academic or AI research profile, but for someone who knows how to use AI as a lever to elevate analysis quality, accelerate insight generation, and improve decision-making.




Key Responsibilities

Analyze large volumes of data to identify patterns, root causes, and improvement opportunities with direct business impact.
Generate actionable insights by connecting technical metrics with business KPIs and strategic objectives.
Apply AI / advanced analytics techniques (predictive models, clustering, analysis automation, insight generation, etc.) with a practical, results-oriented approach.
Drive continuous improvement by proposing hypotheses, tests, and data-driven recommendations.
Design and create executive presentations (slides, dashboards, one-pagers) for committees and senior stakeholders, with clear, structured, and decision-oriented messaging.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (product, technology, operations, business), acting as a bridge between data and decision-making.
Explore and propose new use cases of AI applied to data analysis, maintaining a pragmatic innovation mindset.




Profile we are looking for

Degree in quantitative fields: Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar.
Strong experience in data analysis and interpretation of business KPIs.
Knowledge and practical experience with analytics tools (SQL, Python, Power BI / Tableau or similar).
Interest and experience in applying AI techniques and advanced models, always with a business focus (not an academic profile).
High ability to synthesize complex information and convert it into clear messages for non-technical audiences.
Experience creating executive presentations and presenting conclusions to senior stakeholders.
Continuous improvement mindset, critical thinking, and impact orientation.
Strong communication skills, autonomy, and an end-to-end vision of data.
Fluent in English and Spanish (C1+), with experience working in international and cross-functional environments




Nice to have

Experience using AI to automate analysis, generate insights, or improve analytical efficiency.
Knowledge of cloud environments, large-scale data management, or analytical pipelines.
Previous experience in product, operations, or business environments.
Ability to prioritize and focus analysis on what truly drives impact.




What We Offer

A role with real impact on business decisions.
An environment where AI is applied in a practical, not experimental, way.
Direct participation in decision-making forums and strategic projects.
A highly skilled team with a collaborative mindset.
Opportunity to grow at the intersection of data, AI, and business.







Strong fit with our Company DNA

Passionate in Everything We Do: Our people bring a contagious energy and a sense of urgency that is unmistakable. We create a vision and inspire others around that vision with full engagement and focus. We are all-in, and we love what we do.

Committed to Making a Difference: We are courageous, we deliver what we promise through hard work and resilience. We make a difference, through operating with discipline and doing what is needed. We are hands-on, and we aren’t afraid to get into the detail. We deliver results and we execute with excellence.

Always Innovating: Our people make the impossible possible; it’s a continuous state of mind. We are purpose-driven, curious and we challenge the status quo. We believe good ideas travel, we share and reapply. We take smart risks, and we are not afraid to fail. We believe innovation can be big or small.

Winning as a Team: We are determined to become number 1, and to do that we need to listen to one another, collaborate and work together. We play our part, fueled by a winning attitude and a fighting spirit. We celebrate our successes. We play to our strengths and our diversity to deliver even better outcomes, while developing and supporting one another. We believe that together we go further, and that nothing is impossible.

With Trust & Responsibility: Our people take responsibility for the people we protect. We are accountable and reliable. We role model operating with integrity. We trust and empower one another to do the right thing, always. We deliver on our promise through world-class expertise and meticulous know-how. And, we do this with humility while being honoured to play such an important role in society.




At Verisure, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, recognising that diversity of thought and background only makes our teams stronger and more innovative. We reject all forms of discrimination and bias, and we believe in access to opportunities for everyone, regardless of gender, age, disability status, race, sexual orientation, or any other status.

Analizarás resultados y elaborar informes de seguimiento utilizando Excel y otras herramientas de análisis.

1-3 años de experiencia profesional, en áreas de desarrollo de negocio, desarrollo corporativo, consultoría o en el sector asegurador, bancario o financiero.
Excel avanzado y Power BI.
Capacidad de análisis e interpretación de datos.

Title: Regional Data Analyst
Description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About The Role

Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team and play a key role in accelerating our data transformation across the Services Division. This position sits at the crossroads of business intelligence, analytics, and technology, providing an exciting opportunity to influence how data is leveraged to support strategic and operational decisions across the region.

We are looking for a proactive and business-oriented data professional who enjoys turning complex data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with a builder mindset, constantly seeking smarter, faster, and more effective ways of working through technology and innovation.

In this highly visible role, you will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain, helping teams unlock the full value of data while promoting a culture of data-driven decision making.

What You Will Do


Gather and translate business requirements into clear, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses.
Develop, enhance, and maintain business intelligence dashboards, ensuring consistency, usability, and high-quality user experiences.
Manage analytics and dashboard development projects from scope definition through delivery and continuous improvement.
Build a strong understanding of data sources, structures, and flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms.
Ensure dashboards are intuitive, actionable, and accessible to business users with minimal training.
Maintain documentation for dashboards, data models, and related processes.
Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance activities and serve as a regional point of reference for business users.
Identify data quality issues and collaborate with stakeholders to implement sustainable improvement solutions.
Analyze trends across regions, product lines, and business areas to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.
Support stakeholders with ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to address complex business questions.
Partner with regional and sub-regional management teams to understand business priorities and enable informed decision-making.
Guide and support regional users in adopting and effectively utilizing BI tools and dashboards.
Design and deliver training sessions that increase data literacy and user adoption.
Support leadership teams with compelling, data-driven narratives and recommendations.
Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve existing reporting and analytics processes through emerging technologies and tools.


Required

What you need to succeed:


3 to 6 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or related role.
Proven experience developing dashboards that support real business decision-making.
Advanced Excel and Power Pivot skills, including complex data models, pivot tables, and data analysis techniques.
Hands-on experience with a major BI platform such as Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Strong understanding of data structures, data modelling, and working with multiple data sources.
Experience partnering with business functions such as Sales, Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
Experience collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical or IT teams.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Excellent written and spoken English.


Preferred


Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, B2B environment, or consultancy.
Exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.
Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and data warehouses such as Snowflake.
Spanish language skills.
Portuguese language skills.
Experience identifying and implementing technology-driven process improvements and automations.
Project management experience or a strong project management mindset.
Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, and business environments.


What we offer you


A permanent contract.
A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
Meal vouchers.
Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package, such as health insurance, transport, or childcare.
Be part of an experienced and international team.
A good vibe working environment.
The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.
Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.
The freedom to innovate, experiment, and help shape smarter ways of working.
Office location: Nuevos Ministerios, Madrid, Spain.
Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.


Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Title: Sr Business Analyst
Description:
Senior Business Analyst

Location: Madrid, Spain

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

At PMI, we're transforming our business and building our future around one clear purpose: delivering a smoke-free future.

As part of our Data, Insights & Analytics (DI&A) team, you'll help turn data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge business strategy and analytics by translating complex business challenges into data-driven insights and solutions.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, uncover trends, develop dashboards and analytical products, and enable better, faster, and more informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze commercial, consumer, and digital data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and define analytical requirements.
Design, build, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
Drive visibility of key performance indicators across multiple functions.
Support continuous improvement through experimentation, performance measurement, and insight generation.
Promote data quality, analytics adoption, and evidence-based decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related fields.
Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development and data modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar cloud-based analytics environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Experience translating business questions into analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Advanced English communication skills.


Nice to Have


Experience working with consumer, CRM, loyalty, or customer lifecycle data.
Understanding of consumer behavior from acquisition to retention.
Experience with advanced or predictive analytics using Python, R, or similar programming languages.


Why PMI?

At PMI, you'll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues from around the world, and contribute to the transformation of a global organization.

We offer the opportunity to learn, innovate, grow your career, and make an impact from day one.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We believe diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Relocation support and visa sponsorship are not provided. Candidates must have the legal right to work in Spain to be considered for this role.

Description:
Marketing & Communication Senior Consultant

Fundada en 2008, HipoGes es una de las plataformas líderes en Asset Management para activos distressed, con más de 48.500 millones de euros en activos bajo gestión. Con oficinas en España, Portugal, Grecia e Italia y más de 1.700 empleados, HipoGes como plataforma independiente trabaja con más de 30 clientes diferentes, instituciones financieras e inversores internacionales especializados en el sector de activos distressed. HipoGes proporciona soluciones a lo largo de todo el ciclo de inversión:
Due diligence y valoración
Cierre de operaciones y reestructuración
Gestión amistosa de préstamos / gestión legal, real estate management, estrategia de comercialización y venta, reporting ; portfolio management
En el área de asset management, HipoGes gestiona una amplia gama de activos incluyendo hipotecas residenciales, préstamos a grandes corporaciones y PYMES, activos de real estate y préstamos sin garantía.



Descripción

El departamento de Marketing & Communication es el encargado de velar por la imagen de marca de la compañía (y marcas del grupo). Gestionar y desarrollar la comunicación externa e impulsar la comunicación interna. Dando soporte a todos los departamentos de la empresa.


Perfil

Descripción del puesto:

Buscamos un/a Analista Digital de Datos e Insights para el área de Marketing, con responsabilidad directa sobre la calidad, coherencia e interpretación del dato de marketing y comercial, y un papel clave como puente entre negocio y los equipos de Data/BI.

Su misión será asegurar que los datos sean fiables, comprensibles y accionables, transformándolos en análisis claros que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas y operativas del área de Marketing de la compañía, así como la elaboración de informes y reportes para dirección.

Funciones:

· Seguimiento diario de KPIs de negocio y marketing mediante herramientas de Business Intelligence.
· Ownership de la calidad del dato de marketing (definición, control y mejora continua).
· Detección de inconsistencias entre fuentes (CRM, BI, marketing, comercial) y coordinación para su corrección.
· Definición de KPIs claros, homogéneos y compartidos entre equipos.
· Traducción de datos complejos en insights accionables para perfiles no técnicos.
· Elaboración de recomendaciones basadas en datos.
· Identificación temprana de alertas y cambios de tendencia.
· Elaboración de informes de seguimiento y análisis.
· Diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de dashboards en Power BI.
· Cruce, revisión y validación de datos procedentes de Marketing, Comercial y CRM.
· Colaboración continua con los equipos implicados para mejorar procesos y calidad del dato.

Requisitos:

Imprescindibles:
· Experiencia previa como Analista de Datos / BI / Reporting.
· Capacidad demostrada para interpretar datos.
· Perfil analítico, riguroso y ágil en el análisis.
· Buen manejo de Power BI.
· Conocimientos de SQL.
· Atlo nivel de Excel.
· SQL para exploración y validación de datos.

Valorable:
· Experiencia con datos de CRM.
· Experiencia previa en marketing, ventas, comercial.
· Experiencia colaborando con equipos de Data/Engineering.
· Experiencia en entornos con múltiples fuentes de datos.
· Experiencia en Real Estate, Finance en entornos digitales.

Title: Analista de Datos de Negocio – Retención, Fidelización
Description:
Misión del Puesto

Como Analista de Datos de Negocio, serás el motor analítico que ayude a impulsar la estrategia de retención y fidelización. Debes poseer la profundidad técnica para entender los datos y la visión estratégica para entender el negocio. Serás el encargado de liderar la identificación de patrones de comportamiento mediante el ecosistema de Google Cloud (BigQuery) e IA, transformando datos en soluciones que reduzcan directamente la tasa de abandono.




Funciones Principales

Análisis de Negocio y Operativa

Comprender a fondo la operativa del negocio para asegurar que los análisis realizados se ajusten a la realidad del cliente y de la compañía.
Analizar el ciclo de vida del cliente para detectar señales de alerta antes de que se produzca una baja o impago.
Transformar datos complejos en información que los responsables de negocio puedan ejecutar de inmediato.
Generar bases de datos precisas para el lanzamiento de campañas de retención, asegurando la correcta exclusión de perfiles y la personalización de las ofertas.
Elaboración de informes ad-hoc para el Área de Retención y Fidelización, garantizando la coherencia y cubriendo sus necesidades específicas.

Colaboración Multidisciplinar (Técnico-Negocio)

Actuar como enlace permanente entre el equipo de Retención, Fidelización y el equipo de IT/Datos así como con el resto de unidades de Negocio (Ventas, Producto).
Aunque IT gestiona la exportación técnica entre plataformas (ej. desde nuestra solución actual, Genesys Cloud u otras plataformas de Contact Center equivalentes, hacia Google Cloud), el analista debe conocer ambas para optimizar el uso de los datos.
Trabajar con IT para asegurar que las fuentes de información sean veraces y que las métricas definidas respondan a las necesidades reales de negocio.

Experiencia y Formación

Grado en ADE, Economía, Estadística, Análisis de Datos o similar.
Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en departamentos analíticos de negocio. Se valorará el sector asegurador, pero se aceptan perfiles de banca, retail, telco o utilities con fuerte enfoque en retención.




Perfil Requerido

Perfil técnico y de conocimiento

Entendimiento de los procesos de negocio y ciclo de vida del cliente.
Experiencia en la explotación de datos y métricas de herramientas de Call Center. Se valorará muy positivamente el conocimiento específico en Genesys Cloud como fuente de origen de datos de voz e interacciones.
Dominio de SQL y manejo de grandes volúmenes de datos en BigQuery.
Experiencia sólida en Looker y/o Microstrategy para la creación de dashboards e informes de negocio.
Capacidad para trabajar con modelos de lenguaje y análisis de datos no estructurados.

Perfil Competencial

Capacidad para hablar el "lenguaje técnico" con IT y el "lenguaje de resultados" con los directivos de negocio.
Foco absoluto en la mejora de los KPIs de retención.
Capacidad para identificar problemas y proponer soluciones sin necesidad de supervisión constante.

Title: Portfolio Data Analyst
Description:
About Morningstar

Morningstar is a leading global provider of independent investment insights, serving both individual and institutional investors across public and private markets. Our offerings include a wide range of data, research, and investment management services, with $300+ billion in assets under management. Operating in 32 countries, Morningstar supports financial advisors, asset managers, retirement plan providers, and more with comprehensive investment solutions.

The Team

Morningstar’s Research group provides independent analysis on individual securities, managed investments, portfolios, and markets. The group also collects and maintains high-quality data on the equities, managed investments, and fixed-income investments we cover in our database, one of the largest investment databases in the world. Morningstar is one of the largest independent sources of manager, equity, and credit research in the world. We transform data into insights that investors can use to reach their financial goals.

The Role

The Managed investment Data Team requires a Data Research Analyst to process our portfolio data across global markets. The analyst will need to work closely with the global Portfolio Team and Local Business Representatives, taking responsibility for data coverage, quality, and timeliness to the highest standards. The Portfolio Data Analyst will form closer links with providers related to data acquisition processes and gain expert knowledge of our database. The position will be based in our Data and Development Centre EMEA.

Responsibilities


Collect and maintain Morningstar data, ensuring high levels of data accuracy, completeness and coverage.
Meet the predetermined production deadlines for internal and external clients
Collaborate strongly with the global data teams
Continuously evaluate procedures, create and enhance analytical tools, and implement process improvement projects.
Act as an expert regarding investment data points and calculations, answering questions and escalations from data team.
Maintain and strengthen existing relationships with fund companies and clients as well as 3rd party data providers
Keep up to date on current and new financial regulations (Solvency II, MIFID II, etc.)
Drive process improvement by applying LEAN Six Sigma tools and implementing process automation.
Support Morningstar's portfolio capabilities, by testing incoming templates (TPT+, APT, etc.
Handling of Portfolio Data Transfer Agreement. Strong collaboration with Legal department and fund companies


Requirement


Solid understanding of the financial industry and passionate in investment data.
Excellent writing, communication, problem solving, organizational, and analytical skills.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, capable of handling high volumes of data and meeting strict deadlines
Fluent English and at least one other European language is mandatory.
A minimum of 2 years of experience in Morningstar, ideally in data management.
Expertise in Morningstar data, methodology, quality and processes. A strong knowledge of derivative investments is also required.


Ready to Shape the Future? At Morningstar, every hire we make strengthens our mission to empower investor success. Apply now and help shape the future of investing with us.

Base Salary Compensation Range

EUR 29.000,00-39.000,00

Bonus Target

5% Annual

We expect the compensation and target bonus for this role to fall within the stated range. The specific compensation offered will depend on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and other job-related factors.

Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

Title: Data Analytics Lead (Product Intelligence)
Description:
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,300 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 18 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.









Job Description



About the role



The Product Intelligence team serves a critical role by providing business intelligence to the organization: we synthesize data sources across the company, delivering product usage and business insights that directly shape product strategy and decision-making.



We are looking for a Data Analytics Lead to own the analytical and semantic layer of Product Intelligence – the person who defines what our data means, makes sure it is trustworthy, and turns it into insight that changes decisions. You will work hand in hand with Product Management and Engineering to define the telemetry we need in order to answer the questions the business is actually asking, establish the success metrics that product and commercial teams are measured against, and proactively investigate product usage and user journeys to surface opportunities PMs would not have found on their own. You will also be the analytical voice in the room with senior leadership, regularly presenting insights and recommendations to senior management.



This is a deliberately broad, high-ownership analytics role rather than a report-building one. You will own data quality, cataloging, and the semantic definitions that make our data AI-ready, and you will partner closely with your data engineering counterpart – defining the business needs and data requirements, and collaborating with them to deliver the pipelines and models that support them.



As a senior individual contributor, you will lead our analytics function, its standards, and its definitions. As Lead you are expected to own the discipline and set its direction, with your influence coming from the quality of your work and your partnerships across Product, Engineering, and the business.



What you’ll do



Insight & analysis



Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to translate product usage and telemetry data into product-led insights – identifying upsell opportunities, predicting churn, and supporting revenue targets.
Perform proactive, self-directed analysis into product usage and user journeys – funnel and drop-off analysis, feature adoption, cohort and retention behaviour – to help Product Managers understand how the product is really used and where to improve it.
Define, document, and own the success metrics used to evaluate product features, releases, and business objectives, and make sure they are consistently understood and applied across teams.
Provide regular reporting, insights, and recommendations to senior management, and present them directly to that audience.
Manage senior stakeholders across the business, balancing competing analytical priorities from Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance.

Data definition, quality & governance



Own the semantic layer: define what our core business entities and metrics mean – customer, account, active user, adoption, churn, expansion – so that a given metric means the same thing everywhere in the company.
Champion an AI-ready data strategy by defining the semantics, metric definitions, and metadata that allow AI and LLM-powered tools to query our data reliably and return trustworthy answers.
Own data quality for the analytical layer: define quality expectations and checks, monitor for silent correctness failures, and drive issues to resolution with the owning teams before they reach a dashboard or a leadership deck.
Build and maintain the data catalog and documentation, so that data consumers across the company can find data, understand its meaning, and know how much to trust it.
Establish and maintain data governance practices for the analytics layer – ownership, lineage, definitions, and access – proportionate to a fast-moving team.

Data collection & partnering with Engineering



Work with Product Managers and Engineering to define and implement new product telemetry, specifying the events, properties, and grain needed to answer real business questions – and validating that what ships actually answers them.
Identify gaps in what we currently collect, and make the case for the instrumentation needed to close them.
Define business and data requirements clearly enough to be built, and collaborate with your data engineering counterpart to deliver the pipelines, models, and data structures required to support them.
Contribute to the design and evolution of the analytics layer, including semantic modeling and dashboarding within our BI tools.
Promote an agile, iterative way of working and actively contribute to team ceremonies.


Qualifications



What We’re Looking For



Analytics experience



Degree in a quantitative, technical, or business-analytical field, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of experience in a data analyst, product analyst, analytics engineer, or business intelligence role, including experience operating with a high level of autonomy and owning your own analytical agenda.
Strong SQL – comfortable working directly in a data warehouse against large, messy, multi-source data without needing someone to prepare it for you.
Proven experience partnering with Product and business teams to deliver product-led insights, such as identifying upsell opportunities, predicting churn, or supporting revenue growth.
Demonstrated experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting data strategy and insights to executive/C-level audiences.
Hands-on experience with product usage or telemetry data – funnels, user journeys, feature adoption, cohort and retention analysis.
Experience defining success metrics and KPIs, and the judgement to know when a proposed metric will drive the wrong behaviour.
Experience with data visualization and BI tools such as Power BI, QuickSight, Tableau, or similar – including building the semantic/data model behind a dashboard, not just the dashboard itself.
Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (facts, dimensions, grain, slowly changing dimensions) and the ability to reason about whether a data model can answer a given business question.
Hands-on experience using agentic AI coding tools – Claude Code or similar – as part of your day-to-day analytical work: exploring unfamiliar data, writing and debugging queries and transformations, and automating repetitive analysis.
Familiarity with the modern data stack – dbt, cloud data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), AWS services such as S3, Athena, or Glue – and comfort using Git as part of an analytics workflow.
Experience specifying telemetry or instrumentation requirements together with Product and Engineering teams.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain a complex finding simply without losing its rigor. Fluency in English.
Available to travel to our head office in Lausanne on an occasional basis.

Data quality, governance & AI-readiness



Practical experience owning data quality – defining checks and expectations, investigating discrepancies, and distinguishing a genuine business result from a data problem.
Experience with data cataloging, documentation, or data governance practices, and an understanding of why shared definitions matter more than tooling.
Solid understanding of AI/ML and LLM concepts and their implications for data – in particular, why semantic definitions, metric consistency, and data quality determine whether an AI tool gives a trustworthy answer or a plausible wrong one.
Ability to identify where AI can create value in an analytics workflow, and interest in using it to work faster.

How you work



Curious and proactive: you go looking for the insight nobody asked for, and you sanity-check a result against business reality before you present it.
Comfortable with ambiguity – able to turn a vague business question into a well-defined analysis, and to say clearly when the data cannot answer it.
Collaborative: you work as a genuine partner to Product Managers and to your data engineering counterpart rather than as a request queue.
Rigorous and honest about confidence levels, caveats, and the limits of the data.


Additional Information



We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.



With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.



IIf you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:



Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,300 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 18 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.





Job Description

About the role

The Product Intelligence team serves a critical role by providing business intelligence to the organization: we synthesize data sources across the company, delivering product usage and business insights that directly shape product strategy and decision-making.

We are looking for a Data Analytics Lead to own the analytical and semantic layer of Product Intelligence – the person who defines what our data means, makes sure it is trustworthy, and turns it into insight that changes decisions. You will work hand in hand with Product Management and Engineering to define the telemetry we need in order to answer the questions the business is actually asking, establish the success metrics that product and commercial teams are measured against, and proactively investigate product usage and user journeys to surface opportunities PMs would not have found on their own. You will also be the analytical voice in the room with senior leadership, regularly presenting insights and recommendations to senior management.

This is a deliberately broad, high-ownership analytics role rather than a report-building one. You will own data quality, cataloging, and the semantic definitions that make our data AI-ready, and you will partner closely with your data engineering counterpart – defining the business needs and data requirements, and collaborating with them to deliver the pipelines and models that support them.

As a senior individual contributor, you will lead our analytics function, its standards, and its definitions. As Lead you are expected to own the discipline and set its direction, with your influence coming from the quality of your work and your partnerships across Product, Engineering, and the business.

What you’ll do

Insight & analysis

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to translate product usage and telemetry data into product-led insights – identifying upsell opportunities, predicting churn, and supporting revenue targets.
  • Perform proactive, self-directed analysis into product usage and user journeys – funnel and drop-off analysis, feature adoption, cohort and retention behaviour – to help Product Managers understand how the product is really used and where to improve it.
  • Define, document, and own the success metrics used to evaluate product features, releases, and business objectives, and make sure they are consistently understood and applied across teams.
  • Provide regular reporting, insights, and recommendations to senior management, and present them directly to that audience.
  • Manage senior stakeholders across the business, balancing competing analytical priorities from Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance.

Data definition, quality & governance

  • Own the semantic layer: define what our core business entities and metrics mean – customer, account, active user, adoption, churn, expansion – so that a given metric means the same thing everywhere in the company.
  • Champion an AI-ready data strategy by defining the semantics, metric definitions, and metadata that allow AI and LLM-powered tools to query our data reliably and return trustworthy answers.
  • Own data quality for the analytical layer: define quality expectations and checks, monitor for silent correctness failures, and drive issues to resolution with the owning teams before they reach a dashboard or a leadership deck.
  • Build and maintain the data catalog and documentation, so that data consumers across the company can find data, understand its meaning, and know how much to trust it.
  • Establish and maintain data governance practices for the analytics layer – ownership, lineage, definitions, and access – proportionate to a fast-moving team.

Data collection & partnering with Engineering

  • Work with Product Managers and Engineering to define and implement new product telemetry, specifying the events, properties, and grain needed to answer real business questions – and validating that what ships actually answers them.
  • Identify gaps in what we currently collect, and make the case for the instrumentation needed to close them.
  • Define business and data requirements clearly enough to be built, and collaborate with your data engineering counterpart to deliver the pipelines, models, and data structures required to support them.
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of the analytics layer, including semantic modeling and dashboarding within our BI tools.
  • Promote an agile, iterative way of working and actively contribute to team ceremonies.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

Analytics experience

  • Degree in a quantitative, technical, or business-analytical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in a data analyst, product analyst, analytics engineer, or business intelligence role, including experience operating with a high level of autonomy and owning your own analytical agenda.
  • Strong SQL – comfortable working directly in a data warehouse against large, messy, multi-source data without needing someone to prepare it for you.
  • Proven experience partnering with Product and business teams to deliver product-led insights, such as identifying upsell opportunities, predicting churn, or supporting revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting data strategy and insights to executive/C-level audiences.
  • Hands-on experience with product usage or telemetry data – funnels, user journeys, feature adoption, cohort and retention analysis.
  • Experience defining success metrics and KPIs, and the judgement to know when a proposed metric will drive the wrong behaviour.
  • Experience with data visualization and BI tools such as Power BI, QuickSight, Tableau, or similar – including building the semantic/data model behind a dashboard, not just the dashboard itself.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (facts, dimensions, grain, slowly changing dimensions) and the ability to reason about whether a data model can answer a given business question.
  • Hands-on experience using agentic AI coding tools – Claude Code or similar – as part of your day-to-day analytical work: exploring unfamiliar data, writing and debugging queries and transformations, and automating repetitive analysis.
  • Familiarity with the modern data stack – dbt, cloud data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), AWS services such as S3, Athena, or Glue – and comfort using Git as part of an analytics workflow.
  • Experience specifying telemetry or instrumentation requirements together with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain a complex finding simply without losing its rigor. Fluency in English.
  • Available to travel to our head office in Lausanne on an occasional basis.

Data quality, governance & AI-readiness

  • Practical experience owning data quality – defining checks and expectations, investigating discrepancies, and distinguishing a genuine business result from a data problem.
  • Experience with data cataloging, documentation, or data governance practices, and an understanding of why shared definitions matter more than tooling.
  • Solid understanding of AI/ML and LLM concepts and their implications for data – in particular, why semantic definitions, metric consistency, and data quality determine whether an AI tool gives a trustworthy answer or a plausible wrong one.
  • Ability to identify where AI can create value in an analytics workflow, and interest in using it to work faster.

How you work

  • Curious and proactive: you go looking for the insight nobody asked for, and you sanity-check a result against business reality before you present it.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity – able to turn a vague business question into a well-defined analysis, and to say clearly when the data cannot answer it.
  • Collaborative: you work as a genuine partner to Product Managers and to your data engineering counterpart rather than as a request queue.
  • Rigorous and honest about confidence levels, caveats, and the limits of the data.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
As a Senior Data Analyst on our Growth team, you will play a pivotal role in driving our marketing performance to new heights. You will collaborate closely with User Acquisition and Growth partners to analyze data, find opportunities, and deliver actionable insights. Your work will empower strategic business decisions and improve player experiences.

What You'll Do
Partner closely with UA and Growth collaborators to understand performance, investigate business questions, and provide actionable recommendations.
Lead analytical projects end-to-end, from problem definition and data exploration through to insights and collaborator communication.
Own and evolve the business logic and analytical requirements of Growth data models, ensuring they accurately represent how the business measures performance.
Act as a key collaborator with Data Engineering, translating business and analytical needs into clear data requirements and validating delivered solutions.
Proactively identify and investigate data quality issues, inconsistencies, and gaps across Growth reporting and underlying data models.
Build and maintain scalable reporting and analytical solutions, reducing repetitive manual analysis where possible.
Define and maintain key Growth metrics and measurement logic across areas such as spend, acquisition, revenue, attribution, and marketing performance.
Perform deep-dive analyses to understand performance drivers, find opportunities, and support investment decisions.
Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical collaborators, including senior leadership.
Provide technical mentorship and share standard methodologies with other analysts while contributing to consistent analytical standards across the team.
Work closely with Data Scientists on measurement, experimentation, and modeling projects by offering solid analytical and data foundations.


What We're Looking For

We are seeking an ambitious and seasoned Senior Data Analyst with a proven track record of delivering outstanding results. You should have:
4+ years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or a related role.
Strong experience independently delivering analytical projects and working directly with business collaborators.
Experience owning or contributing significantly to analytical data models, metric definitions, or reporting foundations.
Advanced SQL skills and strong experience working with large and complex datasets.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation and analytical workflows.
Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and analytical data structures.
Experience converting business requirements into data requirements and collaborating closely with Data Engineering teams.
Proficiency in a data visualization/BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.
Good understanding of statistical analysis and experimentation.
Familiarity with digital marketing data, attribution, and acquisition metrics is a strong plus.
A strong ownership approach, comfortable independently driving work through to completion.
A curious and analytical nature, always looking to investigate unexpected results and challenge assumptions.
Realistic and dedicated to identifying ways forward.
Strong attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy and reliability.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities in a fast paced business environment.
Strong collaboration skills, capable of working effectively across Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering, and business teams.
Excellent communication skills, able to challenge constructively and build trust with technical and non-technical collaborators.
Willingness to assist in the technical growth of other analysts and help maintain high analytical standards throughout the team.


This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Place: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain
Description:
En BETWEEN te ofrecemos las oportunidades que necesitas para alcanzar tus objetivos profesionales. Si quieres desarrollar tu carrera en IT e Ingeniería, ¡este es tu próximo destino!

Trabajamos con clientes líderes, desarrollando soluciones tecnológicas en Infraestructura, Cloud, Software, Project Management y muchas otras áreas.

Buscamos un/a Senior Data Analyst para incorporarse a un entorno orientado a datos, participando en la recopilación, tratamiento, análisis y visualización de información, así como en la mejora y automatización de procesos analíticos.

Funciones


Recopilar, limpiar y estructurar datos de diferentes fuentes.
Elaborar reporting operativo y ejecutivo y análisis de KPIs.
Crear y mantener dashboards en Power BI, incluyendo DAX y Power Query.
Realizar consultas y transformación de datos mediante SQL.
Desarrollar análisis y automatizaciones con Python (Pandas, NumPy).
Identificar oportunidades de automatización utilizando Power Automate / Power Apps.
Participar en iniciativas de IA y Machine Learning aplicadas al negocio.
Trabajar con equipos de Business, PMO y Tecnología para traducir necesidades en soluciones de datos.


Condiciones


Tendrás horario flexible.
Te integrarás en un equipo internacional.
Trabajarás en modelo híbrido acudiendo 2 días/semana a la oficina de Sant Cugat del Vallès. Buena accesibilidad tanto en transporte público como aparcamiento.
Tendrás un PC y los periféricos necesarios para el desarrollo de tu trabajo.


Beneficios De Trabajar Con Nosotros En BETWEEN

🏥 Seguro médico: cobertura médica privada para empleados.

📚 Formación y desarrollo: acceso a formación a cargo de la empresa.

🤝 Acompañamiento personalizado: apoyo continuo del equipo de Talento y seguimientos mensuales.

💳 Retribución flexible: ventajas fiscales aplicables a restauración, transporte y guardería.

🏋️ Bienestar y actividad física: acceso a la aplicación Wellhub.

💸 Descuentos exclusivos: acceso al Club Inspiring Benefits.

🌐 Networking y comunidad: participación en BETWEEN Nights, torneos deportivos y otros eventos.

🎁 Programa de recomendación: incentivos económicos por referir talento a la compañía.

En BETWEEN, la igualdad de oportunidades es uno de nuestros valores. Nuestro compromiso es contratar al mejor talento independientemente de su raza, religión, sexo, edad y personas con otras capacidades y promover su desarrollo profesional y personal.

Requisitos

Mínimos


Formación en Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Data Analytics, Informática o similar.
Dominio del inglés (avanzado/bilingüe) y español.
5+ años de experiencia en Data Analytics / BI.
Experiencia con:
Power BI, DAX y Power Query
SQL
Excel avanzado
Python (Pandas, NumPy)
Conocimientos básicos de IA / Machine Learning.
Capacidad analítica, atención al detalle y orientación a mejora continua.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.


Valorables


Power Automate / Power Apps.
Microsoft Azure / Fabric, Azure Data Factory o Azure SQL.
Scikit-learn, modelos predictivos o forecasting.
Experiencia con otros entornos cloud (AWS / GCP).

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About BizAway

Here at BizAway, we Deliver the Future of Travel. 😎

We are a solid international company with strong ambitions and great expertise. With a focus on sustainability 🌱, on a daily basis we support companies enabling them to improve their travel management through our constantly evolving services and solutions, always characterized by our tech attitude and smart and innovative processes. 🚀

We know that success comes from People and deserves to be recognized.👫Proactivity and

Reliability, Kind collaboration, and communication are the core values of our Solution Culture.

If you like challenges and would love to be part of one of the fastest-growing B2B scale-ups, then BizAway is the company you have been looking for. 🤩

We are looking for

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d) , who desires to contribute to the growth and success of our Data & Analytics Team.

Your role in BizAway


You tackle complex business problems end to end, translating ambiguous questions into analysis, and analysis into recommendations the business can act on.
You deliver data products rather than one-off reports, reusable models and tools that keep delivering value over time.
You own our semantic layer, the metric definitions, business logic and data models that make sure there is one trusted answer to any business question, for people and for AI.
You own the implementation and evolution of our self-service analytics tools, so internal stakeholders can answer their own recurring questions.
You learn all aspects of the travel industry covering Finance, Product, Sales and Operations perspective, and engage with Business stakeholders to define KPIs, including how data is captured, shared and leveraged across departments.


Your Basic Qualifications


Data analysis, presentation, and visualization experience
Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior non-technical stakeholders
Ability to work autonomously with high ambiguity, alone or in a team as required
Advanced SQL, Python and strong data modeling fundamentals
Experience defining and maintaining shared metric definitions across an organisation
Demonstrated experience with Product Analytics tools (eg: Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, Google Analytics)
Demonstrated experience with BI Data Visualization tools (Qlik preferred)
Master degree in Statistics, Engineering, Economics or a related field is preferred
Previously worked in a Tech Company
English proficiency (written and spoken level B2)


We are also interested in


Understanding of AI/ML concepts
Experience making data available to LLMs or AI agents
Previous experience in the travel industry or similar sectors


Our offer

📄 Contract type: Permanent

🕓 Working hours: Full-time – 40h/week, from Monday to Friday

🏢 Hybrid setting, flexible working policy, and great offices in Europe

💰 Salary: Attractive compensation, including equity in the company

💼 Equity in the company (stock options plan)

✈️ A seat on a scale-up with skyrocketing growth

📈 Development of your entrepreneurial spirit, having the chance to implement real-impact business decision

🌍Multicultural and international team

🙌Collaborative and smart environment to work and learn

🍻Free coffee to kick-start your day and free beers to celebrate together

BizAway avoids any discrimination based on age, gender, sexual orientation, health status, nationality, political opinions, and religious beliefs in all decisions affecting personnel selection.

Title: DATA ANALYST
Description:
About

Joko is an AI shopping app that helps millions of users save time and money when shopping online or in-store. With Juno, our shopping assistant, they can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds.

What sets Joko’s AI apart is how well it knows its users. Its shopping recommendations feel personal from day one and get sharper the more they use it. It draws on unique assets to deliver the best experience: one of the largest product catalogs in the world, and unique shopping data no one else has to personalize every recommendation.

Users can also track the price of their favorite products and earn cash back almost everywhere. All in one free app.

Joko is a tech company founded in Paris. Their team of 120+ talents is international and spread across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, with some working remotely.

As a certified B Corporation, they are committed to making a difference for the communities they serve, including the 6 million consumers already using Joko to save money every day at over 10,000 merchants.

After reaching profitability in their core market, they are expanding internationally with a primary focus on the US.

It’s still day 1 at Joko; come build the future of shopping with us.

Job Description

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

🧚🏻 Our Data team

The Data team at Joko is turning mountains of data into actionable insights for all the teams! The Data team is part of our Operations department led by our COO, and our mission is to empower the company to make informed decisions.

More Specifically, The Team's Responsibilities Are


State-of-the-art analytics & data science: We want to be at the forefront of analytics and data science by building top-notch analyses and tools. Our goal is to allow teams to leverage powerful insights from advanced reporting and predictive models.
AI-driven autonomy for stakeholders: We are doubling down on the combination of AI and data to unlock a new level of autonomy for our stakeholders, seamlessly bridging data insights with the AI tools we use, built on secure and trustworthy foundations.
Spread the data culture: At Joko, we have a strong engineering and tech culture across all teams. We work hand-in-hand with our stakeholders, providing support and training on data tools, and building close relationships to ensure our solutions align perfectly with their operational needs and evolve with them over time.


🎯 What you will do

As a Data Analyst, you will have a cross-functional role and collaborate closely with teams to understand our data and develop insights.


Advanced analytics & data science: You will explore and analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and potential issues that will support decision-making processes across all teams. You will also contribute to data science initiatives by building predictive models and applying statistics to generate deeper insights and drive measurable business impact.
Reporting and Data Visualization: You will design and create dashboards and data visualizations that empower stakeholders to explore data autonomously. Leveraging AI tools to move faster, your focus will be on what matters most: defining the right metrics, surfacing meaningful insights, and ensuring data is understood and acted upon across the company.
AI and data integration: You will actively contribute to bridging our data with the AI tools we use, ensuring insights are integrated and maintained over time.
Stakeholder collaboration: You will work hand-in-hand with stakeholders to understand their needs, collect their feedback, and evangelize data usage to help them make smarter choices and become more autonomous over time.
Continuous Learning and Improvement: As "never stop learning" is one of our values, you will grow along the way and keep up with the latest analytical methods, AI developments, and tools in our data stack.


👀 Who we're looking for


Experience: You have 2+ years of professional experience in data analysis (relevant internships can count). We hire across different seniority levels, so we encourage you to apply even if you are more experienced.
Interest in AI: You are genuinely curious about AI and its applications, and eager to leverage it in your day-to-day work to move faster and create more impact.
Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you are willing to get better every day to reach excellence.
Problem-solving & Analytical skills: You love solving complex problems and analyzing data.
Coding knowledge: Mastering SQL and Python is not mandatory, as you can still learn when joining, but it's a plus.
Business acumen: You can understand the needs of your business stakeholders and get the big picture of how the business is running.
Communication: You know how to present your conclusions clearly and concisely (written and oral).
Education: You have graduated from a top-tier business or engineering school.
Languages: You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.


💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:


Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.
Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.


On Top Of That, We Offer Plenty Of Perks


💸 Top-market compensation
📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build
🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills
🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings
💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription
🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent
…and much more, check the full list here!


🤝 Our hiring process


Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.
Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).
Step 2 – Role-specific assessments
For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).
For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).
Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.
References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Additional Information


Contract Type: Full-Time
Location: Paris, Barcelona
Possible full remote
Salary: between 48000€ and 84000€ / year

You will also contribute to data science initiatives by building predictive models and applying statistics to generate deeper insights and drive measurable business impact.
  • Reporting and Data Visualization: You will design and create dashboards and data visualizations that empower stakeholders to explore data autonomously. Leveraging AI tools to move faster, your focus will be on what matters most: defining the right metrics, surfacing meaningful insights, and ensuring data is understood and acted upon across the company.
  • AI and data integration: You will actively contribute to bridging our data with the AI tools we use, ensuring insights are integrated and maintained over time.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: You will work hand-in-hand with stakeholders to understand their needs, collect their feedback, and evangelize data usage to help them make smarter choices and become more autonomous over time.
  • Continuous Learning and Improvement: As "never stop learning" is one of our values, you will grow along the way and keep up with the latest analytical methods, AI developments, and tools in our data stack.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 2+ years of professional experience in data analysis (relevant internships can count). We hire across different seniority levels, so we encourage you to apply even if you are more experienced.
  • Interest in AI: You are genuinely curious about AI and its applications, and eager to leverage it in your day-to-day work to move faster and create more impact.
  • Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you are willing to get better every day to reach excellence.
  • Problem-solving & Analytical skills: You love solving complex problems and analyzing data.
  • Coding knowledge: Mastering SQL and Python is not mandatory, as you can still learn when joining, but it's a plus.
  • Business acumen: You can understand the needs of your business stakeholders and get the big picture of how the business is running.
  • Communication: You know how to present your conclusions clearly and concisely (written and oral).
  • Education: You have graduated from a top-tier business or engineering school.
  • Languages: You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.
  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On Top Of That, We Offer Plenty Of Perks

  • 💸 Top-market compensation
  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build
  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills
  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings
  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription
  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent
  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  • Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.
  • Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).
  • Step 2 – Role-specific assessments
    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).
    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).
  • Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.
  • References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.
☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Additional Information

  • Contract Type: Full-Time
  • Location: Paris, Barcelona
  • Possible full remote
  • Salary: between 48000€ and 84000€ / year

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
1. Propósito del Puesto (Misión)

Garantizar la explotación estratégica de la información y la evolución del entorno de datos en Netquest, identificando oportunidades de mejora, desarrollando herramientas analíticas y siendo una pieza técnica clave para la toma de decisiones basadas en datos.




2. Responsabilidades Principales

Interpretar datos e indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPI) para ayudar a la empresa a maximizar el valor de la información.
Colaborar con diferentes áreas de negocio para definir y priorizar necesidades de información.
Proporcionar soluciones de informes y herramientas de BI para partes interesadas internas y externas.
Desarrollar y mantener cuadros de mando (dashboards) en herramientas de BI (ej. Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau).
Manipular datos y realizar análisis ad-hoc utilizando Python y consultas avanzadas en SQL.
Identificar, analizar e interpretar patrones y tendencias en grandes volúmenes de datos (millones de registros).
Monitorizar fuentes de datos y colaborar con Data Engineers para resolver inconsistencias y garantizar las políticas de calidad.
Trabajar de manera colaborativa dentro del área de Datos con Data Scientists, Data Engineers y otros analistas.




3. Relaciones Clave (Interfaces)

Internas: Equipo de Datos (Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics) y responsables de diversas áreas de negocio.
Externas: Clientes y colaboradores externos receptores de herramientas de análisis o informes ad-hoc.




4. Requisitos del Perfil

Formación y Experiencia:
Educación: Grado Universitario en Ingeniería, Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, Informática o campo cuantitativo similar.
Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años de experiencia previa desempeñando funciones como Data Analyst.
Conocimientos Técnicos e Idiomas:
Dominio de Python (librerías como pandas, polars, numpy, matplotlib, ggplot, seaborn).
Sólidos conocimientos y optimización en SQL.
Experiencia en herramientas de Business Intelligence (Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI).
Idiomas: Fluidez en inglés (comunicación verbal y escrita clara).
Valorables: Experiencia en servicios Cloud (especialmente AWS) y herramientas de gestión de datos como dbt.
Competencias Y Habilidades:
Excelente pensamiento analítico y capacidad para la resolución de problemas.
Habilidades de storytelling para comunicar hallazgos complejos de forma sencilla.
Trabajo en equipo, adaptabilidad y enfoque orientado a la calidad de los datos.




5. Qué Ofrecemos

Ubicación: Barcelona
Modelo de trabajo: Híbrido (2 días en la oficina y 3 días de teletrabajo)
Beneficios sociales:
Contrato indefinido.
Seguro médico privado con cuadro médico o reembolso (50% cubierto para el empleado).
Plan de retribución flexible: vales de comida (tickets restaurante), transporte y guardería.
Horario flexible (entrada de 8:00 a 10:00, salida de 17:00 a 19:00) y viernes de jornada intensiva.




6. Igualdad de Oportunidades

En Netquest, nos enorgullece ser una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y tenemos el compromiso de crear un entorno inclusivo para todos nuestros empleados, independientemente de su género, edad, origen, nacionalidad, raza, religión, orientación sexual o discapacidad.

Ensure the strategic exploitation of information and the evolution of Netquest's data ecosystem, identifying improvement opportunities, developing analytical tools, and serving as a key technical contributor for data-driven decision-making.

Partner with various business units to define and prioritize reporting and data needs.

Work collaboratively with the broader Data team (Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and fellow Data Analysts).

External: External clients or partners receiving analytical tools and ad-hoc reporting.

Strong storytelling skills to effectively present insights.
Team player with high attention to detail and a commitment to data quality.

Workplace Model: Hybrid model (2 days in the office, 3 days working from home)

Permanent contract.

Flexible working hours (start between 8:00–10:00 AM, finish between 5:00–7:00 PM) and intensive workdays on Fridays.
