Title: Data & Insight Analyst Mid
Description:
A Housfy busquem un/a Data Analyst que ens ajudi a convertir les dades en decisions estratègiques, millorant l'experiència dels nostres clients i impulsant el creixement del negoci.




Volem incorporar algú que aporti insight, doni suport en la presa de decisions estratègiques i contribueixi a generar un impacte real en el negoci. A més, l'equip de Data és al capdavant de la implementació d'automatitzacions basades en IA a tota la companyia, de manera que tindràs un paper clau en aquesta transformació.




Què esperem de tu?

Col·laborar amb equips clau del negoci (Màrqueting, Operacions i Producte) per entendre els seus reptes i proporcionar dades i insights que ajudin a obtenir millors resultats.
Treballar de manera autònoma, amb una actitud proactiva i orientada a l'acció, identificant oportunitats i afrontant nous reptes.
Donar suport a la implementació d'automatitzacions basades en intel·ligència artificial per reduir processos manuals i millorar l'eficiència.
Impulsar i optimitzar l'estratègia de cross-selling de la companyia, transformant les dades en audiències accionables.
Analitzar el funnel de conversió i ajudar els equips a prendre decisions basades en dades.
Participar en l'evolució i el desenvolupament de la nostra infraestructura de dades i de les eines de visualització.
Transformar preguntes de negoci i hipòtesis en insights accionables que contribueixin al creixement de Housfy.




Què busquem?

Mínim 3 anys d'experiència com a Data Analyst o en una posició similar.
Domini d'SQL per consultar i analitzar grans volums de dades.
Coneixements en automatització de processos i aplicació d'intel·ligència artificial per millorar l'eficiència (es valorarà molt positivament).
Experiència avançada amb eines de visualització de dades.
Capacitat per entendre les necessitats del negoci i comunicar informació complexa de manera clara a perfils tant tècnics com no tècnics.
Nivell professional de català, castellà i anglès.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About the role:

We are looking for a responsible and hard-working Senior Data Analyst to join our efforts in taking over the print-on-demand industry. You would work in an international environment with talented teammates in a casual atmosphere. You’ll have your hands on very rich and diverse data related to the print-on-demand universe.

Your daily tasks will include:


Acting as a go-to data person within your respective team
Engaging in product analytics, ops analytics and business analytics
Continuously improving your team's product features with suggestions from ad-hoc and regular data analysis
Analyzing internal, market, and customer levels of data regarding various business areas
Translating data into actionable insights


You’ll level up fast by building production-grade analytics with state-of-the-art tools—Snowflake Intelligence, Streamlit in Snowflake, Amplitude, and more—gaining real ownership, mentorship, and impact at scale. In collaboration with our data engineers, you will define data models and ensure data quality through rigorous QA processes. You will work with Looker's analytical layer, defining explores, measures, and dimensions to support robust data exploration.

Your qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, physics, economics or a related quantitative field required
Strong written & verbal English communication skills
At least 4 years of professional experience in data analysis
Demonstrated ability to present and clearly articulate summarized data analysis results
Advanced SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or similar data warehouses
Proficiency in Excel usage for data analysis
Hands-on experience with BI tools to create interactive dashboards and visualizations (Looker is a plus)
Solid understanding of data modeling and data quality principles
Hands-on experience with event tracking and product analytics tools (Amplitude is a plus)
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and causal inference


What we offer:


A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done
An opportunity to work remotely
Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 10 AM)
Private health insurance
2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being
1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice
Learning Budget to support your professional development.
Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online
Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!
Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team.

You would work in an international environment with talented teammates in a casual atmosphere. You’ll have your hands on very rich and diverse data related to the print-on-demand universe.

Your daily tasks will include:

  • Acting as a go-to data person within your respective team
  • Engaging in product analytics, ops analytics and business analytics
  • Continuously improving your team's product features with suggestions from ad-hoc and regular data analysis
  • Analyzing internal, market, and customer levels of data regarding various business areas
  • Translating data into actionable insights

You’ll level up fast by building production-grade analytics with state-of-the-art tools—Snowflake Intelligence, Streamlit in Snowflake, Amplitude, and more—gaining real ownership, mentorship, and impact at scale. In collaboration with our data engineers, you will define data models and ensure data quality through rigorous QA processes. You will work with Looker's analytical layer, defining explores, measures, and dimensions to support robust data exploration.

Your qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, physics, economics or a related quantitative field required
  • Strong written & verbal English communication skills
  • At least 4 years of professional experience in data analysis
  • Demonstrated ability to present and clearly articulate summarized data analysis results
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or similar data warehouses
  • Proficiency in Excel usage for data analysis
  • Hands-on experience with BI tools to create interactive dashboards and visualizations (Looker is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of data modeling and data quality principles
  • Hands-on experience with event tracking and product analytics tools (Amplitude is a plus)
  • Hands-on experience with A/B testing and causal inference

What we offer:

  • A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done
  • An opportunity to work remotely
  • Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 10 AM)
  • Private health insurance
  • 2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being
  • 1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice
  • Learning Budget to support your professional development.
  • Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online
  • Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!
  • Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount

FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Thunes

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments globally. Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Miami, Johannesburg, Riyadh, San Francisco and Atlanta For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

Context of the role

We are looking for a driven and product-minded BI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in solving real business problems through data.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decision-making across the business. You will help identify product and operational pain points, improve day-to-day insight consumption for internal teams, and contribute to a strong data informed culture across the company.

You will work closely with data engineers to design, build, and maintain analytical solutions for key internal stakeholders across different functions, that improves our productivity, business performance, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
Build a strong understanding of key business processes, product flows, operational challenges, and performance metrics.
Design, develop, and maintain production-grade dashboards, reports, and analytical assets using Tableau and other relevant tools.
Write production-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery.
Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure data sources are reliable, well-structured, and fit for analytical use.
Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team.
Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities.



Professional Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.
2-5 years of experience in a data, BI, analytics, or related role.
Strong hands-on experience writing production-level SQL.
Strong hands-on experience using Python for analysis, data processing, and analytical solution development.
Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management.
Proven ability to work with complex datasets and turn business questions into structured, actionable analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from stakeholder requests to practical data solutions.
Good understanding of reporting design, data visualisation best practices, and how to present insights clearly for business users.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.
Experience supporting multiple business functions and balancing different stakeholder needs in a structured way.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to gather requirements, align expectations, and communicate clearly throughout delivery.
Demonstrated business curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding how the business works beyond the data itself.
Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to work independently and follow through from problem understanding to solution delivery.



Sound like you? Apply now!

Formación en Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Data Analytics, Informática o similar.
Dominio del inglés (avanzado/bilingüe) y español.
+2 años de experiencia en Data Analytics / BI.

Power BI, DAX y Power Query

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Ogury

Ogury is a global adtech company powered by Persona Intelligence, its proprietary technology that enables brands and agencies to activate consistent persona-based strategies across channels and drive measurable brand outcomes.

Founded in 2014, Ogury operates in 18 countries with over 400 employees worldwide.

At Ogury, our vision unites us all . But we know that it takes people from all walks of life to come together and make it happen. We embrace and celebrate what makes us different , creating a unique and winning culture where everyone feels safe , has access to the same opportunities , and is excited about bringing their most authentic self to work. Everyday.

Together we’re changing the face of adtech with values that inspire excellence, standards that encourage a leadership mindset, and an inclusive workplace where Ogurians are engaged and know they belong .

Working at Ogury

At Ogury , we pledge to provide all our team members with an equitable voice across our company and community. We understand that to have Ogurians who are engaged, respected , and who feel proud to belong, means creating a safe space where everyone feels comfortable bringing their most authentic selves to work. Everyday.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior Data Analyst to specialize in our advertising platform reporting and analytics. In this role, you will bridge the gap between data and execution, supporting our Product and Client Services teams by building scalable, automated reporting solutions.

As a key member of our Global Analytics Team, you will look beyond daily reporting to champion data governance, data quality, and scalable data modeling. You will collaborate closely with Data Reporting and Platform Engineering teams, utilizing dbt to build robust, reliable data models that serve as the foundation for global business decisions.

Why you'll love this role


Build systems that scale — Design and own automated reporting solutions that serve the entire organization; move beyond ad-hoc analysis to engineer production-grade data models with dbt that become the trusted foundation for critical business decisions
Work with a modern analytics stack — Partner with top-tier data infrastructure (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse) and best-in-class tools; solve complex optimization problems with large-scale clickstream and transactional datasets while championing data governance standards across a global team
Drive impact across the business — Act as the analytical bridge between Product, Client Services, and Platform Engineering; translate your insights into tangible outcomes that optimize ad revenue, improve user experience, and directly influence how the platform evolves


What You Will Be Doing


Ad Platform Reporting & Scalability: Design, develop, and scale automated dashboards and analytics solutions that provide deep insights into ad platform performance, campaign delivery, and user engagement for both Product and Client Services teams.
Global Data Governance & Quality: Serve as a core member of the Global Analytics team, leading initiatives to define data standards, enforce data quality checks, and document data lineages to ensure a trusted, single source of truth.
Data Modeling with dbt: Partner with Data Reporting and Platform teams to build, maintain, and optimize production-grade data models using dbt, ensuring efficient transformations and analytics-ready datasets.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the analytical partner to Product Managers (to guide feature development) and Client Services (to provide scalable client-facing insights and automate ad-hoc requests).
Advanced Analytics & Insights: Go beyond standard metrics to uncover trends, identify platform inefficiencies, and provide actionable recommendations that optimize ad revenue and user experience.


What You Will Bring To Ogury


Experience: 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Analytics Engineering, ideally within an AdTech
Data Modeling & dbt: Proven hands-on experience using dbt to develop, test, and deploy scalable data models in a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse).
SQL Mastery: Expert-level SQL skills, including writing highly optimized, complex queries and managing large-scale, clickstream, or transactional datasets.
Scalable BI & Visualization: Advanced proficiency in building scalable, intuitive dashboards in modern BI tools (e.g.Omni, Tableau, Looker, Power BI) tailored for both internal product tracking and external client services.
Data Governance Focus: Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, data governance principles, and version control (Git).
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of translating complex technical metrics into scalable solutions for product teams and business clients.


How Ogury Supports You

At Ogury, we believe in taking care of our team members and providing a work environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.

While benefits may vary by location, here’s a glimpse of what you can typically expect when you join our team:


A competitive compensation package
Comprehensive benefits coverage
Meal voucher
Holiday and leave allowance, in addition to national holidays
A strong focus on the well-being of our team members, with access to both physical and mental health resources
Flexible Working Model: At Ogury, we believe in the power of presence to fuel innovation. Our hybrid approach is centered on two core in-office collaboration days to drive team synergy, plus one additional office day of your choosing to support personal balance. This 3-day baseline ensures strong connection and real-time problem-solving, while allowing for flexibility across the rest of the week.
And more


We thank you in advance for your interest in Ogury!

Our Commitment

At Ogury, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace by providing equal employment opportunities to all. We will consider all qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive candidate experience. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please contact us. In accordance with applicable laws, we will work with you to provide reasonable support and ensure a fair hiring process.

Please note that this position is for an existing vacancy and is open to all qualified candidates.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

THE WORLD OF UBISOFT

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

Job Description

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.



Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.*



Your daily adventure:

devicenow offers Device as a Service for workplace IT hardware on a global scale. We revolutionize the Device as a Service industry – the only thing missing is you!

Title: Data Analyst Demand Planning
Description:
Job Summary

Are you passionate about transforming data into actionable insights that improve planning performance and drive better business decisions?

We are looking for a Data Analyst – Demand Planning to support our global planning organization through advanced analytics, performance reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives. In this role, you will partner with Demand Planning, Commercial, Supply Planning, Finance, Information Technology, and external stakeholders to deliver meaningful insights that enhance forecast accuracy, business performance, and planning maturity. The position supports a fully remote working model and offers the opportunity to contribute to global transformation and data-driven decision-making initiatives.

Job Description

Global Operations

Ensuring excellence in execution across the value chain through operational effectiveness, supply chain performance, quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Team Description

You will join a collaborative, analytical, and globally connected planning organization focused on enabling smarter business decisions through data, insights, and performance management. The team partners across regions, functions, and business units to improve planning outcomes, strengthen forecasting capabilities, and support business growth through fact-based decision-making.

Where You'll Make a Difference


Monitor and analyze demand planning performance indicators, including Forecast Accuracy, Forecast Bias, Forecast Value Add, and other planning metrics.
Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, reports, and performance monitoring solutions that support business reviews and decision-making.
Perform root cause analysis on forecast deviations, planning gaps, and operational performance issues to identify improvement opportunities.
Analyze demand patterns, customer trends, product performance, and key business drivers to generate actionable insights.
Consolidate and validate data from multiple sources while ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of planning information.
Support monthly Demand Review and business review processes through data-driven recommendations and performance reporting.
Partner with planners, commercial teams, finance, supply planning, and technology stakeholders on reporting, analytics, and planning initiatives.
Contribute to planning transformations, new capability deployments, process improvements, testing activities, and business adoption efforts.
Document reporting methodologies, key performance indicator definitions, governance standards, and analytical processes.


What Makes You The Right Fit


Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related analytical discipline.
Experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, or a related field.
Strong experience working with large datasets, reporting solutions, and performance measurement frameworks.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Experience using Power BI or similar business intelligence and data visualization tools.
Knowledge of data analysis, dashboard development, reporting automation, and performance management.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex insights for diverse stakeholders.
Fluent written and verbal English communication skills.


How Would You Stand Out


Experience with SAP Integrated Business Planning (SAP IBP) Demand Planning.
Knowledge of Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), and Demand Review processes.
Experience with SQL and advanced data querying techniques.
Familiarity with forecasting performance metrics, including Forecast Accuracy, Forecast Bias, and Forecast Value Add.
Experience within global, matrixed organizations supporting cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience supporting OTC Scent & Taste and/or PWB business processes.
Knowledge of MyBIS reporting environments, analytics solutions, and planning data structures.


Why Choose Us

At IFF, your work helps transform complex data into meaningful business outcomes. We value curiosity, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning, creating an environment where analytical professionals can make a visible impact on global operations.

What We Offer


Fully remote work environment.
Opportunities to collaborate with global teams and stakeholders.
Exposure to planning transformation and digital improvement initiatives.
Continuous learning, training, and professional development opportunities.
Inclusive and collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives.
The opportunity to help shape a more data-driven planning organization

Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.


Nice-to-have:


Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.


Eres la persona que buscamos si...


Eres una persona proactiva y con mentalidad de ownership: no esperas a que te digan qué construir, identificas dónde falta gobierno de dato y lo propones.
Estás cómod@ operando con ambigüedad: el rol y las herramientas van a seguir evolucionando mientras el equipo global centraliza más tooling
Eres alguien entrepreneurial: te motiva construir algo desde una base poco estructurada, no solo mantener un sistema ya hecho


Información adicional

💶 Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.

🤝 Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.

⚕️ Seguro médico privado.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.

📚 Clases de idiomas gratuitas.

🧠 Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.

🏠 Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

🔎 Nuestro proceso de selección 🔎

✅ Primer match – Una charla con Alejandro (TAP).

📚 Prueba técnica - Para entender bien tus conocimientos básicos del rol.

💡 Conversación estratégica – Intro call con Elias, tu próximo manager.

👉 Presentación de un Business Case - Con Elias.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations Analytics | €47K - €60K
Description:
A platform we collaborate with at Joppy is looking to hire a Senior Data Analyst to partner with Operations and Product teams, turning complex business challenges into clear analysis and strategic recommendations that improve customer experience.




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Operations Analytics team in Barcelona. You will partner closely with Rover’s Operations org, driving initiatives and supporting analytics towards furthering customer experience. This is a high-visibility role involving direct collaboration with a diverse set of stakeholders to define, measure, test and improve the success of customer experience programs and product developments. A key component of this position will be providing product analytics support for our Bookings Confidence team, which aims to tackle customer service improvements through product developments.




The ideal candidate is a passionate problem-solver who comfortably translates ambiguous business challenges into clear questions, deep analysis, and strategic recommendations that drive action.




You’ll be joining an international team, reporting to a Barcelona based Analytics manager, with colleagues and stakeholders split between Barcelona and Seattle. This is a hybrid role: we're in our Poblenou office two days a week (Mondays and Thursdays), so you'll need to be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.







Your Responsibilities:

Thought Partnership: Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, making data-driven recommendations on optimization strategies within customer experience.
Experimentation: Partner with Product Managers, designers and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments in support of product developments.
Strategic Planning & Measurement: Partner with Ops Program leadership to define the strategy for measuring program health and operational performance, including establishing comprehensive metrics, developing crisp reporting, and setting up monitoring rhythms.
Performance Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of key CX (Customer Experience) operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities, which will inform deeper research and analytical efforts.
Executive Communication: Develop and present crisp narratives resulting from analytics findings and investigations to senior Operations leaders, focusing on both identified problems and proposed solutions.
Data Infrastructure Support: Support the construction and maintenance of our core reporting abstractions (built in dbt), BI reporting and AI semantic layers




What we're looking for (must-haves):




At least 4 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
You are extremely comfortable with receiving stakeholder questions and independently translating them into clear, actionable analytical problems to solve, all with relative autonomy.
You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists




Nice to Have:




Master’s degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
Ability to code in Python/R
Hands on experience leveraging AI tools for analytics
Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
Hands-on experience in workforce forecasting




Compensation:




In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €47,124 - €60,319. Additionally, we offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees.

The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking a Senior Product Data Analyst to join our Experiments & Insights team in Barcelona (hybrid) to help different teams across the organization to succeed in their mission by providing insights generation and data analysis support in a healthy data-informed environment. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.


We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts



Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. Our Experiments and Insights team is the centre of excellence for Online (AB) Experimentation and for providing best practices to generate insights and learning from and for the experiments.

In this role, you would be performing as a product data analyst (tasks are described below) to support a set of product teams, but you will be also part of the next experimentation generation at eDreams Odigeo. The team is constantly investigating best in class methodologies and processes to implement in our business/analysis and tests, which means you will be required to apply your mathematical knowledge in some strategic projects that are focused on taking more accurate decisions maintaining a strong statistical confidence level. Your will be working with multi-disciplinary teams - Qualitative Researchers, Designers, Product Owners, Developers, and Pricing Managers - to blend different statistical and data analytics techniques to generate a holistic understanding of the users and markets.

As a Product Data Analyst inside the team, you will be in charge of:


Analyse performance and identify behaviours in our different websites and interfaces related to our products;
Analyse performance and user behaviours in the A/B Tests experiments or Pre-Post run by the product teams;
Help the product teams to generate their testing hypotheses by providing exploratory analysis about our products, past tests, etc,
Data cleaning and validation,
Definition of new tracking that will all mostly be added in Google Analytics (to be able to answer different kinds of research/product questions);
Build and maintain dashboards (mostly using LookerStudio) and/or reports (mostly in Google Sheets) to share performance information with senior management and C-level stakeholders;
Lead data-driven initiatives to improve company decision making and business knowledge;
Responsible for one or more team’s projects such as the investigation and implementation of new methodologies, new data analysis techniques or the usage of new tools;
Collaborate with user researchers and designers to detect gaps in knowledge about our user; identify research opportunities to fill those gaps.
NOTE: Data you will be using could come from Google Analytics API or Google Analytics tables in BigQuery, other sources of data stored in BigQuery such as internal databases, customer service database, etc., as well as our data stored and accessible in Microstrategy.



What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline is a requirement (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, etc.),
Minimum of 6 years experience in a role with strong analytical component,
Previous experience in user behavior analysis (product performance) using data from any of the following: Google
Analytics/Adobe Analytics/Mix Panel/ Amplitude/Matomo.
Strong knowledge of the math and statistical concepts behind A/B testing,
Strong knowledge of SQL is a requirement, as well as experience in working with databases and large sets of data,
Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with the Google toolset (spreadsheets, google docs, etc),
Knowledge of visualisation tools like LookerStudio, Tableau, Looker or Qlikview,
Business Proficiency in English,
A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!



It would be a plus if you have:


R or Python programming skills (mostly for data extraction and data manipulation),
Google Analytics knowledge (as well as Google Analytics API, googleAnalyticsR library for R, GA4, etc.),
Previous experience in programming,
Knowledge on data structure and data sets management in Google Cloud Platform.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.



What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.

Title: Data Analyst (CRM)
Description:
We are looking for Data Analyst (CRM), to join our team in Barcelona.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What Will You Do

The CRM Analyst is the measurement and intelligence engine of the central CRM organization. Operating across all game titles, this person pulls, verifies, and reports on campaign performance; tracks trends; and ensures experimentation is structured to produce reliable, actionable results. Critically, they look beyond individual game performance to surface portfolio-wide segment insights - understanding how key player cohorts like VIPs, regular customers, new players, and conversion targets perform across the full game catalog.

Campaign Reporting & Performance


Pull and verify campaign data from the CRM platform and downstream analytics systems, reconciling any discrepancies
Produce regular campaign performance reports for each game team and portfolio-level summaries for the Director of CRM
Track trends over time — open rates, click rates, conversion, retention impact — and flag anomalies or degradation
Create and maintain dashboards that give CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs visibility into the performance of their communication programs


Experimentation Design & Governance


Support CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs in designing A/B and multivariate tests, ensuring appropriate sample sizes, holdout groups, and clean control conditions
Maintain an experimentation log across all games to prevent conflicting tests and ensure results can be interpreted confidently
Review proposed experiments for methodological soundness before launch
Analyze and present experiment results with clear, actionable recommendations


Cross-Portfolio Segment Insights


Define and maintain segment definitions across the portfolio (e.g., VIP, Regular Customer, New Player, Lapsed, Conversion Candidate)
Track how these segments behave and respond to CRM across multiple titles, identifying patterns and outliers
Produce regular cross-game segment reports that help the Director of CRM and game teams understand what works universally versus what is title-specific
Identify high-value segment opportunities that are underserved by current campaigns


Data Integrity & Targeting Validation


Validate that targeting attributes used in campaigns are correctly populated and reliably representing the intended audience
Partner with Data Engineering to surface data quality issues and advocate for fixes
Verify that audience sizes match expectations prior to campaign launch


What We’re Looking For


4+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or a related data role - ideally in a behavior-based vs transactional environment - like gaming or live services.
Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent)
Experience working with CRM or marketing automation platforms to extract and interpret campaign data
Experience with both performance data and attribution data and able to ensure appropriate tracking is in place.
Ability to represent data needs to engineers if necessary data options are not available.
Understanding of A/Bn testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design across a complex set of overlapping campaigns.
Ability to communicate data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience in games, apps, or a retention-driven consumer product is a strong plus
Comfortable managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously across different game teams
Experience in gaming as a player or operations manager preferred.


Technical Skills


SQL (required)
Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions, pivot tables)
BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, etc.)
Familiarity with event tracking tools (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
Basic understanding of data pipelines and data quality checks


About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Title: Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst
Description:
Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection.

With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.

We are seeking a skilled and business-minded Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team in Barcelona. This is a business-facing role, not a pure IT development position, that combines strong technical Power BI expertise with commercial acumen and the ability to act as a true BI business partner. The Power BI Developer designs, builds, and maintains datasets, data models, and dashboards while working directly with functions across the business to understand their needs, challenge their requirements, and propose better ways to analyze data and measure performance. The role requires a solid understanding of the company’s core KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance, but not limited to these; and the ability to translate business questions into clear, decision-oriented analytics. This position partners with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and other functions, turning data into actionable insight.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain Power BI datasets, semantic data models, reports, and dashboards using DAX and Power Query (M)
Develop, optimize, and document robust data models, ensuring performance, scalability, and a reliable single source of truth
Partner with business functions to gather, challenge, and refine reporting requirements, proposing better KPIs and smarter ways to analyze the data
Act as a BI business partner, running working sessions with stakeholders across functions to understand their priorities and translate them into analytical solutions
Define, standardize, and monitor core business KPIs (sales, margin, corporate finance, and beyond), ensuring consistency and a shared definition across reporting
Turn business questions into executive-ready dashboards and self-service analytics that drive decision making
Perform ad-hoc and deep-dive analysis, identifying trends, root causes, and opportunities, and surfacing actionable insights
Promote data literacy and the adoption of self-service analytics across the organization


Qualifications


Strong hands-on expertise in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query (M), dataset and data model design, and report/dashboard development
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure, interpret, and communicate complex data
Solid understanding of core business KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance
Strong business acumen, with the ability to engage, challenge, and advise stakeholders across different functions — this is a hybrid business-and-technical role, not a pure IT developer position
Proven experience in a similar BI / analytics role (~3 years)
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders and lead requirement-gathering discussions
Proficiency in Excel
Experience in data modeling, data analysis, and data visualization
Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken)
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to work independently and manage multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously
Based in, or willing to relocate to, Barcelona


You will be joining a highly motivated and skilled team, providing a great environment to learn and grow. If you love working with data, building insights, and partnering with the business to drive better decisions, this is the position for you. We value a proactive approach and encourage continuous learning and development, ensuring that you will have ample opportunities to enhance your skills and contribute to our success.

Arxada has world class offerings in two distinct areas:

Microbial Control Solutions (MCS) focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home & Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints & Coatings and Material Protection.

Nutrition, Care & Environmental (NCE), meanwhile, provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high-performance applications.

Arxada is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations Analytics
Description:
Who we are:
At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

About The Role
We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Operations Analytics team in Barcelona. You will partner closely with Rover’s Operations org, driving initiatives and supporting analytics towards furthering Rover’s customer experience. This is a high-visibility role involving direct collaboration with a diverse set of stakeholders to define, measure, test and improve the success of customer experience programs and product developments. A key component of this position will be providing product analytics support for our Bookings Confidence team, which aims to tackle customer service improvements through product developments.

The ideal candidate is a passionate problem-solver who comfortably translates ambiguous business challenges into clear questions, deep analysis, and strategic recommendations that drive action.

You’ll be joining an international team, reporting to a Barcelona based Analytics manager, with colleagues and stakeholders split between Barcelona and Seattle. This is a hybrid role: we're in our Poblenou office two days a week (Mondays and Thursdays), so you'll need to be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

Your Responsibilities:


Thought Partnership: Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, making data-driven recommendations on optimization strategies within customer experience
Experimentation: Partner with Product Managers, designers and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments in support of product developments.
Strategic Planning & Measurement: Partner with Ops Program leadership to define the strategy for measuring program health and operational performance, including establishing comprehensive metrics, developing crisp reporting, and setting up monitoring rhythms.
Performance Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of key CX (Customer Experience) operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities, which will inform deeper research and analytical efforts.
Executive Communication: Develop and present crisp narratives resulting from analytics findings and investigations to senior Operations leaders, focusing on both identified problems and proposed solutions.
Data Infrastructure Support: Support the construction and maintenance of our core reporting abstractions (built in dbt), BI reporting and AI semantic layers




What we're looking for (must-haves):


At least 4 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
You are extremely comfortable with receiving stakeholder questions and independently translating them into clear, actionable analytical problems to solve, all with relative autonomy.
You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists




Nice to Have:


Master’s degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
Ability to code in Python/R
Hands on experience leveraging AI tools for analytics
Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
Hands-on experience in workforce forecasting




Compensation:


In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €47,124 - €60,319. Additionally, Rover offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees
The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process




Benefits of Working at Rover.com:


Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout
Pension plan
Private medical insurance
25 days PTO
Meal allowance and flexible compensation plan (transport and nursery)
Gym membership
€450 to cover the costs associated with the adoption of a pet
Annual €150 wellness reimbursement
Flexible work hours, sometimes you'll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we're pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
Regular team activities, events, game nights, and more
Dog-friendly office




Rover is an equal-opportunity employer committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive, and inventive environment with the best employees. We’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, and we work to ensure everyone contributes to their fullest potential. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, protected veteran status, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - FP&A
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team

The Business & Strategy Analytics team's mission is to transform data into strategic insights that empower our leaders to make informed decisions, effectively track progress, and unlock growth opportunities. Through deep metric understanding, holistic business views, and detailed analytics, we enable concrete actions that drive business success.

Working closely with the Director of FP&A, CFO, and senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Data, you’ll support strategic planning, fundraising, and Preply’s journey toward IPO through rigorous, business-focused analytics.

What you’ll be doing


Partner with the FP&A team to provide analytical insights that shape strategic planning, forecasting, and company performance.
Deliver executive-ready analyses and presentations that support leadership decision-making, fundraising activities, and Preply’s roadmap toward IPO.
Lead end-to-end analytical initiatives, translating ambiguous business questions into executive-ready recommendations and measurable business impact.
Develop forecasting models, scenario analyses, driver-based models, and opportunity sizing to evaluate strategic decisions and quantify financial impact.
Connect Product, Marketing, and Operational initiatives with business performance, identifying the key drivers behind revenue, profitability, and efficiency.
Conduct deep dives into business performance to uncover growth opportunities, operational improvements, and emerging risks.
Partner across Finance, Product, Marketing, Operations, and the Data Chapter to establish a trusted, consistent view of business performance and key metrics.
Continuously improve analytical frameworks, business metrics, and decision-support models that enable scalable, data-informed decision making.


What You Need To Succeed


5+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Growth Analytics, Financial Analytics, or a similar analytical role.
Strong SQL skills and confidence independently working with large, complex datasets.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence VP and C-level stakeholders.
Strong analytical and critical thinking, with the ability to simplify complex business problems into actionable insights.
Proven experience building forecasting models, scenario analyses, financial impact models, and driver-based analyses.
Experience leading cross-functional analytical initiatives from problem definition through implementation.
Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
A proactive, curious mindset with strong business intuition and a focus on pragmatic problem solving.
Familiarity with AI tools that improve analytical productivity and decision-making.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets modeling skills.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.


Nice to have


Experience partnering closely with FP&A or Corporate Finance teams.
Experience in fast-growing technology companies, marketplaces, SaaS, or subscription businesses.
Comfortable working with P&L statements and financial performance analysis.
Familiarity with key business and marketplace metrics such as LTV, CAC, payback period, retention, and ARPU.
Background in strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, or venture capital.
Experience with Snowflake and Looker.


Why you’ll love it at Preply


Help shape Preply’s next stage of growth, supporting strategic planning, fundraising, and our journey toward IPO.
Work directly with our Director of FP&A, CFO, and senior leaders on company-wide strategic priorities.
Own high-impact analytical initiatives spanning Finance, Product, Marketing, and Operations.
Influence executive decisions through data, strategic thinking, and business partnering.
Join a collaborative, high-performing team where your analyses directly contribute to company performance and long-term success.


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Join the team. Make an impact.

At Holded, we believe that daily admin should never stop a great idea from becoming a success. That's why we create intuitive software to empower anyone who dares to start their own business. Long story short: we want to make business simple.

In order to create cutting-edge products that meet the needs of the sector, talent is essential. We are looking for passion, creativity, and commitment. In return, we offer the same.




The Role

Data plays a key role in how we design the product, support our customers, and make better decisions across the company. Our Data team works with teams across Holded (Product, Sales, Support, Marketing and Finance) and we’re now looking for a Product Data Analyst to join us, with a focus on specific products within Holded.




You’ll be part of a growing data organisation that includes analysts, data engineers and data science, and you’ll work closely with both business and product teams from day one.




As a Product Data Analyst your work will include:

Working closely with Product Managers and Business stakeholders
Supporting frequent product launches by defining metrics, validating tracking, building observability and monitoring results
Analyzing the behavior of users and our product performance
Developing data models using dbt
Contributing to shared metrics and a common semantic layer
Building and improving dashboards used by Product and Business teams
Answering small and big data questions and helping teams understand what’s happening in the business.




Ideally, we are looking for an analyst with solid experience in dbt and an interest in data modeling and/or analytics engineering.

This is a role with significant growth opportunities, both in terms of scope and impact and which will be adjusted to the candidate’s profile and experience.




About you

Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Master in Data Science or any related field
Around 3+ years of experience in data, analytics or a similar role
Great SQL
Basic DBT knowledge
Data modeling knowledge
Ideally, some experience working close to product and business teams
Experience with BigQuery, Lightdash or cloud platforms is a plus, but not required.
Some experience with Python is a plus
Curious mindset and willingness to learn
Spanish (working proficiency), English (Intermediate)
Based in Barcelona




What it's like to work with us

Permanent contract
Short workday on Fridays
26 paid vacation days
Free catered lunch at the office
English/Spanish classes
Referral program
Continuous Training: an annual budget for training for each employee
Fully equipped kitchen with snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit
Top-notch work equipment
Office in front of the sea with ping pong, pool table, PlayStation…
Interesting projects and a great work environment
An excellent opportunity to grow with the company
Discounts on a Gym membership




At Holded, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in self-sufficient, autonomous teams. We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or age.

We didn’t start Holded to be another software company. We started Holded to be epic, and you will be part of it.

Help Shape the Game Strategy: Be a part of the development of data-driven strategies for top games, influencing product roadmaps, features, and monetization.

Experience in analytics or data science roles, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or digital products.

Excellent communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders.
Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience mentoring or leading other analysts is a big plus.
Fast learner, highly meticulous, proactive, and pragmatic.

Title: Staff Data Analyst - Ops & Compliance
Description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as a Staff Data Analyst - Ops & Compliance to build the analytics foundations that power Qonto's compliance execution. You'll own a brand-new scope — monitoring KYC/KYB funnels, remediation campaigns, and financial exposure — working cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control, under the guidance of Alma, our Lead Data Analyst.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As a Data Analyst at Qonto, you will


Build compliance process monitoring from scratch: You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers compliance monitoring at Qonto — from onboarding funnel analytics to remediation financial exposure — giving product, operations and compliance teams the self-service tools they need to make decisions without waiting on a data request.
Model and transform data with dbt: With the collaboration of Analytics Engineer Team, you'll build end-to-end transformation pipelines from source to consumption layer, keeping metric definitions clean and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.
Turn regulatory questions into self-service assets: You'll partner with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control to scope and ship analytical tools
Own the KYC/KYB funnel analytics end-to-end: You'll deliver insights from CS initiation through KYB validation — refusal reasons, document gaps, lead-time distributions — so teams can act on friction fast.
Track remediation campaigns and financial exposure: You'll measure MRR secured, at risk, or lost across active campaigns, with peak intensity in Q4 (budget season) and May-June (reforecast).


🤔 What You Can Expect


A greenfield, strategically critical scope: Qonto is under close regulatory scrutiny — you'll build analytics foundations that matter company-wide, not just for your team.
Senior, cross-functional exposure from day one: Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, Internal Control — few DA roles give you this breadth of senior stakeholder access at this level.
Real ownership in the Modern Data Stack: You'll build in Omni and dbt with a high degree of autonomy — no legacy to untangle, just foundations to create.
A team where AI is a first-class tool: Unlimited access to AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to evolve how you work, not just output more.


➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Alma, our Lead Data Analyst for Ops & Finance. Alma knows exactly what it takes to build an analytics function that actually changes decisions, and she'll push you to do the same.

Alma reports to Erwan, Director of Business Analytics who oversees the entire Analytics function and ensures alignment across teams.

🏅 About You


Compliance or regulated environment experience: You've worked analytically on KYC/KYB, AML, remediation, or similar regulatory/operational processes — and you know how to get credible with those stakeholders fast.
Self-service product mindset: You've designed dashboards and models for end-users to explore autonomously, adapting the same dataset from ops-level (daily SLA tracking) to exec-level (budget readouts).
Cross-functional stakeholder management: You've juggled competing analytical priorities across multiple teams — and you know how to scope clearly, push back when needed, and drive adoption.
Strong SQL and data modelling skills: You've built end-to-end transformation pipelines, enforced data quality, and made non-technical stakeholders trust your numbers.
AI-native workflow: You actively use AI tools to accelerate your analytics work — from data modelling to stakeholder communication — and you're genuinely curious about going further.
Language: Fluent in English.

Experiencia práctica en Inteligencia Artificial / Machine Learning en entornos reales.
Conocimientos básicos de SQL.
Experiencia analizando datos operativos y detección de incidencias
Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma en un entorno técnico.
Nivel de inglés medio – alto (mínimo B2)
Experiencia en entornos industriales, automatización o software técnico.
IA aplicada a incidencias, tickets, logs o detección de anomalías.
Conocimientos básicos de MLOps, APIs o entornos cloud.

Persona proactiva, con capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas.
Buen nivel de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.
Orientación a resultados y compromiso con la calidad del código.

Contrato indefinido
Horario flexible de lunes a viernes, con jornada reducida los viernes.

Vacaciones amplias para que desconectes de verdad.

Modelo de trabajo híbrido.

Oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos internacionales y de alto impacto, dentro de un entorno innovador y en constante evolución.
Cultura colaborativa y orientada al desarrollo profesional
Formación continua y oportunidades de crecimiento
