Title: Workforce Insights Analyst
Description:
About Ricoh

A global leader in digital services, recognised for innovation, sustainability and a people-first culture. We feature in the Gartner Magic Quadrant, are listed in the Global 100 Most Sustainable Companies, and have been named one of Forbes’ World’s Best Employers 2025.

At Ricoh, we believe people do their best work when they feel valued and supported. We create inclusive workplaces where you can grow, contribute, and make a positive impact while helping to build a more sustainable future.

Find your place. Transform your future

Our purpose is centred on understanding and improving how people work. By focusing on real working experiences, we support individuals to develop their skills, realise their potential and do work that feels meaningful.

People Transform When They Love What They Do

This belief sits at the heart of The Ricoh Promise. It guides how we recruit, how we support our people, and how we work together every day, creating an environment where you can grow, feel valued and make a difference.

When you join us, you are encouraged to share your ideas, challenge the way things are done, and work with others to build something better. If you are looking for a place where your voice is heard, your development is supported, and your work feels meaningful, you will feel at home at Ricoh.

What you will be doing

As part of the Workforce Insights team, this role partners with the business to create and develop the core set of workforce and talent data KPIs. The primary focus is to support the business with reporting, collect and interpret data to provide actionable insights, and translate reporting requirements into KPI tracking and dashboards.


Manage, prioritise, and deliver new insight requests from the business across the EMEA region.
Collect, analyse, and interpret workforce data to provide insights and recommendations that support business decision-making and strategic planning.
Translate business reporting requirements into standardized reporting, KPI tracking, and dashboard processes.
Implement and uphold business intelligence policies, including data definitions, data quality, and analytics standards.
Provide specialist advice on the interpretation of HR data, resolving queries and clearly explaining insights to stakeholders.
Maintain and create scalable workforce data models within Microsoft Fabric to establish a structured reporting foundation.
Working across Excel, PowerBI and Microsoft Fabric to create meaningful and impactful dashboards, insights and charts as required by the business




You will ideally have

We're looking for a data-driven professional who is passionate about transforming complex workforce data into meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making. You will combine strong analytical skills with the ability to communicate compelling data stories to senior stakeholders across the business.

Key Skills & Experience


Proven experience in HR Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related data-focused role, with the ability to turn complex workforce data into actionable insights and recommendations.
Advanced expertise in Microsoft Power BI, including the development of robust DAX measures, dashboards, and reports that drive business performance.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including data preparation, modelling, visualisation, and workspace management.
Strong understanding of data analytics, data architecture, and reporting best practices.
Demonstrated ability to identify trends, solve complex business problems, and drive continuous process improvement through data-led solutions.
Knowledge of data modelling, systems thinking, risk analysis, and business process optimisation.
Experience working with large, multicultural organisations and engaging effectively with senior leadership teams.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence audiences at all levels.
Strong planning, prioritisation, and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple competing demands.
Adaptable, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment undergoing change.
Exposure to programming, automation, machine learning, or AI technologies would be advantageous.


Qualifications


Ideally educated to Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Management Information Systems (MIS), or another quantitative discipline. With studies in Finance, Economics, Human Resources, or related fields also considered, providing there is also strong technical expertise in business intelligence, data modelling, and analytics.




In return for your commitment, you can expect

At Ricoh, work should feel meaningful, supportive and fulfilling. The Ricoh Promise shapes your experience through four pillars that bring our culture to life.

Love to Connect

You become part of a global community built on openness, inclusion and genuine collaboration.

Across teams, countries and roles, you'll find people who listen, involve and encourage you - helping you feel valued and able to be yourself every day.

Love to Grow

Your development truly matters to us. With access to learning pathways, mentoring and career opportunities across functions and countries, you'll be supported to stretch your skills, explore new directions and stay future-ready in a changing world.

Love to Give Back

Purpose is part of how we work. You'll have opportunities to make a difference through volunteering, sustainability initiatives and community programmes that reflect our shared values and commitment to positive impact.

Love to Succeed

Success at Ricoh is something we pursue together. You'll benefit from fair rewards, flexible working, wellbeing resources and real recognition - including programmes such as the Imagine. Change. Awards, where colleagues celebrate each other's achievements.

We are an equal opportunities employer

We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions are based on skills, experience and potential, and we are committed to creating a fair and inclusive recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment journey, please let us know and we will support you to bring your best self forward.

Ready to love what you do? Apply now and help us shape what comes next.

Formación universitaria en ADE, Economía, Finanzas, Matemáticas, Estadística o similar.
2-5 años de experiencia en Controlling, análisis financiero o reporting.
Experiencia avanzada con Power BI, DAX y Power Query.
Conocimientos de SQL y modelado de datos.
Nivel avanzado de Excel, incluyendo macros.
Experiencia trabajando con SAP u otros ERP.
Buen nivel de inglés para trabajar en un entorno internacional.

Experiencia en multinacionales o proyectos de automatización financiera, certificaciones Power BI o conocimientos de Microsoft Fabric, Python, Power Automate, ETL o Data Warehouse.

Job description:



 

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Finance and Controlling team and bring your passion and talent to work.

 

Senior IT Data Analyst 100%

 

Barcelona, Spain

 

Your contribution

 

In this challenging and important role, you will be responsible for the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company’s SAP Datasphere and BW data landscape. Your responsibility is to ensure, from the definition of business requirements through to implementation and delivery, that data solutions are reliable, scalable, and aligned with business needs. You will work closely with business teams and IT to design and deliver high-quality data models, reporting solutions, and analytics capabilities.

 

The objectives and scope of the job are the following:

DataSphere and BW System ownership with administration, maintenance and development
Build, optimize, and maintain DataSphere models and reporting solutions.
Drive global reporting solutions across system landscape.
Integrate data from ERP, CRM, finance, and other systems.
Partner with business teams to design effective analytics solutions.
Analyze and visualize business data to support decisions
Create dashboards and KPIs in SAP Analytics Cloud and explore new BI tools.
Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance (e.g., GDPR)
Lead or support BI and digital transformation projects.
Apply strong knowledge of SAP Datasphere and SAP ERP (S/4).

 

Responsibilities

Ensure availability, quality, consistency, and compliance of company data (incl. data protection and governance).
Support the strategic development of Tecan’s data landscape across platforms
Advise management and business units on data-driven decisions.
Prioritize, implement, and monitor analysis requirements.
Create data models, ETL processes, and related standards.
Provision of technical documentation and knowledge transfer within the team.
Support cross-functional projects throughout the full lifecycle (Design, Implementation, Testing, Go-live and Hypercare).
Enforce consistent application of tools, methods, and standards in data & analytics.
Provide documentation, training, and knowledge transfer to colleagues and business users.

 ·      

Your background

 

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

Extensive experience as a BI specialist/data analyst in SAP HANA.
Strong knowledge of SAP Datasphere, SAP ERP (S/4), SAP Analytics Cloud, and ETL Tools.
Experience in data modelling, SQL Scripts and performance optimization.
Understanding of SAP S4 data structures (FI/CO, MM, SD, PP)
Excellent analytical, communication and project management skills.
Hands on experience in Project Management.
Fluent in English and Spanish; German is a plus.
Team player with a structured, independent work style.
Degree  in Business IT, data science or similar is a nice to have.
Experience with OneStream, Salesforce, TableauNext, Power BI would be a plus.

 

What makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

Working in an international and diverse environment
The chance to grow your career within the company
Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture
Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

 

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work.

We offer:


Hybrid remote working model
Ticket restaurant
Private health insurance
30 working days of annual leave
Flexible working hours

Kiwi.com is looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join our Customer Support Analytics team in Barcelona, Spain. We support Kiwi.com's Customer Support department to turn complex operational data into thoughtful, high-impact decisions that enhance customer satisfaction and strengthen daily operations. Partnering closely across Product, Finance, and Operations, we build intuitive dashboards and data models to bring real-time visibility to friction points, tracking airline recovery and ensuring accurate, timely refunds. In our AI-native team, you will collaborate directly with key decision-makers, seeing firsthand how your shared insights make the customer journey measurably better.

Title: Data Analyst I Courier RTO Global HQ
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

YOUR MISSION

Real-Time Operations keeps Glovo’s deliveries moving: when an order stalls, a courier stops, or a store goes quiet, RTO is what notices and acts.

Your mission is to find what is actually causing those failures and then build the thing that fixes them — the analysis and the automation, not one handed to someone else to build.

You will work at the intersection of operations analytics, AI agent quality and automation engineering, on problems that are genuinely unsolved.

THE JOURNEY


Own operational analyses end to end — take an ambiguous problem, find the real driver rather than the most visible symptom, and turn it into a decision about where to focus.
Build and run the automations that come out of that analysis: real-time detection, the action it triggers, the monitoring that proves it still works, and the documentation someone else can operate it from.
Work on the systems around our AI voice and chat agents across fourteen markets — automated conversation audits, the loop that turns an unanswered question into a knowledge base update, and the evaluation that says whether a prompt change helped or hurt.
Design and read the experiments behind what we ship: choose the unit of randomisation, pick the metric that reflects the real outcome, and report the result honestly, including when it says the thing does not work.
Build processes that send an input to an LLM and need a specific, reliable output back — together with the checks that confirm the output is what we expected.
Hand findings to the right owner when they sit outside RTO, with enough evidence that they can act on them.


Qualifications

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

Must have


Advanced SQL — window functions, CTEs, joining across large event and transactional tables, and the habit of checking what a column really contains before building on it.
A structured, sceptical approach to problem-solving. You look for the reason your own conclusion might be wrong before someone else does.
Hands-on experience building something end to end that ran in production and that other people depended on.
Good written and verbal English. Most of your stakeholders are operations people, not analysts.


Nice to have


Python (pandas or equivalent), experiment analysis, BigQuery, n8n or similar orchestration, Google Apps Script, Looker, voice or chat AI agent platforms such as ElevenLabs, and a background in last-mile delivery, marketplaces or logistics.
Practical experience using LLMs inside a process that had to produce a reliable output — prompt design, structured outputs, and a way of checking the result.


Additional Information

At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our LinkedIn and website!

Description:
Descripción del puesto:

¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

En Servicios Operativos de Tesorería (SOT) trabajamos en el núcleo operativo de los mercados financieros de CaixaBank, dando soporte a actividades críticas de post-trade, lifecycle, liquidez, clearing, garantías, renta fija, derivados y nuevas iniciativas estratégicas de Tesorería. La nueva unidad especializada en Loan Data & SRT Operations se integrará en SOT con una visión transversal, apoyando a ALM Treasury & Funding en la calidad, trazabilidad y uso operativo del dato de activos que soporta las operaciones de titulización.

 

Misión del puesto


Asegurar la calidad, integridad, trazabilidad y explotación operativa de los datos de activos asociados a operaciones Synthetic Risk Transfer (SRT), contribuyendo al seguimiento de carteras, reporting, evidencias auditables y mejora continua del modelo operativo.

 

Responsabilidades principales

Gestionar y analizar loan tapes y bases de datos de activos subyacentes de operaciones SRT.
Ejecutar controles de calidad de dato, validaciones, reconciliaciones y seguimiento de excepciones.
Dar soporte operativo al closing y al lifecycle de titulizaciones: altas, bajas, amortizaciones, defaults e incidencias.
Preparar reporting operativo, evidencias auditables y dashboards para stakeholders internos, inversores y supervisor cuando aplique.
Diseñar automatizaciones y herramientas de control mediante SQL, Python, Power BI u otras tecnologías de análisis.
Participar en proyectos transversales relacionados con datos, regulación, originación, control y transformación operativa.

 

Requisitos mínimos
Titulación superior con componente cuantitativo: Matemáticas, Física, Ingeniería, Economía, ADE o similar.
Conocimientos sólidos de análisis de datos y programación: SQL, Python o equivalente.
Nivel alto de inglés escrito y hablado, con capacidad para interactuar con partners internacionales.
Manejo avanzado de Excel. Se valorará experiencia con Power BI, herramientas de reporting y data quality.
Interés por mercados financieros, gestión de riesgos, productos estructurados y dinámica de balance/capital.
Se valorará experiencia en operaciones financieras, riesgos, reporting regulatorio, gestión de datos o proyectos de transformación.

 

Competencias clave
Capacidad analítica
Orientación al detalle
Trabajo transversal
Autonomía e iniciativa
Aprendizaje continuo
Resiliencia y adaptación

 

¿Qué ofrecemos?
Incorporarte a una unidad de nueva creación, con visibilidad y recorrido profesional.
Desarrollar una combinación diferencial de expertise de mercados, análisis de datos y control operativo.
Trabajar en un entorno dinámico y colaborativo, con impacto directo en una actividad estratégica para la gestión de capital y balance del banco.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
As a Senior Data Analyst on our Growth team, you will play a pivotal role in driving our marketing performance to new heights. You will collaborate closely with User Acquisition and Growth partners to analyze data, find opportunities, and deliver actionable insights. Your work will empower strategic business decisions and improve player experiences.

What You'll Do
Partner closely with UA and Growth collaborators to understand performance, investigate business questions, and provide actionable recommendations.
Lead analytical projects end-to-end, from problem definition and data exploration through to insights and collaborator communication.
Own and evolve the business logic and analytical requirements of Growth data models, ensuring they accurately represent how the business measures performance.
Act as a key collaborator with Data Engineering, translating business and analytical needs into clear data requirements and validating delivered solutions.
Proactively identify and investigate data quality issues, inconsistencies, and gaps across Growth reporting and underlying data models.
Build and maintain scalable reporting and analytical solutions, reducing repetitive manual analysis where possible.
Define and maintain key Growth metrics and measurement logic across areas such as spend, acquisition, revenue, attribution, and marketing performance.
Perform deep-dive analyses to understand performance drivers, find opportunities, and support investment decisions.
Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical collaborators, including senior leadership.
Provide technical mentorship and share standard methodologies with other analysts while contributing to consistent analytical standards across the team.
Work closely with Data Scientists on measurement, experimentation, and modeling projects by offering solid analytical and data foundations.


What We're Looking For

We are seeking an ambitious and seasoned Senior Data Analyst with a proven track record of delivering outstanding results. You should have:
4+ years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or a related role.
Strong experience independently delivering analytical projects and working directly with business collaborators.
Experience owning or contributing significantly to analytical data models, metric definitions, or reporting foundations.
Advanced SQL skills and strong experience working with large and complex datasets.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation and analytical workflows.
Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and analytical data structures.
Experience converting business requirements into data requirements and collaborating closely with Data Engineering teams.
Proficiency in a data visualization/BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.
Good understanding of statistical analysis and experimentation.
Familiarity with digital marketing data, attribution, and acquisition metrics is a strong plus.
A strong ownership approach, comfortable independently driving work through to completion.
A curious and analytical nature, always looking to investigate unexpected results and challenge assumptions.
Realistic and dedicated to identifying ways forward.
Strong attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy and reliability.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities in a fast paced business environment.
Strong collaboration skills, capable of working effectively across Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering, and business teams.
Excellent communication skills, able to challenge constructively and build trust with technical and non-technical collaborators.
Willingness to assist in the technical growth of other analysts and help maintain high analytical standards throughout the team.


This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About BizAway

Here at BizAway, we Deliver the Future of Travel. 😎

We are a solid international company with strong ambitions and great expertise. With a focus on sustainability 🌱, on a daily basis we support companies enabling them to improve their travel management through our constantly evolving services and solutions, always characterized by our tech attitude and smart and innovative processes. 🚀

We know that success comes from People and deserves to be recognized.👫Proactivity and

Reliability, Kind collaboration, and communication are the core values of our Solution Culture.

If you like challenges and would love to be part of one of the fastest-growing B2B scale-ups, then BizAway is the company you have been looking for. 🤩

We are looking for

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d) , who desires to contribute to the growth and success of our Data & Analytics Team.

Your role in BizAway


You tackle complex business problems end to end, translating ambiguous questions into analysis, and analysis into recommendations the business can act on.
You deliver data products rather than one-off reports, reusable models and tools that keep delivering value over time.
You own our semantic layer, the metric definitions, business logic and data models that make sure there is one trusted answer to any business question, for people and for AI.
You own the implementation and evolution of our self-service analytics tools, so internal stakeholders can answer their own recurring questions.
You learn all aspects of the travel industry covering Finance, Product, Sales and Operations perspective, and engage with Business stakeholders to define KPIs, including how data is captured, shared and leveraged across departments.


Your Basic Qualifications


Data analysis, presentation, and visualization experience
Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior non-technical stakeholders
Ability to work autonomously with high ambiguity, alone or in a team as required
Advanced SQL, Python and strong data modeling fundamentals
Experience defining and maintaining shared metric definitions across an organisation
Demonstrated experience with Product Analytics tools (eg: Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, Google Analytics)
Demonstrated experience with BI Data Visualization tools (Qlik preferred)
Master degree in Statistics, Engineering, Economics or a related field is preferred
Previously worked in a Tech Company
English proficiency (written and spoken level B2)


We are also interested in


Understanding of AI/ML concepts
Experience making data available to LLMs or AI agents
Previous experience in the travel industry or similar sectors


Our offer

📄 Contract type: Permanent

🕓 Working hours: Full-time – 40h/week, from Monday to Friday

🏢 Hybrid setting, flexible working policy, and great offices in Europe

💰 Salary: Attractive compensation, including equity in the company

💼 Equity in the company (stock options plan)

✈️ A seat on a scale-up with skyrocketing growth

📈 Development of your entrepreneurial spirit, having the chance to implement real-impact business decision

🌍Multicultural and international team

🙌Collaborative and smart environment to work and learn

🍻Free coffee to kick-start your day and free beers to celebrate together

Title: DATA ANALYST
Description:
About

Joko is an AI shopping app that helps millions of users save time and money when shopping online or in-store. With Juno, our shopping assistant, they can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds.

What sets Joko’s AI apart is how well it knows its users. Its shopping recommendations feel personal from day one and get sharper the more they use it. It draws on unique assets to deliver the best experience: one of the largest product catalogs in the world, and unique shopping data no one else has to personalize every recommendation.

Users can also track the price of their favorite products and earn cash back almost everywhere. All in one free app.

Joko is a tech company founded in Paris. Their team of 120+ talents is international and spread across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, with some working remotely.

As a certified B Corporation, they are committed to making a difference for the communities they serve, including the 6 million consumers already using Joko to save money every day at over 10,000 merchants.

After reaching profitability in their core market, they are expanding internationally with a primary focus on the US.

It’s still day 1 at Joko; come build the future of shopping with us.

Job Description

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

🧚🏻 Our Data team

The Data team at Joko is turning mountains of data into actionable insights for all the teams! The Data team is part of our Operations department led by our COO, and our mission is to empower the company to make informed decisions.

More Specifically, The Team's Responsibilities Are


State-of-the-art analytics & data science: We want to be at the forefront of analytics and data science by building top-notch analyses and tools. Our goal is to allow teams to leverage powerful insights from advanced reporting and predictive models.
AI-driven autonomy for stakeholders: We are doubling down on the combination of AI and data to unlock a new level of autonomy for our stakeholders, seamlessly bridging data insights with the AI tools we use, built on secure and trustworthy foundations.
Spread the data culture: At Joko, we have a strong engineering and tech culture across all teams. We work hand-in-hand with our stakeholders, providing support and training on data tools, and building close relationships to ensure our solutions align perfectly with their operational needs and evolve with them over time.


🎯 What you will do

As a Data Analyst, you will have a cross-functional role and collaborate closely with teams to understand our data and develop insights.


Advanced analytics & data science: You will explore and analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and potential issues that will support decision-making processes across all teams. You will also contribute to data science initiatives by building predictive models and applying statistics to generate deeper insights and drive measurable business impact.
Reporting and Data Visualization: You will design and create dashboards and data visualizations that empower stakeholders to explore data autonomously. Leveraging AI tools to move faster, your focus will be on what matters most: defining the right metrics, surfacing meaningful insights, and ensuring data is understood and acted upon across the company.
AI and data integration: You will actively contribute to bridging our data with the AI tools we use, ensuring insights are integrated and maintained over time.
Stakeholder collaboration: You will work hand-in-hand with stakeholders to understand their needs, collect their feedback, and evangelize data usage to help them make smarter choices and become more autonomous over time.
Continuous Learning and Improvement: As "never stop learning" is one of our values, you will grow along the way and keep up with the latest analytical methods, AI developments, and tools in our data stack.


👀 Who we're looking for


Experience: You have 2+ years of professional experience in data analysis (relevant internships can count). We hire across different seniority levels, so we encourage you to apply even if you are more experienced.
Interest in AI: You are genuinely curious about AI and its applications, and eager to leverage it in your day-to-day work to move faster and create more impact.
Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you are willing to get better every day to reach excellence.
Problem-solving & Analytical skills: You love solving complex problems and analyzing data.
Coding knowledge: Mastering SQL and Python is not mandatory, as you can still learn when joining, but it's a plus.
Business acumen: You can understand the needs of your business stakeholders and get the big picture of how the business is running.
Communication: You know how to present your conclusions clearly and concisely (written and oral).
Education: You have graduated from a top-tier business or engineering school.
Languages: You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.


💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:


Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.
Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.


On Top Of That, We Offer Plenty Of Perks


💸 Top-market compensation
📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build
🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills
🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings
💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription
🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent
…and much more, check the full list here!


🤝 Our hiring process


Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.
Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).
Step 2 – Role-specific assessments
For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).
For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).
Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.
References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Additional Information


Contract Type: Full-Time
Location: Paris, Barcelona
Possible full remote
Salary: between 48000€ and 84000€ / year

Descripción de la empresa

MSX International es un líder global en servicios para el sector de automoción, presente en más de 80 países. Desde nuestra sede en Barcelona trabajamos con diferentes fabricantes internacionales para ofrecer soluciones innovadoras que impulsan la eficiencia, la calidad y el rendimiento de sus operaciones.

Si buscas un entorno dinámico, analítico, internacional y orientado a la mejora continua, este es tu sitio.

Como Analista de Datos, serás responsable de gestionar, analizar y transformar datos clave relacionados con proyectos del sector automoción. Tu misión será convertir grandes volúmenes de datos en insights claros y accionables que apoyen la toma de decisiones, la optimización de procesos y el rendimiento general del negocio.

Requisitos


Realizar análisis diarios, semanales y mensuales utilizando herramientas como Tableau, Power BI y Excel
Identificar tendencias, variaciones y oportunidades de mejora
Preparar informes avanzados alineados con KPIs y requisitos del proyecto
Mantener, actualizar y asegurar la calidad de la documentación y reportes en herramientas como SharePoint y Office365
Identificar patrones en los datos y proponer acciones correctivas u oportunidades de optimización
Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para convertir insights en acciones concretas
Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares internos en informes y dashboards
Presentar análisis, conclusiones e información relevante a equipos internos y dirección
Asegurar la precisión, consistencia y calidad de los datos analizados
Proponer mejoras continuas en procesos, metodologías y flujos de análisis


Requisitos

Conocimientos y habilidades


Habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar con equipos diversos
Enfoque resolutivo para problemas complejos
Capacidad para gestionar prioridades y trabajar con plazos ajustados
Dominio de Tableau, Power BI y Excel
Conocimientos de sistemas de gestión de datos, minería de datos, procesos ETL y reporting automatizado
Competencias en análisis estadístico y modelos de rendimiento
Experiencia con herramientas de automatización (RPA) es un plus
Conocimiento de Microsoft Dynamics (deseable)


Formación


Grado en Ingeniería, Economía, Estadística, Matemáticas o formación equivalente


Experiencia


Experiencia previa demostrable como Analista de Datos


Idiomas


Español nativo
Inglés B2 (escrito y hablado)

Puesto permanente con contrato indefinido desde el primer día.
Política de teletrabajo de hasta el 50% de la jornada mensual tras el periodo de adaptación.
Formar parte de un gran equipo de profesionales en una compañía internacional consolidada.
Obtener una visión global del sector automoción, interactuando con clientes, proveedores, consultores y concesionarios.
Salario: 23.000 euros brutos anuales.
Acceso a MSX Bazaar, el portal de compras colectivas con grandes descuentos para empleados.
Posibilidad de adherirte al Plan de Retribución Flexible (seguro médico, tarjeta transporte, tarjeta restaurante, formación...).
23 días laborables de vacaciones al año según convenio y 3 días por año completo trabajado.
Incentivos adicionales por programas de recomendación interna, formadores internos, detección de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, etc.

Title: Sr Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Location: Madrid, Spain

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

At PMI, we're transforming our business and building our future around one clear purpose: delivering a smoke-free future.

As part of our Data, Insights & Analytics (DI&A) team, you'll help turn data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge business strategy and analytics by translating complex business challenges into data-driven insights and solutions.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, uncover trends, develop dashboards and analytical products, and enable better, faster, and more informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze commercial, consumer, and digital data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and define analytical requirements.
Design, build, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
Drive visibility of key performance indicators across multiple functions.
Support continuous improvement through experimentation, performance measurement, and insight generation.
Promote data quality, analytics adoption, and evidence-based decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


3+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related fields.
Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development and data modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar cloud-based analytics environments.

Responsibilities

The main tasks of the jobholder will be:


Perform end-to-end data processing, from gathering relevant data from various internal and external sources to cleaning and processing raw data to ensure the highest data quality.
Apply advanced statistical and analytical techniques to extract meaningful insights, draw accurate conclusions from data, and prevent biases in decision-making.
Design and deliver high-impact data visualizations, charts, and dashboards to communicate findings effectively through clear storytelling, while advising users on best practices.
Prepare and present comprehensive reports to share key insights with stakeholders and support informed, data-driven business decisions.
Manage and maintain analytical tools and software ecosystem for data analysis, ensuring data security, privacy, and full compliance with internal requirements and external regulations.
Foster a data-driven mindset by coaching business functions, collaborating with other teams, and actively sharing best practices and techniques with the wider Airbus data community.


Skills

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you:


Education: Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Experience: Proven experience in data analysis, data preparation, and working with complex datasets.
Technical knowledge:
Strong command of statistics and probability concepts (e.g., hypothesis testing, Monte Carlo simulations, expected values, standard errors, Central Limit Theorem, confidence intervals).
Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Python/R, SQL, Tableau, PowerBI, QlikSense, or similar software).
Soft skills: Excellent communication and storytelling skills, high adaptability to work in a networking mode, coaching mindset, and ability to act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams.
Languages: Advanced level in English.
Valuable / Nice to have: Experience within the aerospace, defense, or industrial manufacturing sectors; knowledge of big data technologies or advanced machine learning models.

Garantizar la explotación estratégica de la información y la evolución del entorno de datos en Netquest, identificando oportunidades de mejora, desarrollando herramientas analíticas y siendo una pieza técnica clave para la toma de decisiones basadas en datos.




2. Responsabilidades Principales

Interpretar datos e indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPI) para ayudar a la empresa a maximizar el valor de la información.
Colaborar con diferentes áreas de negocio para definir y priorizar necesidades de información.
Proporcionar soluciones de informes y herramientas de BI para partes interesadas internas y externas.
Desarrollar y mantener cuadros de mando (dashboards) en herramientas de BI (ej. Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau).
Manipular datos y realizar análisis ad-hoc utilizando Python y consultas avanzadas en SQL.
Identificar, analizar e interpretar patrones y tendencias en grandes volúmenes de datos (millones de registros).
Monitorizar fuentes de datos y colaborar con Data Engineers para resolver inconsistencias y garantizar las políticas de calidad.
Trabajar de manera colaborativa dentro del área de Datos con Data Scientists, Data Engineers y otros analistas.




3. Relaciones Clave (Interfaces)

Internas: Equipo de Datos (Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics) y responsables de diversas áreas de negocio.
Externas: Clientes y colaboradores externos receptores de herramientas de análisis o informes ad-hoc.

Formación y Experiencia:
Educación: Grado Universitario en Ingeniería, Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, Informática o campo cuantitativo similar.
Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años de experiencia previa desempeñando funciones como Data Analyst.
Conocimientos Técnicos e Idiomas:
Dominio de Python (librerías como pandas, polars, numpy, matplotlib, ggplot, seaborn).
Sólidos conocimientos y optimización en SQL.
Experiencia en herramientas de Business Intelligence (Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI).
Idiomas: Fluidez en inglés (comunicación verbal y escrita clara).
Valorables: Experiencia en servicios Cloud (especialmente AWS) y herramientas de gestión de datos como dbt.
Competencias Y Habilidades:
Excelente pensamiento analítico y capacidad para la resolución de problemas.
Habilidades de storytelling para comunicar hallazgos complejos de forma sencilla.
Trabajo en equipo, adaptabilidad y enfoque orientado a la calidad de los datos.

Ubicación: Barcelona
Modelo de trabajo: Híbrido (2 días en la oficina y 3 días de teletrabajo)
Beneficios sociales:
Contrato indefinido.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Fraud
Description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What you will get to do


Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate


To succeed in this role, you should have


Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (4+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
Strong problem solving skills
Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets
Experience in fraud, risk, or financial services; you understand how fraud attacks work and how to think about mitigation trade-offs
A proactive mindset — you don't wait to be asked; you spot something unusual and you dig in
Some exposure to Python or scripting for data manipulation and analysis
Proficiency with a BI tool (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, Superset, Redash, or any other alternative)
Strong stakeholder management skills; you can communicate findings clearly to fraud operations, product managers, engineers, and senior leadership — and you know how to influence decisions with data across all of them.
Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams where priorities shift quickly.
Proficiency with a spreadsheet tool (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, or any other alternative)
Enjoy autonomy and a flat structure: we have millions of customers and a flat hierarchy so any individual can have an outsized impact
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or any other related field


Experience with the following would be a plus


Data governance
Python or any other scripting language
Git or any other version control tool


What we can offer you


Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.


What to expect in the hiring process


A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
Technical take-home task (SQL test).
Technical Interview with hiring manager.
A behavioural interview with the Head of Data Analytics/Science and Fraud Team.

  • Python or any other scripting language
  • Git or any other version control tool

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Data team at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Analytics. The Analytics pillar is split into two teams: Product Analytics, working closely with our Product teams, and Revenue Analytics, partnering directly with the Business Unit leads in the Revenue org.

The Revenue Analytics function sits at the intersection of growth, customer acquisition, lifecycle management and commercial steering, as part of the Data Analytics team. You'll join the Revenue Analytics team, led by Saghar, our Analytics Manager, who heads a team of four data analysts and you'd be the fifth. This structure means you'll spend less time fixing broken pipelines and more time uncovering high-value insights

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

What’s in it for you?


Direct Business Impact: Your work will directly shape how BU Managers and Country GMs steer revenue, churn, and growth decisions across markets, with clear visibility to senior leadership.
End-to-End Business Intelligence: From acquisition and activation to churn, retention, and revenue quality, you will own the analytical narrative for your BU scope, spanning marketing performance, product adoption, and commercial health.
Local Market Influence: You will partner closely with BU Managers and local marketing teams to understand country-specific dynamics and translate data into practical commercial decisions.
Strategic Growth Partnership: You will help shape budget allocation, campaign optimisation, funnel improvements and lifecycle opportunities based on robust analytical evidence.
A Mature Stack: Work with a modern data stack including Snowflake, dbt, Python and Omni, supported by a dedicated Analytics Engineering team.
A hybrid work policy: Enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration.
Modern, centrally located offices: Work from modern office spaces in prime city locations.
An international environment: Join a diverse team with colleagues from across Europe.
Mobility across locations: Opportunity to work from our offices in Madrid, Copenhagen, Paris, Amsterdam or Berlin.


Your Responsibilities Will Include


Business KPI Definition & Governance: Establish, define and maintain the core KPI framework for your BU scope, including revenue metrics, churn rate, activation, retention, payback, LTV and customer-quality metrics.
Steering Dashboards: Design and deliver actionable dashboards for BU Managers and Country GMs, enabling reliable performance steering across Germany and Spain.
Data Modelling & Collection: Build robust, scalable data models using SQL and dbt to support recurring and ad-hoc marketing analytics needs.
Project & Stakeholder Management: Lead analytical projects end-to-end, managing timelines, priorities and senior stakeholder expectations across local BUs, Marketing and Data.
Funnel & Conversion Analysis: Own the analytical view of the customer journey from first touch to activation, paying customer and retained user, identifying bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Customer Lifecycle Analytics: Analyse onboarding, activation, retention and lifecycle campaigns, helping local teams improve customer engagement and long-term revenue quality.
Performance Marketing Analytics: Analyse paid and organic acquisition performance across channels, campaigns, audiences and markets, helping teams understand where growth is efficient and where optimisation is needed.
Experimentation & Incrementality: Support the design, measurement and interpretation of marketing experiments, including A/B tests, landing-page tests, lifecycle tests and channel tests.
Cross-functional Connectivity: Bridge insights across Revenue, Product, Marketing, Finance and Customer Success, ensuring a unified view of customer acquisition, value creation and retention.


📍 Job located in Berlin or Madrid, with possibility of two remote working days per week

About You


Experience: 5+ years in Data Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Growth Analytics or Revenue Analytics, ideally in a SaaS, fintech, subscription, marketplace or digital product environment.
Technical Excellence: Expert-level SQL and solid experience with dbt (modelling, testing, and documentation).
Business & Revenue Analytics Expertise: Strong understanding of revenue metrics (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, payback), customer lifecycle and funnel analytics and commercial KPI frameworks. Marketing analytics experience is a strong plus.
Analytical Breadth: Comfortable working across forecasting, LTV modelling, funnel analysis, and operational KPI frameworks.
Communication: Ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable recommendations for senior non-technical stakeholders.
Language: Fluent in English. German is strongly preferred for the German market scope; Spanish would be beneficial for the Spain market scope.
Nice to have: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Hightouch, Census, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads or similar.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Technical Call (60’): Discussion with Saghar (Analytics Manager) + a technical SQL assessment.

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation (60’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Logical & Personality Assessment (30–45’): Followed by meeting a few team members + Discussion with the VP of Data & Analytics regarding collaboration and strategic vision.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About the role:

We are looking for a responsible and hard-working Senior Data Analyst to join our efforts in taking over the print-on-demand industry. You would work in an international environment with talented teammates in a casual atmosphere. You’ll have your hands on very rich and diverse data related to the print-on-demand universe.

Your daily tasks will include:


Acting as a go-to data person within your respective team
Engaging in product analytics, ops analytics and business analytics
Continuously improving your team's product features with suggestions from ad-hoc and regular data analysis
Analyzing internal, market, and customer levels of data regarding various business areas
Translating data into actionable insights


You’ll level up fast by building production-grade analytics with state-of-the-art tools—Snowflake Intelligence, Streamlit in Snowflake, Amplitude, and more—gaining real ownership, mentorship, and impact at scale. In collaboration with our data engineers, you will define data models and ensure data quality through rigorous QA processes. You will work with Looker's analytical layer, defining explores, measures, and dimensions to support robust data exploration.

Your qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, physics, economics or a related quantitative field required
Strong written & verbal English communication skills
At least 4 years of professional experience in data analysis
Demonstrated ability to present and clearly articulate summarized data analysis results
Advanced SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or similar data warehouses
Proficiency in Excel usage for data analysis
Hands-on experience with BI tools to create interactive dashboards and visualizations (Looker is a plus)
Solid understanding of data modeling and data quality principles
Hands-on experience with event tracking and product analytics tools (Amplitude is a plus)
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and causal inference


What we offer:


A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done
An opportunity to work remotely
Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 10 AM)
Private health insurance
2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being
1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice
Learning Budget to support your professional development.
Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online
Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!
Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Thunes

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments globally. Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Miami, Johannesburg, Riyadh, San Francisco and Atlanta For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

Context of the role

We are looking for a driven and product-minded BI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in solving real business problems through data.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decision-making across the business. You will help identify product and operational pain points, improve day-to-day insight consumption for internal teams, and contribute to a strong data informed culture across the company.

You will work closely with data engineers to design, build, and maintain analytical solutions for key internal stakeholders across different functions, that improves our productivity, business performance, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
Build a strong understanding of key business processes, product flows, operational challenges, and performance metrics.
Design, develop, and maintain production-grade dashboards, reports, and analytical assets using Tableau and other relevant tools.
Write production-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery.
Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure data sources are reliable, well-structured, and fit for analytical use.
Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team.
Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities.



Professional Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.
2-5 years of experience in a data, BI, analytics, or related role.
Strong hands-on experience writing production-level SQL.
Strong hands-on experience using Python for analysis, data processing, and analytical solution development.
Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management.
Proven ability to work with complex datasets and turn business questions into structured, actionable analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from stakeholder requests to practical data solutions.
Good understanding of reporting design, data visualisation best practices, and how to present insights clearly for business users.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.
Experience supporting multiple business functions and balancing different stakeholder needs in a structured way.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to gather requirements, align expectations, and communicate clearly throughout delivery.
Demonstrated business curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding how the business works beyond the data itself.
Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to work independently and follow through from problem understanding to solution delivery.



Sound like you? Apply now!

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst
Description:
LocalStack - the Local Cloud Sandbox for Developers and AI Agents

We are a fast-growing Series A startup building cutting-edge technology to revolutionize cloud development processes and support highly efficient dev&test feedback loops. We’ve closed our last $25mil round in Q4 2024, led by Notable Capital, CRV and Heavybit.

LocalStack is a local cloud development platform. LocalStack makes it easier, faster, and less expensive for software teams to ship reliable, high-quality applications to the cloud.

The cloud was built to run software, not to support AI-native development workflows. As the world's leading local cloud development platform, LocalStack provides secure local sandboxes that simulate cloud environments, enabling AI agents and software developers to find and fix risks faster and more effectively than they can in the cloud.

Our customer base ranges from SMBs to Global Fortune 500 companies. Our clients include companies like NASA, Harness, IBM, Workday, Comcast, Apple, 3M, Block and many more.

We are sustainably growing our globally distributed teams across GTM, operations and engineering. In 2025 we almost doubled in size and continue to grow across all areas in 2026.

LocalStack is headquartered in Zurich/Switzerland 🇨🇭, with a small engineering office in Vienna/Austria 🇦🇹 and remote team members from 25 countries including 🇺🇸the US, 🇫🇷FR, 🇬🇧UK, 🇨🇦CA, 🇪🇸ES, and many more!

👉Check our Notion Candidate Handbook and our GitHub!

✅ About the role

Data is highly valued at LocalStack, and this role is an opportunity to shape our product analytics strategy as we scale. You’ll connect fragmented data and user identities across the Emulator, CLI, VS Code extension, web app and docs, using rich product telemetry to understand how behaviour drives conversion, expansion and churn. You’ll help define what we build versus buy, establish better product analytics foundations, and turn usage data into insights that inform pricing, packaging and growth decisions. You’ll work closely with highly technical teams and have significant ownership in shaping how product analytics, data tooling and AI-assisted ways of working evolve at LocalStack.

✅ We Expect you to accomplish in this role:


Build and evangelise product analytics foundations, delivering actionable insight for GTM, Finance, Marketing, Product and Engineering teams on how the product is being bought and used (across PLG and SLG channels)
Connect the user journey across the Emulator, CLI, VS Code extension, console, docs site, website, offering a 360 degree customer view view into customer behaviour (for all types: human, CI, AI agent) and composites (e.g. human + AI)
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes that impact the product success
Understand how data currently flows at LocalStack and work with technical teams to develop enrichment to deliver the product analytics vision
Develop insights that prove out the value proposition / ROI for customers in collaboration with customers and customer facing teams


✅ Specialist Skills/ Experience


7+ years in data analytics role with a strong focus on product analytics
Experience modelling a unified system, showcasing architecture level thinking
Strong experience with complex SQL and ideally programming languages such as Python.
Experience with web and product analytics tools such as Posthog, GA4, Segment, RudderStack, Heap, Amplitude, Contentsquare, or equivalent
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to quickly prototype and iterate across analysis, data modeling, instrumentation, visualization and code development.


🌱 Values we hold in LocalStack


Care: we create with compassion. We prioritize empathy and understanding in every interaction. By genuinely caring for our team, customers, and community, we create an environment where people thrive and impactful work flourishes
Ownership: we own the outcome. We take responsibility for our work and are passionate about its impact. We foster autonomy, inspire ambition, encourage ownership, and empower everyone to unlock their potential and make an impact.
Openness: we build trust together. We build trust through open communication and honest feedback. By sharing ideas and embracing diverse perspectives, we create stronger, more connected teams that work toward shared goals.
Courage: we dare to innovate. We embrace bold challenges and take calculated risks to move the needle. We step outside our comfort zones, experiment fearlessly, and turn setbacks into springboards for growth.
Excellence: we chase the extraordinary. We chase excellence by pushing boundaries and delivering results that go beyond the ordinary, constantly raising the bar and striving for greatness in everything we do. Excellence is not just the outcome, itʼs how we approach every task with purpose, passion, and a commitment to delivering exceptional value.


🎁 Benefits we offer:


Fully remote
Competitive salary
Annual company retreat
2 extra company-wide holidays
Friendly and inclusive workplace culture (community guilds and online company events)
Yearly bonus


Sounds like a good match?

We'd love to hear from you! Join us in shaping the future of cloud development at LocalStack.

To apply, follow the application process. Make sure to include a short motivation outlining why you are the perfect candidate for this role.

If your profile looks like a good match, our talent team will be in touch to organize further steps within 2 weeks.

Please note, that due to a high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate.

Compensation Range: £70K - £90K

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Ogury

Ogury is a global adtech company powered by Persona Intelligence, its proprietary technology that enables brands and agencies to activate consistent persona-based strategies across channels and drive measurable brand outcomes.

Founded in 2014, Ogury operates in 18 countries with over 400 employees worldwide.

At Ogury, our vision unites us all . But we know that it takes people from all walks of life to come together and make it happen. We embrace and celebrate what makes us different , creating a unique and winning culture where everyone feels safe , has access to the same opportunities , and is excited about bringing their most authentic self to work. Everyday.

Together we’re changing the face of adtech with values that inspire excellence, standards that encourage a leadership mindset, and an inclusive workplace where Ogurians are engaged and know they belong .

Working at Ogury

At Ogury , we pledge to provide all our team members with an equitable voice across our company and community. We understand that to have Ogurians who are engaged, respected , and who feel proud to belong, means creating a safe space where everyone feels comfortable bringing their most authentic selves to work. Everyday.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior Data Analyst to specialize in our advertising platform reporting and analytics. In this role, you will bridge the gap between data and execution, supporting our Product and Client Services teams by building scalable, automated reporting solutions.

As a key member of our Global Analytics Team, you will look beyond daily reporting to champion data governance, data quality, and scalable data modeling. You will collaborate closely with Data Reporting and Platform Engineering teams, utilizing dbt to build robust, reliable data models that serve as the foundation for global business decisions.

Why you'll love this role


Build systems that scale — Design and own automated reporting solutions that serve the entire organization; move beyond ad-hoc analysis to engineer production-grade data models with dbt that become the trusted foundation for critical business decisions
Work with a modern analytics stack — Partner with top-tier data infrastructure (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse) and best-in-class tools; solve complex optimization problems with large-scale clickstream and transactional datasets while championing data governance standards across a global team
Drive impact across the business — Act as the analytical bridge between Product, Client Services, and Platform Engineering; translate your insights into tangible outcomes that optimize ad revenue, improve user experience, and directly influence how the platform evolves


What You Will Be Doing

Job Description

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.



Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.*



Your daily adventure:



Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.
Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.
Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from.
Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization.
Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio.
Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices.
Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization.
Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.
Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights.
Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI/GenAI trends.
Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team.



Qualifications

YOUR SKILLS



Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.
5+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry.
Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis.
Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.
Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).
Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.
Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.
Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.
Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.
Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.



Nice to Have:



Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.
Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences).
Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).
Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.
Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.
Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.



Additional Information

YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)



Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery).
Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
Personal Matters Hours: 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day on your Ubi-Birthday.
5 extra holiday days on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
Life Insurance with AXA.
Mobile Device Grant of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
Language training in English, Spanish, and French.
Professional development training & programs, based upon request.
Ubisoft games are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
Locally roasted craft coffee by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).



Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.
