Title: Data Analyst Demand Planning
Description:
Job Summary

Are you passionate about transforming data into actionable insights that improve planning performance and drive better business decisions?

We are looking for a Data Analyst – Demand Planning to support our global planning organization through advanced analytics, performance reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives. In this role, you will partner with Demand Planning, Commercial, Supply Planning, Finance, Information Technology, and external stakeholders to deliver meaningful insights that enhance forecast accuracy, business performance, and planning maturity. The position supports a fully remote working model and offers the opportunity to contribute to global transformation and data-driven decision-making initiatives.

Job Description

Global Operations

Ensuring excellence in execution across the value chain through operational effectiveness, supply chain performance, quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Team Description

You will join a collaborative, analytical, and globally connected planning organization focused on enabling smarter business decisions through data, insights, and performance management. The team partners across regions, functions, and business units to improve planning outcomes, strengthen forecasting capabilities, and support business growth through fact-based decision-making.

Where You'll Make a Difference


Monitor and analyze demand planning performance indicators, including Forecast Accuracy, Forecast Bias, Forecast Value Add, and other planning metrics.
Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, reports, and performance monitoring solutions that support business reviews and decision-making.
Perform root cause analysis on forecast deviations, planning gaps, and operational performance issues to identify improvement opportunities.
Analyze demand patterns, customer trends, product performance, and key business drivers to generate actionable insights.
Consolidate and validate data from multiple sources while ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of planning information.
Support monthly Demand Review and business review processes through data-driven recommendations and performance reporting.
Partner with planners, commercial teams, finance, supply planning, and technology stakeholders on reporting, analytics, and planning initiatives.
Contribute to planning transformations, new capability deployments, process improvements, testing activities, and business adoption efforts.
Document reporting methodologies, key performance indicator definitions, governance standards, and analytical processes.


What Makes You The Right Fit


Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related analytical discipline.
Experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, or a related field.
Strong experience working with large datasets, reporting solutions, and performance measurement frameworks.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Experience using Power BI or similar business intelligence and data visualization tools.
Knowledge of data analysis, dashboard development, reporting automation, and performance management.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex insights for diverse stakeholders.
Fluent written and verbal English communication skills.


How Would You Stand Out


Experience with SAP Integrated Business Planning (SAP IBP) Demand Planning.
Knowledge of Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), and Demand Review processes.
Experience with SQL and advanced data querying techniques.
Familiarity with forecasting performance metrics, including Forecast Accuracy, Forecast Bias, and Forecast Value Add.
Experience within global, matrixed organizations supporting cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience supporting OTC Scent & Taste and/or PWB business processes.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At LittleBig Connection, we firmly believe in the transformative power of data analytics and AI to enhance business operations, drive informed decision-making and foster sustainable business growth.

To reinforce our young and ambitious Data and AI team we are seeking an experienced Data Analyst. You will own the semantic layer of our data platform: the models, metrics and definitions that the whole company relies on. Beyond reporting, you will be expected to explain what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next and what should be done about it. You will collaborate closely with key business stakeholders (Financial Partners, Head of Business, Product Managers) to develop impactful analytics solutions.




Key Responsibilities:




Design, build and maintain the semantic model of the platform with dbt: staging, marts, metrics, tests and documentation.
Own the definition of business metrics and make sure they are consistent, documented and unique across all consumption surfaces.
Contribute to data governance: ownership, naming conventions, data contracts, catalog and quality standards on the analytics layer.
Run diagnostic analyses: identify root causes behind business variations rather than only reporting them.
Build predictive analyses (forecasting, scoring, propensity) to anticipate business and product trends.
Turn those insights into prescriptive recommendations: scenarios, simulations and actionable next steps for stakeholders.
Deliver reporting and visualizations where they are the right answer, on top of the semantic model rather than beside it.
Collaborate with the data engineering team on pipelines and modelling, and act as a referent on analytics practices within the team.




Ideal profile:




Master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, IT, or related field
At least 3 years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or related fields
Advanced SQL, and hands-on production experience with dbt
Strong background in data modelling: dimensional modelling, semantic layers, metric definitions
Comfortable with Python for statistical and predictive work
Experience with data governance practices (documentation, ownership, data quality)
Working knowledge of cloud-based data platforms, preferably Azure Databricks, and of a visualization tool (e.g. Microsoft Power BI)
Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving aptitude, and a high standard of rigor and precision
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike
Proactive and entrepreneurial, you are embracing challenges with enthusiasm
Fluent in English, both written and spoken




If you are interested in working in a fast growing company, on unique and innovative projects where you can use your creativity, this opportunity is tailored for you!




What We Offer




Grow your career in the new world of digital business.
Lead high-value strategic projects with a tangible business impact.
Work in a young, international, and multicultural environment, with teams across five continents.
Enjoy a flexible working environment, including hybrid work options.
Access a wide range of learning and development opportunities to continuously grow your skills.
Take part in the LittleBig Crew experience through afterworks, team-building activities, and internal and external events.




Diversity & Inclusion




LittleBig Connection is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to promoting diversity within our teams and fostering an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, ethnic origin, religion, age, marital status, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.




Who are we?




The world of work is changing faster than ever. Companies need increasingly specialized expertise, while freelancers, consulting firms, and niche experts are reshaping the way organizations collaborate.




At LittleBig Connection, part of Mantu, our mission is simple: to create a direct, transparent, and efficient link between large organizations and the external experts who help them deliver their most important projects.




Through our international marketplace, we enable companies to quickly access the expertise they need, wherever they are. We help them identify, select, and contract with external experts while ensuring simplicity, compliance, and security throughout the process.




Today, LittleBig Connection brings together more than 400 employees across 50 countries, operates through 12 international offices, and facilitates over €500 million worth of projects every year through its platform.




Thousands of professionals from leading organizations rely on LittleBig Connection to collaborate with freelancers, consulting firms, and specialized experts around the world.




Joining LittleBig Connection means helping shape a new way for companies and experts to work together. It also means growing within an international, entrepreneurial, and fast-moving environment where ownership, accountability, transparency, and teamwork are part of everyday life.




At LittleBig Connection, everyone is encouraged to take initiative, create tangible impact, and contribute to a shared ambition: connecting the best expertise with the projects that matter most.




Team up with the world.

Title: Senior Web Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
BESTSECRET is the leading European online destination for premium and luxury off-price fashion. The Group offers its members in 28 countries across Europe a superior brand portfolio complemented by a high-end shopping experience. At the same time, BESTSECRET enables its brand partners to clear overstock at scale with minimum visibility and maximum brand equity protection. The unique business model is based on its closed character with an invitation-only customer membership, longstanding brand partner and customer relationships, combined with a tech-focused mindset. BESTSECRET has a strong track record of profitable growth over many years. It generated revenues of EUR 1,533.7 million in 2025 and employs around 2,200 people from over 90 nations. The Group draws on a heritage of 100 years in the textile and fashion industry and today is owned by Permira Funds and the founding families Schustermann and Borenstein.

Join our growing tech hub in Málaga and become part of an international team driving data-informed decision-making across BESTSECRET. As a Senior Web Data Analyst, you will be a core member of the Onsite Analytics team, working alongside the Director and 3 Senior peers to deliver critical insights that shape our business strategy. You'll own complex data projects from conception to delivery, translating raw data into actionable intelligence that empowers stakeholders across buying, product, and commercial teams.

In this role, you'll bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business impact, ensuring that our premium fashion platform leverages data as a competitive advantage. Your work will directly influence purchasing decisions, optimize member experiences, and support the scaling of our profitable growth model.

Your Responsibilities


Design, build, and optimize data models and pipelines using SQL and Python to support analytics workflows at scale.
Develop and maintain Business Intelligence visualizations and dashboards that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Plan and execute A/B testing frameworks to validate hypotheses and measure impact across product and commercial initiatives.
Coordinate analytics projects with cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear insights for non-technical audiences.
Manage Big Data workflows and ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across our platform.
Take ownership of analytical challenges, demonstrating initiative in problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Contribute to team culture through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and mentoring of junior team members.


Your Qualifications


3–5 years of professional experience with SQL and Python in a data analytics or data engineering role.
Proven expertise in data modelling and the ability to design scalable data structures.
Strong hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools and creating impactful visualizations.
Demonstrated proficiency with A/B testing, including experimental design and statistical validation.
Experience with Git version control and collaborative development practices.
Solid background with Big Data workflows and distributed data processing.
Excellent project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to non-technical partners.
Self-directed learner with a proactive, critical mindset and strong agile working mentality.
Fluent English skills (written and spoken).
Experience with data orchestration tools (Cron, Apache Airflow) is a plus.
Knowledge of dbt or similar data transformation frameworks is a plus.
Familiarity with tools like Power BI, Growthbook, Jira, or Confluence is a plus.
Background in statistics or quantitative research is a strong plus.
Experience implementing AI agents or modern AI tools in analytical workflows is a plus.


Our Benefits


Employee discount on our platform
Access to a corporate benefits platform with discounts on travel, hotels, electronics, and more
Private healthcare (tax-free), with the option to include your family
30 days of paid vacation per year plus local bank holidays
Hybrid work model (1–2 days per week in the office in Málaga)
Flexible working hours with core collaboration time (10:00 – 16:00)
Tailored development opportunities, including “TechFriday” – a monthly day dedicated to learning and innovation
Reduced working hours in August (summer schedule)
Choice of equipment: MacBook or Windows laptop
;

Title: Senior Mobility Data Analyst
Description:
Somos una compañía global especializada en la distribución eficiente de vehículos, con más de 47 años de experiencia en el sector de la automoción, con origen y sede central en Madrid, España.

Nuestro enfoque de negocio, combina un profundo conocimiento de la industria, tecnología propia, digitalización e inteligencia de datos para entender las necesidades reales de movilidad y ofrecer soluciones flexibles y personalizadas a particulares, empresas y administraciones públicas.

Move. It’s your right.

Astara Intelligence

En Astara Intelligence transformamos datos en decisiones de negocio para el sector de la movilidad. Somos la unidad de analítica y consultoría de Astara, compañía global de movilidad, y trabajamos con clientes públicos y privados en proyectos de movilidad inteligente, estrategia, datos e innovación.

Buscamos un/a consultor especialista en análisis de datos de movilidad para incorporarse al equipo de consultoría de movilidad en ASTARA Intelligence (Advisory). Participarás en proyectos de consultoría de movilidad, analizando datos, estructurando problemas complejos y preparando recomendaciones claras para cliente.

Main Functions/Responsibilities


Analizar datos de movilidad, demanda, territorio, usuarios, operaciones y mercado.
Apoyar proyectos de consultoría en movilidad urbana, transporte, smart cities y nuevos modelos de servicio.
Construir análisis, modelos y dashboards en Excel, Power BI, Python, SQL u otras herramientas.
Preparar informes, presentaciones y visualizaciones para cliente, en español e inglés.
Definir KPIs, escenarios, diagnósticos y recomendaciones estratégicas.
Colaborar con consultores/as, analistas, diseñadores/as y perfiles técnicos en proyectos end-to-end.
Explorar el uso de IA y automatización para acelerar research y análisis.


Professional Experience/Qualifications


+5 años de experiencia en consultoría, analítica, movilidad, transporte, smart cities, estrategia y/o data analytics.
Formación en Ingeniería, Economía, Data Science, Estadística, Matemáticas, Urbanismo, Transporte o similar.
Nivel experto de Excel y experiencia en analisis de bases de datos complejas.
Conocimiento experto de Power BI, Tableau, Looker o herramientas similares.
Inglés profesional, escrito y hablado (nivel C1-C2)
Capacidad para estructurar problemas ambiguos, extraer insights y comunicarlos con claridad
Excelente comunicación oral (presentación) y escrita (redacción de documentos)
Interés real por la movilidad, las ciudades, la tecnología y los datos

Title: Senior Data Analyst: Multiple Teams
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Analyst: Multiple Teams based in Spain.

You will work at the intersection of data, product, and machine learning, helping teams turn complex datasets into actionable business and product insights.

Your analysis will support a range of teams working across data science, ranking, recommendations, personalization, AI-powered shopping, search optimization, and retail media.

You will investigate user behavior, identify opportunities, and evaluate how product changes affect both customer experience and business performance.

A key part of the role will be designing experiments, defining meaningful metrics, and using statistical analysis to guide product decisions.

You will work with large-scale datasets using SQL and Python while building dashboards and analytical tools that make data accessible to decision-makers.

The role offers broad exposure to engineers, data scientists, product managers, customers, and business stakeholders.

You will join a collaborative, fast-moving environment where analytical thinking, ownership, clear communication, and measurable impact are highly valued.

Accountabilities


Analyze user behavior and large-scale datasets to uncover patterns, identify issues, and surface opportunities for product and business improvement.
Design, run, and analyze A/B tests to evaluate product changes and quantify their impact on key business metrics.
Define, validate, and monitor metrics that capture both user experience and business outcomes.
Build dashboards, reports, analytical tools, and other data resources that support informed decision-making across multiple teams.
Partner with engineers, data scientists, product managers, customers, and business stakeholders to translate analytical findings into actionable product improvements.
Investigate product funnels, performance trends, and user behavior to identify opportunities for optimization.
Apply SQL, Python, and distributed data systems to process, explore, and analyze large volumes of data.
Contribute analytical expertise across different domains, which may include data science integrations, ranking, recommendations, AI shopping agents, search optimization, personalization, and retail media.
Help teams understand machine learning-related data, including training data quality, model evaluation, and relevant performance metrics.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly, adapting the level of technical detail to different audiences and stakeholders.
Take ownership of analytical projects from problem definition and investigation through to recommendations and measurable outcomes.


Requirements


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated experience using data to address business and product questions.
Solid knowledge of SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets.
Professional experience using Python for data analysis, including tools such as pandas, NumPy, and data visualization libraries.
Good understanding of A/B testing, experimentation methodologies, and core statistical concepts.
Experience defining and analyzing product metrics, metric trees, funnels, and other frameworks for measuring product performance.
Understanding of machine learning pipelines, training data quality, and model evaluation.
Familiarity with search relevance, ranking, or recommendation systems is a plus.
Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable collaborating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Ability to work autonomously, take ownership of projects, and proactively identify opportunities to improve products and processes.
Experience in a customer-facing role is a plus.
Previous experience in e-commerce or product analytics is a plus.


Benefits


Fully remote working environment, giving you flexibility over where you live and work.
Unlimited vacation time, with employees strongly encouraged to take at least 3 weeks per year.
Work-from-home stipend to help you create an effective home-office setup.
Apple laptop provided for new employees.
Annual training and professional development budget.
Maternity and paternity leave for eligible employees.
Opportunity to work with talented and empathetic colleagues while contributing to meaningful, high-impact projects.
Regular team offsite events to connect and collaborate.
Base salary of $80,000–$120,000 USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results.
Stock options offered in addition to the base salary.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). Title: Data Analyst (with focus on AI)
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Role purpose

We are looking to add to the Analytics team a profile 100% focused on data analysis and business impact, with a strong sensitivity towards the world of applied Artificial Intelligence, capable of transforming complex data into actionable insights, driving continuous improvement, and clearly communicating conclusions in an executive manner to different stakeholders.

We are not looking for a purely academic or AI research profile, but for someone who knows how to use AI as a lever to elevate analysis quality, accelerate insight generation, and improve decision-making.




Key Responsibilities

Analyze large volumes of data to identify patterns, root causes, and improvement opportunities with direct business impact.
Generate actionable insights by connecting technical metrics with business KPIs and strategic objectives.
Apply AI / advanced analytics techniques (predictive models, clustering, analysis automation, insight generation, etc.) with a practical, results-oriented approach.
Drive continuous improvement by proposing hypotheses, tests, and data-driven recommendations.
Design and create executive presentations (slides, dashboards, one-pagers) for committees and senior stakeholders, with clear, structured, and decision-oriented messaging.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (product, technology, operations, business), acting as a bridge between data and decision-making.
Explore and propose new use cases of AI applied to data analysis, maintaining a pragmatic innovation mindset.




Profile we are looking for

Degree in quantitative fields: Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar.
Strong experience in data analysis and interpretation of business KPIs.
Knowledge and practical experience with analytics tools (SQL, Python, Power BI / Tableau or similar).
Interest and experience in applying AI techniques and advanced models, always with a business focus (not an academic profile).
High ability to synthesize complex information and convert it into clear messages for non-technical audiences.
Experience creating executive presentations and presenting conclusions to senior stakeholders.
Continuous improvement mindset, critical thinking, and impact orientation.
Strong communication skills, autonomy, and an end-to-end vision of data.
Fluent in English and Spanish (C1+), with experience working in international and cross-functional environments




Nice to have

Experience using AI to automate analysis, generate insights, or improve analytical efficiency.
Knowledge of cloud environments, large-scale data management, or analytical pipelines.
Previous experience in product, operations, or business environments.
Ability to prioritize and focus analysis on what truly drives impact.




What We Offer

A role with real impact on business decisions.
An environment where AI is applied in a practical, not experimental, way.
Direct participation in decision-making forums and strategic projects.
A highly skilled team with a collaborative mindset.
Opportunity to grow at the intersection of data, AI, and business.







Strong fit with our Company DNA

Passionate in Everything We Do: Our people bring a contagious energy and a sense of urgency that is unmistakable. We create a vision and inspire others around that vision with full engagement and focus. We are all-in, and we love what we do.

Committed to Making a Difference: We are courageous, we deliver what we promise through hard work and resilience. We make a difference, through operating with discipline and doing what is needed. We are hands-on, and we aren’t afraid to get into the detail. We deliver results and we execute with excellence.

Always Innovating: Our people make the impossible possible; it’s a continuous state of mind. We are purpose-driven, curious and we challenge the status quo. We believe good ideas travel, we share and reapply. We take smart risks, and we are not afraid to fail. We believe innovation can be big or small.

Winning as a Team: We are determined to become number 1, and to do that we need to listen to one another, collaborate and work together. We play our part, fueled by a winning attitude and a fighting spirit. We celebrate our successes. We play to our strengths and our diversity to deliver even better outcomes, while developing and supporting one another. We believe that together we go further, and that nothing is impossible.

With Trust & Responsibility: Our people take responsibility for the people we protect. We are accountable and reliable. We role model operating with integrity. We trust and empower one another to do the right thing, always. We deliver on our promise through world-class expertise and meticulous know-how. And, we do this with humility while being honoured to play such an important role in society.




At Verisure, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, recognising that diversity of thought and background only makes our teams stronger and more innovative. We reject all forms of discrimination and bias, and we believe in access to opportunities for everyone, regardless of gender, age, disability status, race, sexual orientation, or any other status.

We review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position once we find the right candidate. To ensure consideration, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.




Feel free to get in touch with me at enrique.barajasluque@verisure.es. I’d be happy to tell you more about the role and Verisure!

Hands‑on experience with analytical tools (e.g. SQL, Python, R, BI tools).
Comfortable working independently with low stakeholder exposure in an internal, product‑focused environment.
Loves problem solving.
Individual contributor with full ownership of projects.
Proficiency in English is a must.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations Analytics | €47K - €60K
Description:
A platform we collaborate with at Joppy is looking to hire a Senior Data Analyst to partner with Operations and Product teams, turning complex business challenges into clear analysis and strategic recommendations that improve customer experience.




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Operations Analytics team in Barcelona. You will partner closely with Rover’s Operations org, driving initiatives and supporting analytics towards furthering customer experience. This is a high-visibility role involving direct collaboration with a diverse set of stakeholders to define, measure, test and improve the success of customer experience programs and product developments. A key component of this position will be providing product analytics support for our Bookings Confidence team, which aims to tackle customer service improvements through product developments.




The ideal candidate is a passionate problem-solver who comfortably translates ambiguous business challenges into clear questions, deep analysis, and strategic recommendations that drive action.




You’ll be joining an international team, reporting to a Barcelona based Analytics manager, with colleagues and stakeholders split between Barcelona and Seattle. This is a hybrid role: we're in our Poblenou office two days a week (Mondays and Thursdays), so you'll need to be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.







Your Responsibilities:

Thought Partnership: Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, making data-driven recommendations on optimization strategies within customer experience.
Experimentation: Partner with Product Managers, designers and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments in support of product developments.
Strategic Planning & Measurement: Partner with Ops Program leadership to define the strategy for measuring program health and operational performance, including establishing comprehensive metrics, developing crisp reporting, and setting up monitoring rhythms.
Performance Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of key CX (Customer Experience) operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities, which will inform deeper research and analytical efforts.
Executive Communication: Develop and present crisp narratives resulting from analytics findings and investigations to senior Operations leaders, focusing on both identified problems and proposed solutions.
Data Infrastructure Support: Support the construction and maintenance of our core reporting abstractions (built in dbt), BI reporting and AI semantic layers




What we're looking for (must-haves):




At least 4 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
You are extremely comfortable with receiving stakeholder questions and independently translating them into clear, actionable analytical problems to solve, all with relative autonomy.
You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists




Nice to Have:




Master’s degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
Ability to code in Python/R
Hands on experience leveraging AI tools for analytics
Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
Hands-on experience in workforce forecasting




Compensation:




In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €47,124 - €60,319. Additionally, we offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees.

The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Ogury

Ogury is a global adtech company powered by Persona Intelligence, its proprietary technology that enables brands and agencies to activate consistent persona-based strategies across channels and drive measurable brand outcomes.

Founded in 2014, Ogury operates in 18 countries with over 400 employees worldwide.

At Ogury, our vision unites us all . But we know that it takes people from all walks of life to come together and make it happen. We embrace and celebrate what makes us different , creating a unique and winning culture where everyone feels safe , has access to the same opportunities , and is excited about bringing their most authentic self to work. Everyday.

Together we’re changing the face of adtech with values that inspire excellence, standards that encourage a leadership mindset, and an inclusive workplace where Ogurians are engaged and know they belong .

Working at Ogury

At Ogury , we pledge to provide all our team members with an equitable voice across our company and community. We understand that to have Ogurians who are engaged, respected , and who feel proud to belong, means creating a safe space where everyone feels comfortable bringing their most authentic selves to work. Everyday.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior Data Analyst to specialize in our advertising platform reporting and analytics. In this role, you will bridge the gap between data and execution, supporting our Product and Client Services teams by building scalable, automated reporting solutions.

As a key member of our Global Analytics Team, you will look beyond daily reporting to champion data governance, data quality, and scalable data modeling. You will collaborate closely with Data Reporting and Platform Engineering teams, utilizing dbt to build robust, reliable data models that serve as the foundation for global business decisions.

Why you'll love this role


Build systems that scale — Design and own automated reporting solutions that serve the entire organization; move beyond ad-hoc analysis to engineer production-grade data models with dbt that become the trusted foundation for critical business decisions
Work with a modern analytics stack — Partner with top-tier data infrastructure (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse) and best-in-class tools; solve complex optimization problems with large-scale clickstream and transactional datasets while championing data governance standards across a global team
Drive impact across the business — Act as the analytical bridge between Product, Client Services, and Platform Engineering; translate your insights into tangible outcomes that optimize ad revenue, improve user experience, and directly influence how the platform evolves


What You Will Be Doing


Ad Platform Reporting & Scalability: Design, develop, and scale automated dashboards and analytics solutions that provide deep insights into ad platform performance, campaign delivery, and user engagement for both Product and Client Services teams.
Global Data Governance & Quality: Serve as a core member of the Global Analytics team, leading initiatives to define data standards, enforce data quality checks, and document data lineages to ensure a trusted, single source of truth.
Data Modeling with dbt: Partner with Data Reporting and Platform teams to build, maintain, and optimize production-grade data models using dbt, ensuring efficient transformations and analytics-ready datasets.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the analytical partner to Product Managers (to guide feature development) and Client Services (to provide scalable client-facing insights and automate ad-hoc requests).
Advanced Analytics & Insights: Go beyond standard metrics to uncover trends, identify platform inefficiencies, and provide actionable recommendations that optimize ad revenue and user experience.


What You Will Bring To Ogury


Experience: 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Analytics Engineering, ideally within an AdTech
Data Modeling & dbt: Proven hands-on experience using dbt to develop, test, and deploy scalable data models in a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse).
SQL Mastery: Expert-level SQL skills, including writing highly optimized, complex queries and managing large-scale, clickstream, or transactional datasets.
Scalable BI & Visualization: Advanced proficiency in building scalable, intuitive dashboards in modern BI tools (e.g.Omni, Tableau, Looker, Power BI) tailored for both internal product tracking and external client services.
Data Governance Focus: Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, data governance principles, and version control (Git).
Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of translating complex technical metrics into scalable solutions for product teams and business clients.


How Ogury Supports You

At Ogury, we believe in taking care of our team members and providing a work environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.

While benefits may vary by location, here’s a glimpse of what you can typically expect when you join our team:


A competitive compensation package
Comprehensive benefits coverage
Meal voucher
Holiday and leave allowance, in addition to national holidays
A strong focus on the well-being of our team members, with access to both physical and mental health resources
Flexible Working Model: At Ogury, we believe in the power of presence to fuel innovation. Our hybrid approach is centered on two core in-office collaboration days to drive team synergy, plus one additional office day of your choosing to support personal balance. This 3-day baseline ensures strong connection and real-time problem-solving, while allowing for flexibility across the rest of the week.
And more


We thank you in advance for your interest in Ogury!

Our Commitment

At Ogury, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace by providing equal employment opportunities to all. We will consider all qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive candidate experience. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please contact us. In accordance with applicable laws, we will work with you to provide reasonable support and ensure a fair hiring process.

Please note that this position is for an existing vacancy and is open to all qualified candidates.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
1. Propósito del Puesto (Misión)

Garantizar la explotación estratégica de la información y la evolución del entorno de datos en Netquest, identificando oportunidades de mejora, desarrollando herramientas analíticas y siendo una pieza técnica clave para la toma de decisiones basadas en datos.




2. Responsabilidades Principales

Interpretar datos e indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPI) para ayudar a la empresa a maximizar el valor de la información.
Colaborar con diferentes áreas de negocio para definir y priorizar necesidades de información.
Proporcionar soluciones de informes y herramientas de BI para partes interesadas internas y externas.
Desarrollar y mantener cuadros de mando (dashboards) en herramientas de BI (ej. Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau).
Manipular datos y realizar análisis ad-hoc utilizando Python y consultas avanzadas en SQL.
Identificar, analizar e interpretar patrones y tendencias en grandes volúmenes de datos (millones de registros).
Monitorizar fuentes de datos y colaborar con Data Engineers para resolver inconsistencias y garantizar las políticas de calidad.
Trabajar de manera colaborativa dentro del área de Datos con Data Scientists, Data Engineers y otros analistas.




3. Relaciones Clave (Interfaces)

Internas: Equipo de Datos (Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics) y responsables de diversas áreas de negocio.
Externas: Clientes y colaboradores externos receptores de herramientas de análisis o informes ad-hoc.




4. Requisitos del Perfil

Formación y Experiencia:
Educación: Grado Universitario en Ingeniería, Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, Informática o campo cuantitativo similar.
Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años de experiencia previa desempeñando funciones como Data Analyst.
Conocimientos Técnicos e Idiomas:
Dominio de Python (librerías como pandas, polars, numpy, matplotlib, ggplot, seaborn).
Sólidos conocimientos y optimización en SQL.
Experiencia en herramientas de Business Intelligence (Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI).
Idiomas: Fluidez en inglés (comunicación verbal y escrita clara).
Valorables: Experiencia en servicios Cloud (especialmente AWS) y herramientas de gestión de datos como dbt.
Competencias Y Habilidades:
Excelente pensamiento analítico y capacidad para la resolución de problemas.
Habilidades de storytelling para comunicar hallazgos complejos de forma sencilla.
Trabajo en equipo, adaptabilidad y enfoque orientado a la calidad de los datos.




5. Qué Ofrecemos

Ubicación: Barcelona
Modelo de trabajo: Híbrido (2 días en la oficina y 3 días de teletrabajo)
Beneficios sociales:
Contrato indefinido.
Seguro médico privado con cuadro médico o reembolso (50% cubierto para el empleado).
Plan de retribución flexible: vales de comida (tickets restaurante), transporte y guardería.
Horario flexible (entrada de 8:00 a 10:00, salida de 17:00 a 19:00) y viernes de jornada intensiva.




6. Igualdad de Oportunidades

En Netquest, nos enorgullece ser una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y tenemos el compromiso de crear un entorno inclusivo para todos nuestros empleados, independientemente de su género, edad, origen, nacionalidad, raza, religión, orientación sexual o discapacidad.

1. Purpose of the Role (Mission)

Ensure the strategic exploitation of information and the evolution of Netquest's data ecosystem, identifying improvement opportunities, developing analytical tools, and serving as a key technical contributor for data-driven decision-making.




2. Key Responsibilities

Interpret data and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to help the organization leverage its data assets effectively.
Partner with various business units to define and prioritize reporting and data needs.
Provide reporting solutions and BI tools to support decision-making for both internal and external stakeholders.
Build and maintain accurate, user-friendly dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau).
Manipulate data for ad-hoc queries and reporting using Python and advanced SQL.
Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns within large and complex datasets (millions of records).
Monitor data sources and collaborate with Data Engineers to resolve discrepancies and uphold Data Quality standards.
Work collaboratively with the broader Data team (Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and fellow Data Analysts).




3. Key Interfaces

Internal: Data team (Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics) and key business department stakeholders.
External: External clients or partners receiving analytical tools and ad-hoc reporting.




4. Requirements & Profile

Education & Experience:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Experience: At least 2 years of proven experience in a Data Analyst role.
Technical Skills & Languages:
Proficiency in Python (including libraries such as pandas, polars, numpy, matplotlib, ggplot, seaborn).
Strong SQL knowledge and query optimization.
Experience with BI tools (Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI).
Languages: Fluent in English with clear communication skills.
Desirable: Cloud experience (especially AWS) and data management tools like dbt.
Behavioral Skills:
Excellent analytical mindset and problem-solving abilities.
Strong storytelling skills to effectively present insights.
Team player with high attention to detail and a commitment to data quality.




5. What We Offer

Workplace Model: Hybrid model (2 days in the office, 3 days working from home)
Benefits:
Permanent contract.
Private health insurance with medical network or reimbursement (50% covered by the company).
Flexible compensation plan: meal vouchers, transportation, childcare.
Flexible working hours (start between 8:00–10:00 AM, finish between 5:00–7:00 PM) and intensive workdays on Fridays.




6. Equal Opportunity

At Netquest, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

Ensure the strategic exploitation of information and the evolution of Netquest's data ecosystem, identifying improvement opportunities, developing analytical tools, and serving as a key technical contributor for data-driven decision-making.

  • Interpret data and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to help the organization leverage its data assets effectively.
  • Partner with various business units to define and prioritize reporting and data needs.

  • Build and maintain accurate, user-friendly dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau).

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Thunes

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments globally. Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Miami, Johannesburg, Riyadh, San Francisco and Atlanta For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

Context of the role

We are looking for a driven and product-minded BI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in solving real business problems through data.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decision-making across the business. You will help identify product and operational pain points, improve day-to-day insight consumption for internal teams, and contribute to a strong data informed culture across the company.

You will work closely with data engineers to design, build, and maintain analytical solutions for key internal stakeholders across different functions, that improves our productivity, business performance, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
Build a strong understanding of key business processes, product flows, operational challenges, and performance metrics.
Design, develop, and maintain production-grade dashboards, reports, and analytical assets using Tableau and other relevant tools.
Write production-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery.
Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure data sources are reliable, well-structured, and fit for analytical use.
Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team.
Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities.



Professional Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.
2-5 years of experience in a data, BI, analytics, or related role.
Strong hands-on experience writing production-level SQL.
Strong hands-on experience using Python for analysis, data processing, and analytical solution development.
Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management.
Proven ability to work with complex datasets and turn business questions into structured, actionable analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from stakeholder requests to practical data solutions.
Good understanding of reporting design, data visualisation best practices, and how to present insights clearly for business users.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.
Experience supporting multiple business functions and balancing different stakeholder needs in a structured way.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to gather requirements, align expectations, and communicate clearly throughout delivery.
Demonstrated business curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding how the business works beyond the data itself.
Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to work independently and follow through from problem understanding to solution delivery.

Title: Content Partners Data Analyst
Description:
Is this you?

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role Overview

We are looking for a Content Partners Data Analyst to analyse how advertising drives user acquisition, engagement and retention for streaming, CTV, gaming and other content-app brands.

This is a client-facing role combining strong SQL and data visualisation skills with deep knowledge of the content-app market. You will analyse advertising, audience and app-usage data, build clear measurement frameworks and dashboards, use AI tools to accelerate insight generation, and present actionable recommendations to clients and senior stakeholders.

Key responsibilities:


Measure Advertising Performance: Analyse campaign exposure and performance across CTV, streaming, gaming and other content-app environments
Connect Ads to Outcomes: Measure how campaigns influence app usage, acquisition, engagement, retention and re-engagement
Build Client Insights: Turn complex behavioural and advertising data into clear, commercially relevant stories and recommendations

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

THE WORLD OF UBISOFT

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

Job Description

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.



Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.*



Your daily adventure:



Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.
Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.
Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from.
Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization.
Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio.
Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices.
Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization.
Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.
Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights.
Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI/GenAI trends.
Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team.



Qualifications

YOUR SKILLS



Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.
5+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry.
Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis.
Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.
Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).
Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.
Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.
Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.
Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.
Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.



Nice to Have:



Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.
Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences).
Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).
Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.
Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.
Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.



Additional Information

YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)



Ticket Restaurant: 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery).
Flexible working hours: 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
Reduced schedule (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
Personal Matters Hours: 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day on your Ubi-Birthday.
5 extra holiday days on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
Health insurance with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
Life Insurance with AXA.
Mobile Device Grant of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
Language training in English, Spanish, and French.
Professional development training & programs, based upon request.
Ubisoft games are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
Locally roasted craft coffee by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).



Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Data Analyst

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our team. You will be leveraging data to generate impactful insights for strategic purposes. This is a pivotal position to bring the business to the next level, you will support one of our business domain teams using analytics to drive better decisions at Perk.

What you will do:


Work with other Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists and Engineers in our team to generate advanced analysis that answers key business questions and unlocks opportunities.
Explore data from different sources, turning it into information, information into insight and insight into decisions
Design and develop metrics, dashboards, experiments and analyses to track and assess the impact of new initiatives and features.
Develop data frameworks and products to drive insights and behavioural analysis.


What you need:


2+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in data analytics or data science role, including relevant tools, techniques and technology
Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken, in English


You will need to prove the following:


You are a Master using SQL for data querying, transformation and modelling - experience with dbt is a strong plus.
Experience with statistical concepts and packages (Python / R)
Experience with data visualisation and BI tools (Looker)
Data storytelling and stakeholder management experience
The desire to work in an international environment, with minimal direction, alongside highly engaged individuals.


AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Title: Senior Web Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
BESTSECRET is the leading European online destination for premium and luxury off-price fashion. The Group offers its members in 28 countries across Europe a superior brand portfolio complemented by a high-end shopping experience. At the same time, BESTSECRET enables its brand partners to clear overstock at scale with minimum visibility and maximum brand equity protection. The unique business model is based on its closed character with an invitation-only customer membership, longstanding brand partner and customer relationships, combined with a tech-focused mindset. BESTSECRET has a strong track record of profitable growth over many years. It generated revenues of EUR 1,533.7 million in 2025 and employs around 2,200 people from over 90 nations. The Group draws on a heritage of 100 years in the textile and fashion industry and today is owned by Permira Funds and the founding families Schustermann and Borenstein.

Join our growing tech hub in Málaga and become part of an international team driving data-informed decision-making across BESTSECRET. As a Senior Web Data Analyst, you will be a core member of the Onsite Analytics team, working alongside the Director and 3 Senior peers to deliver critical insights that shape our business strategy. You'll own complex data projects from conception to delivery, translating raw data into actionable intelligence that empowers stakeholders across buying, product, and commercial teams.

In this role, you'll bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business impact, ensuring that our premium fashion platform leverages data as a competitive advantage. Your work will directly influence purchasing decisions, optimize member experiences, and support the scaling of our profitable growth model.

Your Responsibilities


Design, build, and optimize data models and pipelines using SQL and Python to support analytics workflows at scale.
Develop and maintain Business Intelligence visualizations and dashboards that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Plan and execute A/B testing frameworks to validate hypotheses and measure impact across product and commercial initiatives.
Coordinate analytics projects with cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear insights for non-technical audiences.
Manage Big Data workflows and ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across our platform.
Take ownership of analytical challenges, demonstrating initiative in problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Contribute to team culture through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and mentoring of junior team members.


Your Qualifications


3–5 years of professional experience with SQL and Python in a data analytics or data engineering role.
Proven expertise in data modelling and the ability to design scalable data structures.
Strong hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools and creating impactful visualizations.
Demonstrated proficiency with A/B testing, including experimental design and statistical validation.
Experience with Git version control and collaborative development practices.
Solid background with Big Data workflows and distributed data processing.
Excellent project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to non-technical partners.
Self-directed learner with a proactive, critical mindset and strong agile working mentality.
Fluent English skills (written and spoken).
Experience with data orchestration tools (Cron, Apache Airflow) is a plus.
Knowledge of dbt or similar data transformation frameworks is a plus.
Familiarity with tools like Power BI, Growthbook, Jira, or Confluence is a plus.
Background in statistics or quantitative research is a strong plus.
Experience implementing AI agents or modern AI tools in analytical workflows is a plus.


Our Benefits


Employee discount on our platform
Access to a corporate benefits platform with discounts on travel, hotels, electronics, and more
Private healthcare (tax-free), with the option to include your family
30 days of paid vacation per year plus local bank holidays
Hybrid work model (1–2 days per week in the office in Málaga)
Flexible working hours with core collaboration time (10:00 – 16:00)
Tailored development opportunities, including “TechFriday” – a monthly day dedicated to learning and innovation
Reduced working hours in August (summer schedule)
Choice of equipment: MacBook or Windows laptop
;

Applicants from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are welcome to join us in our mission towards a more vibrant and inclusive future.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations Analytics | €47K - €60K
Description:
A platform we collaborate with at Joppy is looking to hire a Senior Data Analyst to partner with Operations and Product teams, turning complex business challenges into clear analysis and strategic recommendations that improve customer experience.




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Operations Analytics team in Barcelona. You will partner closely with Rover’s Operations org, driving initiatives and supporting analytics towards furthering customer experience. This is a high-visibility role involving direct collaboration with a diverse set of stakeholders to define, measure, test and improve the success of customer experience programs and product developments. A key component of this position will be providing product analytics support for our Bookings Confidence team, which aims to tackle customer service improvements through product developments.




The ideal candidate is a passionate problem-solver who comfortably translates ambiguous business challenges into clear questions, deep analysis, and strategic recommendations that drive action.




You’ll be joining an international team, reporting to a Barcelona based Analytics manager, with colleagues and stakeholders split between Barcelona and Seattle. This is a hybrid role: we're in our Poblenou office two days a week (Mondays and Thursdays), so you'll need to be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.







Your Responsibilities:

Thought Partnership: Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, making data-driven recommendations on optimization strategies within customer experience.
Experimentation: Partner with Product Managers, designers and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments in support of product developments.
Strategic Planning & Measurement: Partner with Ops Program leadership to define the strategy for measuring program health and operational performance, including establishing comprehensive metrics, developing crisp reporting, and setting up monitoring rhythms.
Performance Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of key CX (Customer Experience) operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities, which will inform deeper research and analytical efforts.
Executive Communication: Develop and present crisp narratives resulting from analytics findings and investigations to senior Operations leaders, focusing on both identified problems and proposed solutions.
Data Infrastructure Support: Support the construction and maintenance of our core reporting abstractions (built in dbt), BI reporting and AI semantic layers




What we're looking for (must-haves):




At least 4 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
You are extremely comfortable with receiving stakeholder questions and independently translating them into clear, actionable analytical problems to solve, all with relative autonomy.
You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists




Nice to Have:




Master’s degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
Ability to code in Python/R
Hands on experience leveraging AI tools for analytics
Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
Hands-on experience in workforce forecasting




Compensation:




In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €47,124 - €60,319. Additionally, we offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees.

The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.

  • Experimentation: Partner with Product Managers, designers and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments in support of product developments.
  • Strategic Planning & Measurement: Partner with Ops Program leadership to define the strategy for measuring program health and operational performance, including establishing comprehensive metrics, developing crisp reporting, and setting up monitoring rhythms.
  • Performance Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of key CX (Customer Experience) operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities, which will inform deeper research and analytical efforts.
  • Executive Communication: Develop and present crisp narratives resulting from analytics findings and investigations to senior Operations leaders, focusing on both identified problems and proposed solutions.
  • Data Infrastructure Support: Support the construction and maintenance of our core reporting abstractions (built in dbt), BI reporting and AI semantic layers


What we're looking for (must-haves):


  • At least 4 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
  • Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
  • You are extremely comfortable with receiving stakeholder questions and independently translating them into clear, actionable analytical problems to solve, all with relative autonomy.
  • You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
  • Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists


Nice to Have:


  • Master’s degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
  • Ability to code in Python/R
  • Hands on experience leveraging AI tools for analytics
  • Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
  • Hands-on experience in workforce forecasting


Compensation:


In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €47,124 - €60,319. Additionally, we offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees.

The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.
