Title: Senior Data Analyst - Expansion
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team

The Business Strategy Analytics team's mission is to transform data into strategic insights that empower our leaders to make informed decisions, effectively track progress, and unlock growth opportunities. Through deep metric understanding, holistic business views, and detailed analytics, we enable concrete actions that drive business success.

What You’ll Be Doing


Partner with Expansion leadership on major transformation initiatives shaping the value proposition, business model, customer experience, monetization strategy, and operational playbook for new geographies, segments, and product lines.
Evaluate and prioritize new market entries, customer segments, and strategic bets through rigorous market sizing, competitive benchmarking, and customer analysis
Run focused, data-driven deep dives into expansion-stage customer behavior, unit economics, funnel performance, and competitive dynamics to surface where to double down and where to pivot.
Lead cross-functional performance analyses across Expansion workstreams — surfacing trends, explaining the drivers behind new-market KPIs, and delivering clear, actionable insights to the executive team.
Build the analytical models that underpin Expansion decisions: market sizing and TAM/SAM/SOM models, ramp and forecasting models for new launches, scenario models to pressure-test strategic options, and financial models to quantify the upside (and downside) of each bet.


What You Need To Succeed


5+ years of experience in business analytics, product analytics, consulting, or a related analytical role.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, capable of influencing Leadership-level stakeholders.
Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
A proactive, curious mindset with a drive to investigate discrepancies and identify opportunities.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives.
Exceptional attention to detail and a rigorous, structured approach to analysis.
Proven Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills (e.g., driver-based modeling, sensitivity analysis, financial impact estimation).
Experience leading cross-functional analytics projects and engaging diverse stakeholders.


Nice to have


Experience in corporate strategy or strategic consulting, with a track record of supporting senior leadership on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives
Experience in fast-growing, data-driven startups, marketplaces, or subscription businesses
Hands-on experience with Looker and Snowflake


Why you’ll love it at Preply


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Title: Global Trade Operations - Data Analyst & Performance Monitoring
Description:
About The Job

As a Performance Monitoring and Reporting Specialist, you will produce critical KPIs and dashboards to support global trade strategies. You will work within the European Trade Finance Service Centre to drive efficiency and data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Produce and analyze recurrent reports and dashboards for main stakeholders.
Chair SLA meetings with internal Business, IT, and Operations teams.
Develop new indicators by identifying requirements and managing implementation.
Drive continuous improvement through automation and new technologies like Python or AI.


Profile & Skills


You have at least 5 years of experience in data analysis, transformation, and reporting roles.
You are an expert in Power Query, DAX, and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or Dataiku).
You possess proficiency in SQL, SSRS, and intermediate Python skills.
You have experience using AI solutions, including LLMs and prompting.
You are proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
You hold a C1 level of English (Mandatory).

Title: Analista de Datos Junior
Description:
¿Te gustaría unirte a un proyecto tecnológico puntero con un impacto positivo?




Desde Newtral nace Trueflag, una spin-off con el propósito de utilizar la IA como herramienta para combatir la desinformación y las fake news.




Estamos buscando a una persona que se incorpore como Data Analyst que combine la habilidad de manejar grandes volúmenes de datos con una fuerte orientación al negocio y al cliente.




¿Cuáles serían tus principales responsabilidades?

Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos provenientes de diversas fuentes para identificar tendencias, patrones e información relevante para los diferentes stakeholders.
Diseñar y construir informes y dashboards efectivos que comuniquen resultados de forma clara a los clientes y al equipo interno.
Buscar en los datos las historias que importan a cada cliente y convertirlas en entregables listos para enviar.
Identificar oportunidades de automatización en análisis de datos, informes y generación de alertas en tiempo real.
Garantizar la integridad y precisión de los datos mediante procesos de validación y limpieza.




¿Qué buscamos?

Formación en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas o similar.
Experiencia previa de +2 años en consultoría de BI o analista de datos. Importante haber trabajado con grandes volúmenes de datos.
Experiencia en análisis de datos, elaboración de informes y cuadros de mando.
Conocimientos en bases de datos SQL (OLTP y OLAP)
Experiencia básica con Python para análisis y manipulación de grandes volúmenes de datos
Experiencia con herramientas de visualización como Tableau, Metabase, Power BI, Looker u otras similares.
Familiaridad con procesos ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)
Español nativo e inglés alto.




Bonus:

Se valorará experiencia trabajando con dbt.
Se valorará haber trabajado con equipos de Data Science.
Se valorará experiencia trabajando con bases de datos NoSQL.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Trabajo 100% remoto desde cualquier parte de España.
Posibilidad de un espacio de coworking en Madrid o Vigo.
La posibilidad de trabajar en un equipo técnico de primer nivel.
Flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salida
23 días de vacaciones además del 24 y 31 de Diciembre.
Plan de retribución flexible.
Dos offsites de empresa al año.
Condiciones competitivas: fijo anual bruto de 35-42k € + Variable.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
¿Quieres una oportunidad para formar parte de nuestro equipo de Análisis?

¿Te gustan los retos?




Pues esta es tu oportunidad...




En Facephi, estamos buscando nuevos/as compañeros/as con experiencia en posiciones iguales o similares a Senior Data Analyst para que se unan a nuestra gran familia. Si tienes ganas de añadir valor al equipo y asumir nuevos retos que se te irán presentando, ¡ven a conocernos!




Tu misión será colaborar en la construcción de nuestra plataforma de datos en Microsoft Fabric y convertir esos datos en análisis de valor en Power BI. Tendrás un rol clave en la integración y explotación de los datos de Marketing, Comercial y Administración, para que sean consistentes y de calidad y den una visión unificada del negocio.




👉Tareas principales

Comprender los procesos y métricas clave de Marketing, Comercial y Administración.
Colaborar en el desarrollo de la arquitectura de datos en Fabric.
Construir procesos de ingesta, transformación y limpieza con Notebooks.
Integrar y modelar datos de CRM y SAP Business One, con calidad y trazabilidad.
Crear modelos semánticos y dashboards en Power BI: KPIs, funnels de marketing, performance comercial, métricas financieras y contables, y reportes ejecutivos.
Generar insights estratégicos y participar en proyectos de analítica de principio a fin, desde los requerimientos hasta producción.
Velar por la gobernanza y calidad del dato.
Gestionar incidencias y coordinarte con las distintas áreas para garantizar la integridad y confiabilidad de la información.




💙¿Qué ofrecemos a nuestro equipo?

Formarás parte de una gran familia integrada por personas con las que trabajar unidas y, de las cuales, poder inspirarte.
Equipo innovador, joven y transparente.
Estabilidad laboral.
Contrato indefinido a tiempo completo.
Flexibilidad horaria para conciliar tu vida personal.
Plan de teletrabajo.
Seguro médico.
Plan de formación.
Facephi Corporate Benefits, donde nos complace poder ofrecerte una gran variedad de descuentos en las mejores marcas.
En Facephi estamos comprometidos con la diversidad e igualdad de oportunidades.




✍️ Requisitos mínimos

3+ años en analítica o ingeniería de datos, con al menos 1–2 años trabajando con Microsoft Fabric.
Conocimientos de SQL.
Experiencia sólida en Power BI: modelado, DAX, optimización y visualización.
Experiencia con datos de CRM y/o SAP.
Visión de negocio y capacidad para comunicarte con equipos no técnicos.
Proactividad, compromiso y autonomía para gestionar tu trabajo.




Se valorará

Experiencia gestionando proyectos de analítica end-to-end.
Experiencia con Salesforce.
Conocimientos de Python.
Analítica de Marketing: funnels, MQL/SQL, conversión, performance de campañas y revenue.
Conocimientos de procesos contables y administrativos.
Experiencia en definición de métricas corporativas y gobierno del dato.
Experiencia en entornos corporativos con múltiples fuentes de información.
Certificaciones DP-600 o DP-700 (un plus).

Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.

Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. Gather and understand business needs and objectives.

Create data-complex dashboards with an optimized data structure and scaling perspective
Assist in planning, forecasting and AB testing processes.

Partner with the Data Engineering team to define and build reliable data sources.
Identify new opportunities for the use of data across the company.


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, Power BI / Tableau, and other data analysis tools
4+ years of experience in data, product analytics, data science or business intelligence, e-commerce experience is a plus
University degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related field
Proficiency in statistical analysis methods, data modeling, hypothesis testing, AB testing
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Fluent English
Good communication skills, ability to communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences
Applying expertise in analysis to see beyond the numbers and provide clear insights


Additional Information



What do we offer?



Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday

Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)
Free English and German language classes (after probation period)
Flexible working hours and hybrid work





The position is available for candidates based in Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Moldova or Kazakhstan.



Join us today and let’s create a success story together!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Wiliot was founded by the team that invented one of the technologies at the heart of 5G. Their next vision was to develop an IoT sticker, a computing element that can power itself by harvesting radio frequency energy, bringing connectivity and intelligence to everyday products and packaging, things previously disconnect from the IoT. This revolutionary mixture of cloud and semiconductor technology is being used by some of the world’s largest consumer, retail, food and pharmaceutical companies to change the way we make, distribute, sell, use and recycle products.

Our investors include Softbank, Amazon, Alibaba, Verizon, NTT DoCoMo, Qualcomm and PepsiCo.

This role offers a unique opportunity to engage in tactical data exploration and to build out solutions on top of the insights you identify. You will sift through massive amounts of data to discover “Ah ha!” moments for key customers that connect the dots between our technology and their key problems. You will then work with internal teams, and key customer teams to turn these insights into integrated solutions. Creativity, curiosity, and resilience are key for this role as you often won’t know what we’re looking for until we’ve found it.

Responsibilities:


Participate in customer meetings and carefully listen for pain points and business problems
Develop visualization interfaces (internally and in customer systems) to maximize data value and useability in the customer business context
Mold real time series data stream into actional insights
Hunt to uncover new insights in data generated by customer deployments
Build and deliver technical presentations to customers
Communicate effectively with engineers from many disciplines (including algorithm, software, and hardware engineers)
Work with internal product teams and customer teams to turn insights into integrated solutions.


Requirements:


Bachelor's degree in Math, CS, data science/engineering or equivalent analytical degree
4-5 years of relevant professional experience
Architecture experience in big data, data warehousing, operational analytics and integration.
Optimize the performance of big data systems to design and implement efficient analytics algorithms.
Strong Python skills
Experience with SPARK strongly preferred.
Visualization tools experience including UI design (Plotly, Tableau, PowerBI, Grafana)
Understanding of statistical analysis and relational database structures (SQL, Influxdb a plus)
Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving abilities
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Ability to be self-sufficient and execute quickly when given autonomy
Experience with IoT data streams and business context a plus
Flexible team player who will thrive in a dynamic, constantly evolving environment


Please send you CV in English.

Title: Data Analyst - Fraud Intelligence Team
Description:
About Us

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. 

 

About the Role

Join our Fraud Intelligence team at Riskified! As a Data Analyst on this team, you'll play a key role in helping us mitigate fraud and stay ahead of the fraudsters targeting our merchants. You'll research new and emerging fraud modus operandi (MOs), dive deep into transactional data, and help build and define the detection tools that power our fraud-prevention engine. This role sits at the core of Riskified's product and performance — the strength of our detection is a direct result of the work this team does every day.

What You'll Be Doing
Research and investigate new and evolving fraud modus operandi (MOs) across our merchant base
Analyze large-scale transactional data using SQL (and R or Python) to uncover patterns, anomalies, and emerging fraud trends
Collaborate with Data Science, Product, and Engineering to help build, define, and refine new fraud-detection tools 
Translate research findings into actionable insights that directly improve detection accuracy and merchant performance
Monitor and evaluate the performance of existing detection logic, flagging gaps or drift as fraud patterns evolve
Document investigation findings and methodologies, strengthening the team's shared knowledge base
Work cross-functionally with Risk Operations and Account Management to respond quickly to new fraud threats
Qualifications
2-3+ years of relevant strong analytical experience with complex data
2+ years of hands-on work experience with SQL (must be proficient)
Proven expertise in analysis tools such as R and Python 
Experienced problem-solver with critical thinking skills
Ability to work simultaneously on different tasks and lead multiple projects
Full working proficiency (both written and verbal) in English
Effective presentation skills, with a track record of client-facing experience
Advantage - experience in fraud, payments, or ecommerce domains

*Please submit your CV/Resume in English

We include transparent salary ranges to support fairness, clarity, and informed decision-making early in the process. The base salary range for this position is €37,000 - €42,000 gross annually for candidates based in Lisbon. Your actual salary will be determined based on your unique skills, experience, and competencies. If your expectations differ, please let us know - we’re always open to a conversation.

The base salary is one part of the total compensation package at Riskified. All full-time regular employees receive a bonus target and are eligible to receive stock-based awards. Also, our value proposition goes way beyond compensation: our perks and benefits package, culture, community, and learning and development programs are just some of the elements we provide to bring value to our employees.

Title: Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Revenue Intelligence
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket. Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Job Description



About the Role



As our business scales across 27 European markets, understanding the mechanics behind our financial performance and identifying new revenue streams is vital. We need an experienced analytical professional who can translate complex datasets into actionable business strategies and take ownership of high-impact initiatives.



To achieve this goal, we are hiring a Data Analyst (m/f/d) to join our Revenue Intelligence team. In this role, you will act as a key strategic partner to our leadership, working closely with our Head of Revenue Intelligence and Chief Revenue Officer, while collaborating cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Management and other teams.



You will focus on dissecting revenue dynamics, building predictive models and developing automated anomaly detection systems to safeguard and boost performance. You will leverage SQL and Python to run causal inference analyses, evaluate pricing initiatives and uncover performance drivers across our e-commerce ecosystem. Beyond technical execution, a key part of your mission will be data storytelling—translating advanced statistical concepts into clear, compelling insights for non-technical stakeholders.



This is an exciting opportunity for a self-starter who thrives on autonomy, proactive problem-solving and high visibility. You will have the direct space to pitch independent ideas, shape analytical frameworks and immediately influence commercial outcomes in a fast-paced scale-up environment.



What You Will Do



Monitor revenue and profit trends continuously across diverse e-commerce dimensions.



Build automated detection systems and frameworks to identify performance anomalies, early warning signals and degradation drivers.



Conduct deep root-cause analyses and apply causal inference methods to distinguish correlation from causation in business performance changes.



Quantify factor contributions to revenue shifts and evaluate commercial initiatives like pricing strategies or category launches.



Communicate analytical findings effectively to cross-functional partners and present actionable insights to senior leadership.



Utilize advanced tools, data processing models and modern analytics technologies to enhance team productivity and workflow automation.





Qualifications



Proven experience (5-7 years) in economic analysis, revenue management, or financial planning and analysis (FP&A), ideally within e-commerce, retail or tech.



Academic background in Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field.



Strong technical proficiency in SQL for advanced data extraction and transformation.



Fluency in Python for data analysis, statistical modeling and analytical processing (e.g., pandas, numpy,etc ).



Solid understanding of statistics, econometrics, time series forecasting, regression and segmentation.



Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to bridge complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.



Proactive mindset with a collaborative approach and strong problem-solving drive.



Professional fluency in English.





Additional Information


Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)

This job was posted on 31/08/2026 and is considering applications up to 6 weeks from this date.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst

Location(s): Lisbon, Portugal & London, United Kingdom

Application Deadline: (if applicable)

About Springer Nature (will Be Included On All Adverts)

Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.

At Springer Nature, we recognise that great talent develops through many different paths. We encourage applications from individuals with strong transferable skills, provided they are supported by relevant experience that shows how those skills have been successfully applied in practice. Our hiring approach balances skills, experience, and potential to ensure each role is fulfilled with both short term effectiveness and long term growth in mind.  

About The Brand

SN Digital (SND) is a technology division of Springer Nature. We are responsible for maintaining and delivering millions of articles used by researchers, scientists and students around the globe. 

There are c.330 of us in London, Berlin, Pune, New York, Madrid, Dordrecht, Heidelberg. We work in collaborative, multi-disciplinary delivery teams, developing digital products and services that answer user problems and support business goals. 


The work is interesting and meaningful. 
Our culture is collaborative and friendly. 
We encourage and support growth, both personal and professional. 


This is a terrific opportunity for friendly, inquisitive people who want to get involved in our work, who love to learn, who will embrace and develop our culture, and help make SN Digital a place where people and ideas can thrive. Having a good command of English is important; collaboration is important in our day-to-day work, so being able to communicate your ideas and understand others’ is key. 

We are intentionally looking to create teams that are diverse and inclusive. Diversity is the mix of culture, background, experience and personality that we all bring; inclusion is getting the mix to work better together. We want every member of our teams to contribute to our common goals while respecting each other's skills, knowledge and needs.  

About The Role

As a data analyst in the Content Acquisition Product Group, you will connect with Technology, Business and User Research functions, using your skills in data analysis and quantitative research to deliver value across the organization. You will support the development of digital products through their lifecycle – from planning and analysis to delivery and operations – while considering customer, business and wider scientific landscape perspectives.

Role Responsibilities


Understanding the global scientific landscape, our publishing business and its content acquisition processes through data.
Applying business knowledge, quantitative methods and proficient storytelling to help teams keep data at the core of their thinking and decision-making.
Designing and deploying key metrics to measure different aspects of the business.
Creating and maintaining analytics products for easier data querying and self-service.
Creating and maintaining dashboards to track metrics and visualize insights.
Partnering with cross-functional teams for deep dive research projects to uncover trends, opportunities and threats at longer timescales.
Help drive the shift to a data mindset as part of our culture – promoting data literacy across the company, while advocating and educating teams to keep data front and center.


Experience, Skills & Qualifications:

Supporting the roll-out of Euronext's supplier engagement plan against its Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) target
Tracking supplier progress on emissions disclosure and target-setting, maintaining the supplier data tracker
Engaging procurement and category managers to embed ESG criteria into supplier onboarding and evaluation
Contributing to the CSRD reporting cycle, including coordination with external auditors

Supporting EU Taxonomy eligibility and alignment assessments (CapEx, OpEx, turnover KPIs)

Title: RevOps Performance Analyst
Description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

We're looking for a RevOps Performance Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between raw data and strategic execution and be part of the GTM engine as we scale our automated spend management solutions across Europe. If you're excited about turning ambiguity into actionable insights and are passionate about FinTech and data-driven growth, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who You'll Be Working With And Reporting To

You'll report to our Manager, Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our team of RevOps specialists is highly collaborative and dedicated to optimising the entire revenue lifecycle. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data Engineering and Finance to ensure a single source of truth for all company-wide KPIs

What You'll Be Doing

As a RevOps Performance Analyst, you will:


Create holistic insights across the entire revenue funnel (Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success) to identify bottlenecks and conversion opportunities. Interpret ambiguous GTM questions and translate them into measurable metrics and analytical approaches.
Develop and maintain automated dashboards that act as the "Single Source of Truth" for GTM KPIs, including CAC, LTV, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and pipeline velocity.
Challenge or refine requests when definitions, logic, or business relevance are unclear. Recommend improved metrics or analytical approaches when they better address the underlying business need.
Design analytics data models and tables to ensure data integrity across the tech stack (CRM, Billing, BI tools), ensuring all data is stored and transferred securely. Identify the correct system of record and reconcile discrepancies across sources. Partner with Data & Analytics when data engineering or architecture support is required.
Support senior management and our C-Level stakeholders with data-driven recommendations on resource allocation and GTM strategy; highlighting risks, trade-offs, and expected impact.
Build and continuously improve predictive models for sales forecasting and churn propensity to provide actionable forward-looking insights.
Analyse the impact of key variables in the sales process—such as discounting behaviours, lead routing efficiency, and promotion effectiveness—to drive operational excellence.


What You Bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:


A solid understanding of SQL, data modeling and predictive statistical techniques
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate messy business questions into clean, measurable metrics
A passion for challenging the status quo and refining logic when business relevance is unclear
Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise high-impact tasks for senior leadership
Experience with SaaS metrics (NRR, Gross Margin, Magic Number)
A background in RevOps, Sales Ops or Strategic Finance within a high-growth environment


Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:


You love the detective work of finding out why a conversion rate dropped and proposing the fix
You enjoy being the bridge between technical data engineers and non-technical sales leaders
You want to see your analytical models directly influence the company's GTM strategy in real-time


This role is not a good fit for you if:


You prefer working on static reports rather than dynamic, evolving business problems
You are uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or senior management when the data tells a different story
You prefer a siloed environment where you don't have to worry about the upstream or downstream impact of data


How You'll Develop In This Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:


Lead a full-funnel audit to drive impact in lead-to-close efficiency
Collaborate with data engineering to improve our underlying RevOps data architecture and dbt models
Grow your skills in executive presence, presenting quarterly performance deep-dives to our GTM leadership


We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on larger strategic projects, stepping into a leadership track, or mastering advanced data engineering skills within the RevOps domain

Please note: You will need to be physically based in one of the locations listed on the advert with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of our locations.

Show me the benefits!


💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:


Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.
Hiring Manager Interview: A 45- minutes interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can adapt to the role
Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
Final Interview: Final conversation with a Senior Leader


Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a vast numbers of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:


We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.


About Your Application


English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
  • Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Title: Business Intelligence Developer/ Analyst

CAPGEMINI ENGINEERING

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

YOUR ROLE

Joining Capgemini Engineering...

As a Business Intelligence Developer/Analyst, you will be a key contributor to an exciting technology project at a client site in Lisbon, working at the intersection of data, analytics, and business insight. In a hybrid working model, you will help organisations make better decisions by turning complex data into clear, actionable intelligence.

In this role you will play a key role in:


Designing, developing, and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, leveraging Tabular models to deliver clear and impactful data visualisations for business stakeholders
Building and optimising data pipelines and queries using MS SQL Server, ensuring data accuracy, performance, and reliability across BI solutions
Using Python to support data processing, automation, and analytical tasks, contributing to the overall quality and efficiency of data workflows
Collaborating closely with business teams and data owners to gather requirements, understand data needs, and translate them into robust and scalable BI solutions
Identifying data quality issues and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring that reporting and analytics outputs meet the highest standards of accuracy and relevance


YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytically minded BI professional who takes pride in delivering quality work and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.


A minimum of 3 years of experience in a Business Intelligence or Data Analyst/Developer role, with strong hands-on proficiency in Power BI and Tabular models
Solid working knowledge of MS SQL Server, including query writing, data modelling, and performance optimisation in production environments
Practical experience with Python for data manipulation, automation, or analytical purposes, with a structured and quality-focused approach to problem solving
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to critically assess data, identify inconsistencies, and drive improvements with rigour and precision
A collaborative and adaptable team player, able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and comfortable working in a hybrid, client-facing environment

Free access to learning platforms – Free access for all to world-class learning assets and curated programs from Harvard Business Review, Coursera, Pluralsight, Udemy, Microsoft, AWS, Google and many more.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. Perform comparative analytical reviews between different phases on a technical level and utilize data reconciliation techniques to prepare synthesis reports for Financial Steering, Executive Management, and the Group.
Drive continuous improvement and optimization of production processes by applying programming logic to automate manual processes and enhance workflow efficiency, in collaboration with IT development teams.
Build and design dashboards for Business Unit Heads, adapting it to their needs and contributing to monitoring the gap between French GAAP and IFRS 17, and be capable of leveraging data automation tools and techniques for this purpose.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? HERE’S WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:


Bachelor’s degree in Management, Accounting, Finance or another related field
Minimum of 5 years of experience, in similar positions (Finance, Management Control or Actuarial)
Proficiency in computing skills. Advanced excel knowledge is mandatory.
Knowledge of VBA / SaaS / Power BI / Power Query / Python is a plus. Comfortable and confident learning new tools or developing skills on the above tools.
Prior experience in banking, insurance or in a consulting firm would be an advantage
Proficiency in Financial Models, financial and performance analysis, and measurement and budget management
Fluent in English (C1 level minimum). Fluency in French is a plus.


WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

In addition to our attractive salary, here’s a glimpse of what you can expect from us:


Generous Perks: Enjoy meal, child and monthly flexible benefits allowances as part of our comprehensive benefits package.

Flexibility Redefined: Embrace our hybrid working model for a perfect balance of commitment and personal flexibility.
Endless and tailored Professional Growth: Fuel your career aspirations with continuous development opportunities on both local and global scales
Vibrant Work Environment: Immerse yourself in our modern amenities, including zen rooms, free language courses, and diverse company events.
Culture of Care: Be part of a multicultural environment that prioritizes employee wellbeing and professional growth.


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION ARE IMPORTANT TO US!

BNP Paribas Cardif is an equal opportunity employer and proud to provide equal employment opportunity to all job seekers. We are actively committed to ensuring that no individual is discriminated against on the grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity/paternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. Title: Data Analytics Consultant
Description:
At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

We are recruiting for our Lisbon Office where you'll be joining a growing team of nearly 200 people. Consultants based in Lisbon will support clients globally with the opportunity for international travel. Our consultants provide flexible support to clients whether it is a rapid assessment, short term savings realisation or embedding in a long-term partnership to deliver lasting and measurable value to clients.

This role sits within Efficio's Digital Delivery team, working at the intersection of consulting, data and technology.

Rather than building dashboards or maintaining internal reporting, you'll use data to solve real procurement and supply chain challenges for global clients.

You'll work alongside our consulting teams to understand client data, assess its quality, build analytical datasets such as Spend Cubes, and deliver insights that directly influence sourcing decisions and business outcomes.

Every project is different. One week you might be analysing ERP data for a global manufacturer, while the next you're helping consultants understand supplier spend patterns or using Python to automate data preparation for a new client engagement.

This is a hands-on delivery role combining technical problem-solving, analytical thinking and client collaboration.

What You’ll Be Doing


Work alongside consulting teams on global procurement and supply chain transformation projects.
Gather, assess and understand client data from ERP systems and other sources.
Clean, transform and structure complex datasets into analytical models such as Spend Cubes.
Develop data pipelines and automate repetitive data preparation activities using Python, SQL and AI.
Analyse procurement and spend data to uncover sourcing opportunities and support consulting recommendations.
Use AI-enabled tools and internal technologies to improve delivery efficiency.
Collaborate with consultants and client stakeholders to understand business problems and translate them into data solutions.
Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve delivery processes through knowledge sharing and automation.


What we are looking for:


At least 3 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data consulting, or a related field.
Experience working with SQL.
Experience using Python for data manipulation or automation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with and processing varied, disparate datasets.
Familiarity with Excel and data visualisation tools. We are using Sigma, but experience in PowerBI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik or similar will be valued).
Curious and eager to understand how businesses operate.
Comfortable working in across multiple projects.
Strong communication skills.


Nice to have:


Experience working with ERP data (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.)
Procurement or supply chain exposure
Experience with AI-assisted analytics or automation
Experience in consulting or client-facing delivery


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Senior Financial Data Analyst / FP&A Business Partner
Description:
About The Company

Turning marketing into a market-domination weapon, we created a new category - the marketplace for future customers. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e-commerce: you see everything about a lead before you buy - full transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. We're the #1 lead marketplace in the USA, and we're accelerating.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Financial Data Analyst / FP&A Business Partner who will help us understand where the business makes money, where profit is lost, and which decisions can improve margins, cash flow, and overall performance. You will work closely with founders, finance, product, operations, and business teams to turn financial and operational data into clear recommendations. This role exists to help leadership make faster, better decisions based on real business numbers.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build and improve executive dashboards that show revenue, profit, margins, COGS, OpEx, refunds, payouts, cash flow, and key business metrics

Analyze profitability across products, customers, providers, geographies, channels, lead sources, and operational workflows

Create P&L analysis, gross margin analysis, contribution margin analysis, unit economics models, forecasts, and scenario analysis

Identify cost leaks, overspending, inefficient vendors, payment issues, margin risks, and other areas where the business can improve profit

Partner with finance, accounting, product, operations, sales, and marketing teams to connect business activity with financial outcomes

Reconcile business data with invoices, payouts, payment systems, taxes, accounting records, and financial reports

Present clear recommendations to founders and senior leadership on pricing, cost optimization, product profitability, hiring, and growth decisions

What Makes You a Strong Fit:

6-8+ years of experience in financial analytics, FP&A, data analytics, business analytics, or a similar role

Strong experience with financial modeling, P&L analysis, unit economics, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis

Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on experience with BigQuery

Strong experience with Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills for financial modeling, reporting, and scenario analysis

Good understanding of accounting basics, financial statements, revenue, COGS, OpEx, gross margin, contribution margin, and cash flow

Clear communication in English, both spoken and written, with the ability to explain financial insights to founders, business teams, and non-finance stakeholders

Bonus if you have:

Experience with Python or another scripting language for data analysis and reporting automation

Experience with payment systems, accounting systems, CRM, ERP, Stripe, QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or similar tools

Experience in marketplace, SaaS, fintech, real estate, lead generation, or performance marketing businesses

Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership in a fast-moving business environment

Why You'll Love It Here:

You'll work at the core of a product-led, AI-powered startup where data drives every decision

Your work will ship fast and impact thousands of users

High autonomy, low bureaucracy: we trust you to own your domain

Remote-first culture with flexible hours and async-friendly communication

Salary (fixed base) ABOVE the market average

A smart, passionate team that moves fast, supports each other, and builds cool stuff

15 paid vacation days plus 5 paid sick days annually

Paid access to courses, books, and growth resources

Real decision-making power and ownership of your results

Title: IT Expert Data, Analytics & Risk
HTML:
Queres integrar uma das maiores organizações na prestação de serviços profissionais do mercado?

Então a Deloitte é para ti. Aqui, vais ter a possibilidade de potenciar a tua carreira e de reforçar as tuas competências no nosso universo tecnológico.

Somos um Tech Hub internacional e estamos à procura dos melhores especialistas em IT Risk para se juntarem aos nossos centros de excelência e à nossa comunidade. Na Deloitte, vais transformar o mundo como o conhecemos e desenvolver soluções únicas e inovadoras nos mais variados e complexos projetos de transformação, de Portugal para o mundo. Vamos reforçar a nossa área de Strategy, Risk and Transaction e procuramos profissionais experientes que tenham gosto e aptidão natural para trabalhar em equipa e em ambiente multi-projeto.

Podes descobrir todas as funções que vais desempenhar, de acordo com o teu perfil, para assim dares um salto na tua carreira!

Juntas-te a nós? Estamos à tua espera.

O teu dia a dia e responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em projetos relacionados com gestão de risco, combate à fraude e branqueamento de capitais, compliance, governo de dados, continuidade de negócio e gestão de fornecedores;
  • Analisar grandes volumes de dados provenientes de diferentes sistemas e tecnologias para tratamento, identificação de padrões, tendências e indicadores de risco;
  • Desenvolver pipelines de tratamento de dados (ETL), garantindo a correta extração, transformação e integração de dados para responder a necessidades de negócio
  • Construir dashboards, reports e soluções de reporting para análise de risco, compliance, performance operacional e tomada de decisão;
  • Desenvolver modelos quantitativos e qualitativos para avaliação e previsão de riscos, utilizando técnicas estatísticas e ferramentas analíticas;
  • Realizar auditorias informáticas para avaliar a conformidade com os padrões e políticas de segurança estabelecidos;
  • Desenvolver soluções eficazes para garantir a resiliência operacional em face de interrupções ou desastres:
  • Colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares na implementação de soluções tecnológicas em ambientes complexos.


És tu quem procuramos?

  • Formação académica em Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação, Data Science, Engenharia Eletrotécnica, Informática de Gestão ou áreas similares;
  • Entre 1 a 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, análise de dados, automação, reporting, implementação de soluções tecnológicas ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos em linguagens e ferramentas como Python, SQL, Power BI, Databricks, SAS, Java, Spark ou tecnologias equivalentes;
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em processos de ETL, incluindo integração e transformação de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes;
  • Interesse em aplicar soluções técnicas a desafios reais de negócio, nomeadamente nas áreas de risco, compliance, dados, fraude, governo de dados ou continuidade de negócio;
  • Domínio da língua inglesa falado e escrito (preferencial);
  • Boas capacidades de comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal, trabalho em equipa;
  • Autonomia, proatividade, empenho e espírito crítico;
  • Capacidades de organização, estruturação e sistematização.


Desenvolve uma carreira à tua medida

  • Num contexto de trabalho diverso que permite um desenvolvimento e aprendizagem contínuos;
  • Através de um plano de desenvolvimento de carreira personalizado (skills/ oportunidades técnicas e funcionais), adequado ao momento, às tuas necessidades e objetivos;
  • Acesso ilimitado às maiores plataformas de aprendizagem online (Linkedin Learning e Udemy);
  • Oportunidade de formação em diferentos dominios tecnológicos.


Vive uma cultura de união

  • Uma cultura de inovação e excelência que nos torna líderes e precursores de tendências;
  • Um ambiente amigável, de respeito, confiança, transparência e informalidade;
  • Uma rede para a vida que te faz estar ligado ao melhor conhecimento ao lado de líderes e especialistas;
  • Uma oportunidade para fazeres parte das nossas comunidades (de Tech, desporto e outros interesses) e para participares ativamente em projetos de responsabilidade social.


Sobre a Deloitte

Na Deloitte nunca trabalharás sozinho. Terás a oportunidade de integrar diversos projetos de transformação e fazer parte de uma equipa que te vai inspirar e ajudar a desenvolver soluções diferenciadoras, num ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde podes dar o melhor de ti e beneficiar das nossas iniciativas de bem-estar e flexibilidade. Somos mais de 5.500 pessoas em Portugal, das quais mais de 2.600 trabalham em áreas tecnológicas, a partir de escritórios e Digital Studios em Lisboa, Porto, Braga, Viseu, Coimbra e Faro e de polos tecnológicos em Braga. Além disso, as nossas equipas em Portugal têm projeção internacional, o que demonstra a nossa forte liderança global em low code/no code, em engenharia de redes de telecomunicações, em plataformas tecnológicas de transformação organizacional (ServiceNow e Apptio) e na indústria de serviços financeiros (Finastra, TIA e Guidewire).

Se tens interesse em explorar e desenvolver as tuas competências nalguma destas áreas em soluções tecnológicas – engenharia de software, cloud, integração de sistemas, data analytics & data science, cyber risk, engenharia de redes telecomunicações, UX design - e gostarias de trabalhar com tecnologias como AWS, Google, Oracle, Salesforce, SAP, Mulesoft, Feedzai e SAS, entre outras, então estás no lugar certo!

Sabe mais em www.deloitte.com/pt/careers.

Title: BI Consultant (DOMO)
Description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.

Role Details

📍 Job location: Portugal (Remote - with possible occasional in-person meetings)

🕒 Contract type: Employee / Contractor B2B

🗓 Target start date: October 2026

⏰ Working hours: Full-time 40h/week

💵 Compensation: €35k–€45k per year; €220–€300/day

📋 What You'll Architect

As a BI Consultant – DOMO, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining technology, data, intelligence, and human decision-making. The role combines Snowflake/SQL data pipeline development with DOMO visualisation, taking data from preparation and transformation through to reporting and dashboards.

This role is both technical and consultative, perfect for someone who can combine Business Intelligence expertise, hands-on DOMO development, data analysis, and stakeholder engagement. You will join an established client team supporting the delivery, maintenance, and continuous evolution of BI and analytics solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Develop, maintain, and enhance DOMO dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions aligned with business requirements.
Build, maintain, and enhance data pipelines and transformations in Snowflake using SQL.
Work closely with business and technical stakeholders to understand reporting, data, and analytics requirements.
Translate business needs and data into clear, actionable insights that support effective decision-making.
Support existing BI solutions and troubleshoot data, dashboard, and reporting issues.
Ensure dashboards and reports remain accurate, reliable, performant, and fit for purpose.
Work collaboratively across business and technical teams to ensure alignment between data requirements and reporting outcomes.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of BI, reporting, and analytics processes.
Support the ongoing evolution of the client's analytics environment by identifying opportunities to improve usability, consistency, and reporting quality.


👤 Who You Are


You are an experienced BI or Data Consultant who enjoys turning data into meaningful business insights.
You are comfortable working directly with business stakeholders, understanding their reporting needs, and translating them into practical solutions.
You combine analytical thinking with a clear understanding of how dashboards and reports support business decision-making.
You are confident working hands-on with DOMO and enjoy developing intuitive, reliable analytics solutions.
You are comfortable investigating data and reporting issues and working methodically to identify practical solutions.
You work effectively independently, while remaining closely connected to a wider client and delivery team.
You take ownership of your work and maintain a strong focus on accuracy, quality, and reliability.
You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You are comfortable working in collaborative and international environments


🛠️ What You Bring

Qualifications & Experience


Professional experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, Data, or Reporting.
Hands-on professional experience working with DOMO.
Experience developing, maintaining, and improving dashboards and reporting solutions.
Good understanding of data analysis, reporting concepts, and data visualisation.
Experience gathering, analysing, and translating business requirements into BI solutions.
Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and client-facing environments.
Professional proficiency in English.


Technical & Professional Skills


Hands-on expertise with DOMO for dashboard development, reporting, and analytics.
Experience designing effective data visualisations, reports, and business dashboards.
Strong understanding of BI and reporting principles, including accuracy, usability, and consistency.
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake and SQL, including data querying, transformation, and pipeline development.
Ability to analyse data and translate findings into clear business insights.
Experience troubleshooting and resolving data and reporting issues.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to translate stakeholder requirements into practical, fit-for-purpose BI solutions.


Nice to Have


Experience with Qlik / Qlik Sense.
Experience with other BI and data visualisation platforms.
Previous experience in consulting or client-facing environments.
Exposure to international projects or multicultural teams.


⭐ What Makes You Successful


You focus on delivering reliable insights and business value, not simply producing dashboards.
You take the time to understand the business question behind each reporting requirement.
You combine strong BI expertise with a pragmatic, user-focused approach.
You communicate data and analytical concepts in a clear and accessible way.
You take ownership of the accuracy, quality, and usability of the solutions you deliver.
You are comfortable troubleshooting existing solutions and finding practical ways to improve them.
You build strong working relationships with both business and technical stakeholders.
You combine autonomy with collaboration, working independently while remaining closely aligned with the wider team.
You continuously look for opportunities to improve dashboards, reporting processes, and analytics outcomes.


🎁 What We Offer at Keyrus Portugal


Competitive salary aligned with your experience and the data market
Meal allowance: €10.20/day
Flexible benefits plan
Private medical insurance
22 days of annual leave, increasing every 3 years (up to 25 days)
Continuous learning via KLX – Keyrus Learning Experience
A collaborative, international, and human-centred work environment


💰 How Our Salary Ranges Work

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect different levels of mastery and impact within the same role — not different job titles.


Bottom of the range You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support.
Middle of the range You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently.
Top of the range You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team.


Final offers are based on experience, autonomy, scope, and market context, and are discussed transparently during the process.

🔒 Responsible AI & Recruitment

At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers.

To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for note-taking purposes during interviews. AI is never used to make decisions.

To ensure fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is strictly prohibited.

Our commitment to responsible AI practices ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate’s own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise.

⚠️ Any use of AI assistance during the interview process may result in immediate disqualification from the recruitment process.

♿ Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

At Keyrus, we help organisations move from experimental AI to industrialised AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. This is the discipline we call being an Architect of Intelligence. Designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), we architect reliable:


Intelligence Foundations,
Human in Command governance,
and Performance Steering,


To create intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capabilities and performance compounds over time.

With 30+ years of expertise and 2,800 employees across 28 countries, we help organisations go beyond transformation: to build adaptive, resilient, and continuously improving intelligent organisations.

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

Keyrus Portugal participates in the +Talento Internship Program, co-funded by IEFP and Portugal 2030.

Esta oportunidade destina-se, apenas, à submissão de referências e não a candidaturas internas.

Queres integrar uma das maiores organizações na prestação de serviços profissionais do mercado?

Somos um Tech Hub internacional e estamos à procura dos melhores especialistas em Data para se juntarem aos nossos centros de excelência e à nossa comunidade. Na Deloitte, vais transformar o mundo como o conhecemos e desenvolver soluções únicas e inovadoras nos mais variados e complexos projetos de transformação, de Portugal para o mundo. Juntas-te a nós? Estamos à tua espera.

O teu dia a dia e responsabilidades:

  • Planear e executar com autonomia as atividades a realizar na elaboração dos diversos outputs no âmbito de um projeto;
  • Gerir responsavelmente e de acordo com a sua esfera de atuação as relações diárias com o cliente.


És tu quem procuramos?

  • Formação superior nas áreas de Engenharia Informática, Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores ou similar;
  • Anos de experiência: 2 a 5 anos em consultoria e em Business Intelligence/ Analytics;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em data mining & Machine Learning;
  • Conhecimentos técnicos em R, Python, SAS Machine Learning e IBM Watson ou ferramentas similares;
  • Conhecimento da língua inglesa no domínio falado e escrito;
  • Conhecimento da língua portuguesa no domínio falado e escrito;
  • Orientação para o cliente e para resultados;
  • Comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal, trabalho em equipa e colaboração;
  • Resolução de problemas, capacidade analítica e espírito crítico;
  • Organização, planeamento e orientação para a qualidade dos projetos;
  • Orientação para o cliente e para resultados;
  • Residência em Portugal obrigatória.


Desenvolve uma carreira à tua medida

  • Num contexto de trabalho diverso que permite um desenvolvimento e aprendizagem contínuos;
  • Através de um plano de desenvolvimento de carreira personalizado (skills/ oportunidades técnicas e funcionais), adequado ao momento, às tuas necessidades e objetivos;
  • Participando em projetos nacionais e internacionais, com dimensão e impacto relevante nesta área de especialização;
  • Acesso ilimitado às maiores plataformas de aprendizagem online (Linkedin Learning e Udemy);
  • Oportunidade de formações e certificações nas mais recentes tecnologias, nomeadamente em tecnologias Cloud.


Vive uma cultura de união

  • Uma cultura de inovação e excelência que nos torna líderes e precursores de tendências;
  • Um ambiente amigável, de respeito, confiança, transparência e informalidade;
  • Uma rede para a vida que te faz estar ligado ao melhor conhecimento ao lado de líderes e especialistas;
  • Uma oportunidade para fazeres parte das nossas comunidades (de Tech, inovação, desporto e outros interesses) e para participares ativamente em projetos de responsabilidade social.


Sobre a Deloitte

Na Deloitte nunca trabalharás sozinho. Terás a oportunidade de integrar diversos projetos de transformação e fazer parte de uma equipa que te vai inspirar e ajudar a desenvolver soluções diferenciadoras, num ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde podes dar o melhor de ti e beneficiar das nossas iniciativas de bem-estar e flexibilidade. Somos mais de 5.500 pessoas em Portugal, das quais mais de 2.600 trabalham em áreas tecnológicas, a partir de escritórios e Digital Studios em Lisboa, Porto, Braga, Viseu, Coimbra e Faro e de polos tecnológicos em Braga. Além disso, as nossas equipas em Portugal têm projeção internacional, o que demonstra a nossa forte liderança global em low code/no code, em engenharia de redes de telecomunicações, em plataformas tecnológicas de transformação organizacional (ServiceNow e Apptio) e na indústria de serviços financeiros (Finastra, TIA e Guidewire).
