Quem somos:

A NoeXa é uma tech consultancy focada em inovação e excelência, parte do grupo austríaco XRXES — cujo nome simboliza "Success".

Com sede em Lisboa, somos o centro de competência tecnológica do grupo, liderando projetos de transformação digital. Trabalhamos lado a lado com organizações públicas e privadas, combinando tecnologia, visão de negócio e foco no cliente para resolver desafios complexos e gerar impacto real.


Posição: Data Analyst

Regime de trabalho: Híbrido (3x por semana na região de Lisboa)


O contexto do projeto:

Vais integrar uma equipa responsável por analisar a atividade de ATMs do ponto de vista financeiro ao longo de toda a cadeia de valor — desde empresas de transporte de valores, passando por terminais, até às contas de suporte. O objetivo é identificar gaps entre o que é esperado e o que realmente acontece nesta operação, e garantir que são resolvidos junto das equipas certas.


O teu papel:

  • Extrair, tratar e agregar dados de diversas fontes para análise;
  • Analisar indicadores relativos à atividade de ATMs, cruzando dados de diferentes intervenientes da cadeia de valor (transporte de valores, terminais, contas de suporte);
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos com os gaps identificados;
  • Despoletar e acompanhar a resolução de gaps junto das equipas internas envolvidas;
  • Analisar faturas de fornecedores, validando-as face às ordens solicitadas;
  • Preparar conteúdos, apresentações e relatórios para clientes externos e internos;
  • Participar em reuniões de equipa.


O que valorizamos em ti:

  • Licenciatura em Engenharia Informática, Informática de Gestão, Estatística ou Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimentos de bases de dados relacionais (SQL Server e T-SQL);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em MS Office, nomeadamente Excel e Access;
  • Conhecimentos de linguagens de programação (ex: VBA) — valorizado;
  • Conhecimentos de sistemas de informação e métodos de integração entre SI — valorizado;
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão;
  • Perfil pragmático e orientado a resultados;
  • Boa capacidade de relacionamento interpessoal.


O que te oferecemos:

  • Integração numa empresa em crescimento com ambição internacional
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento numa função transversal com exposição a diferentes mercados e realidades financeiras
  • Ambiente colaborativo e orientado à aprendizagem contínua
  • Acompanhamento próximo e desenvolvimento de competências técnicas e profissionais
  • Plano de carreira estruturado
  • Pacote competitivo e flexibilidade de trabalho


O próximo passo é teu:

Na NoeXa, construímos mais do que soluções — criamos impacto, desenvolvemos talento e promovemos sucesso.

Se queres iniciar o teu percurso profissional como Data Analyst, queremos conhecer-te.

Title: RFP - Data Analyst
Description:
Resumo da Função

Procuramos um(a) Data Analyst para se juntar à nossa equipa e ajudar a impulsionar decisões de produto, marketing e performance comercial. Vais trabalhar muito próximo das equipas de Produto, Marketing, Vendas e Analytics, transformando dados em insights acionáveis e acompanhando o impacto das iniciativas que desenhamos e lançamos no mercado.

Focos Principais


Análise de negócio e storytelling com dados – medir a performance de campanhas, produtos e canais, explicar o “porquê” por detrás dos números e recomendar ações.
Implementação de soluções de reporting e dados – criar e manter dashboards e pequenos pipelines de dados que garantam a fiabilidade e recorrência da informação.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Medir a performance de ações de marketing e iniciativas comerciais, traduzindo resultados em recomendações práticas para o negócio.
Identificar KPIs relevantes para cada produto e canal e construir narrativas claras sobre o que está a acontecer e porquê.
Desenvolver e manter dashboards automatizados (por exemplo, em Power BI), garantindo a qualidade dos dados, a validação dos cálculos e a respetiva documentação.
Implementar e manter pequenos pipelines de dados (por exemplo, jobs em SQL/Python) como fontes para dashboards e análises recorrentes.
Apoiar a definição de data governance para métricas-chave (definições consistentes, regras de cálculo, standards de reporting).
Conceber e executar análises ad-hoc para responder a questões de negócio e apoiar experiências (por exemplo, testes A/B).
Atuar como “consultor(a) interno(a) de dados” para as equipas de Marketing, Vendas, Produto e Operações, ajudando a transformar perguntas de negócio em problemas analíticos bem definidos.
Identificar tendências, oportunidades e riscos e contribuir para a evolução contínua das nossas capacidades analíticas e de reporting.


Requisitos:


Mínimo de 2–3 anos de experiência em funções de análise de dados (Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Marketing Analyst, Product Analyst ou similar).
Formação em áreas quantitativas (Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística, Informática, Economia ou equivalente) ou experiência profissional relevante que compense outra formação.
Experiência sólida em:
SQL (obrigatório) – capacidade para escrever queries de complexidade média/alta para análise e preparação de dados;
Excel (obrigatório) – análise exploratória, tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas (por exemplo, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, etc.);
Power BI ou ferramenta de visualização equivalente (por exemplo, Tableau, Looker, Qlik, etc.).
Conhecimentos práticos de Python para análise de dados e/ou automação de processos (por exemplo, utilização de pandas, scripts simples).
Experiência na construção de pipelines de dados simples (por exemplo, jobs agendados, integrações entre fontes e modelos de dados para reporting). Experiência com orquestradores (como Airflow) é valorizada, mas não obrigatória.
Capacidade para compreender o negócio, ligar métricas a resultados e explicar conceitos analíticos a stakeholders não técnicos.
Boas competências de comunicação escrita e oral, com foco na clareza, objetividade e storytelling com dados.
Flexibilidade para adaptar prioridades com base em nova informação e contexto, mantendo o foco na entrega com qualidade.

Valorizamos Adicionalmente


Experiência em contextos de marketing, CRM, vendas ou produto digital.
Experiência na conceção e acompanhamento de experiências e testes A/B.
Interesse em trabalhar de forma colaborativa com perfis técnicos e não técnicos, num ambiente orientado a produto.
Curiosidade intelectual, espírito crítico e vontade de aprender continuamente.

A degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, or Information Management.

Communication: Ability to clearly notify and prompt senior stakeholders (Site Security Manager, VO (Physical Security) teams) when data actions are required.

Title: Junior HR Systems, Data & Business Intelligence
Description:
Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 126 premium private schools in 28 countries spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13.

Founded in 2013 by Nadim M. Nsouli, Inspired is backed by investors such as Stonepeak, GIC, TA Associates, and the Oppenheimer and Mansour family offices. The Group is experiencing 20% per annum growth through acquisition, greenfield site expansion, and the development of existing schools within its portfolio. In 2023, Inspired was recognised by Beauhurst as one of the UK's top 10 highest-value private companies.

ROLE SUMMARY:

Inspired Education is seeking a motivated and analytical Junior HR Systems, Data & Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Global HR Systems team.

The role will support the Group in making better use of people data, HR technology and digital tools across our global network of schools. The successful candidate will work closely with HR teams across different countries and regions to ensure that information held within our HR systems is accurate, complete and consistently maintained, and then use that data to develop reporting and insights that support better decision-making. The initial focus of the role will be on recruitment data and analytics. This will involve working end-to-end with recruitment and HR teams to understand how data is captured, identify and resolve data quality gaps, establish consistent ways of working, and develop the reports and analytics required to provide visibility of recruitment activity and performance.

The role offers the opportunity to develop a broad combination of People Analytics, HR Systems and stakeholder management skills within a global HR function. Working closely with experienced members of the Global HR Systems team, including a People Systems & Insights Analyst, the successful candidate will receive coaching and support while progressively taking greater ownership of different areas of HR data and reporting.

While recruitment will be the initial area of focus, the scope of the role is expected to evolve into other areas of HR over time, providing exposure to a broad range of people data, reporting, systems, automation and AI initiatives as Inspired continues to develop its global HR technology and analytics capabilities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


Work with recruitment and HR teams across the Group to ensure people data is accurate, complete and consistently maintained, initially with a particular focus on recruitment data.
Perform regular data quality checks and audits, identify gaps or inconsistencies, and work with relevant teams to understand and resolve them.
Develop and maintain HR reports, dashboards and key people metrics, using data from SuccessFactors and other relevant sources.
Support the development of recruitment analytics, including visibility of vacancies, recruitment activity, candidate pipelines, time to hire and other relevant indicators.
Analyse HR data to identify trends, patterns, risks and opportunities, translating findings into clear and actionable insights.
Work with HR stakeholders to understand their reporting and data needs and provide ad-hoc analysis to support business decisions.
Help establish consistent data definitions, reporting standards and ways of working across HR teams.
Identify opportunities to improve data collection, reporting and HR processes through better use of technology, automation and AI.
Support the testing and implementation of new reports, system enhancements and digital solutions.
Work closely with the Global HR Systems team and support HR colleagues with guidance and training on how data should be captured and maintained.


THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business, Human Resources, Information Systems, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or another relevant field.
Up to 2 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, HR systems, People Analytics or another relevant analytical role. Internship, graduate programme or relevant academic project experience will be considered.
Strong Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, data manipulation and data cleansing.
Exposure to Power BI or other data visualisation tools is an advantage.
Exposure to HR systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or Oracle HCM is desirable but not essential.
Familiarity with automation, AI tools or digital transformation initiatives is an advantage.


Skills & Attributes


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and a natural curiosity about data.
Comfortable questioning information that does not look right and investigating the underlying cause.
Confident working with different stakeholders and following up with teams to resolve data issues and improve ways of working.
Able to translate data and technical information into clear, simple messages for non-technical audiences.
Proactive, organised and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
Curious about technology and keen to learn new tools and develop new skills.
Comfortable working in an international and fast-paced environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English.


SAFEGUARDING STATEMENT:

Inspired Education Group is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practices and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.

Visit our careers site for more information; https://jobs.inspirededu.com

Title: Business Data Analyst (Maintenance)
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.



Responsibilities



Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.



Education



Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.



Experience



Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data-related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data-driven initiatives.
Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.



Functional Competencies

Compliance

Governance, Risk and Control

Analytics and reporting

IT Tools and application

Cost and budget control

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Business Acumen

Contract Management

Management of change application

GENERAL INFORMATION

It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at www.sbmoffshore.com. The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Title: Analista de Dados (m/f) - SHEQ
Description:
Descrição da Oportunidade

Estamos a reforçar a equipa SHEQ Corporativa, responsável por apoiar a definição de diretrizes, standards, indicadores e práticas de gestão em Segurança, Saúde, Ambiente e Qualidade em todo o Grupo. Uma das nossas prioridades é evoluir para uma gestão SHEQ cada vez mais orientada por dados, capaz de antecipar riscos, identificar tendências e apoiar decisões mais informadas.

Procuramos um/a Analista de Dados para apoiar a definição, recolha, tratamento, automatização e análise de dados SHEQ, transformando informação operacional proveniente de diferentes fontes em dashboards, indicadores e insights acionáveis para diferentes níveis da organização.

Em articulação com a equipa SHEQ Corporativa, IT e equipas SHEQ e operacionais das várias unidades de negócio, contribuirá para transformar dados e tendências em informação útil para antecipar riscos, melhorar decisões e reforçar o desempenho SHEQ do Grupo

Requisitos da Função


Formação superior em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia e Gestão Industrial ou área equivalente.
Experiência mínima de 3 anos em análise de dados, Business Intelligence, reporting corporativo, gestão e consolidação de informação ou funções similares.
Domínio de Power BI, DAX e Power Query, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards e relatórios corporativos.
Conhecimentos sólidos de SQL e bases de dados relacionais. Conhecimentos de Python ou de outras linguagens de análise e tratamento de dados serão valorizados.
Experiência na recolha, tratamento, validação, harmonização e consolidação de dados provenientes de múltiplos projetos, empresas ou unidades de negócio.
Conhecimentos de modelação de dados, definição de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e estruturação de modelos de informação para suporte à tomada de decisão.
Experiência na integração e automatização de fluxos de dados, incluindo processos ETL, APIs, Power Platform ou ferramentas equivalentes.
Conhecimentos de estatística aplicada e análise exploratória de dados, incluindo a identificação de tendências, correlações, desvios e fatores de risco. Experiência em analítica avançada ou modelos preditivos será valorizada.
Conhecimentos de governação, qualidade e gestão de dados, assegurando a sua integridade, consistência, rastreabilidade e comparabilidade entre diferentes fontes de informação.
Fluência em português (obrigatório) e inglês (mínimo B2). Conhecimentos de espanhol ou francês serão valorizados.
Conhecimento dos processos e indicadores de Segurança, Saúde, Ambiente e Qualidade (SHEQ), incluindo gestão de incidentes, auditorias, inspeções, observações, riscos, não conformidades e desempenho ambiental, será valorizado.
Conhecimento dos referenciais ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 será valorizado.
Disponibilidade para deslocações pontuais a projetos e mercados internacionais.


Principais tarefas


Definição, em articulação com as áreas SHEQ e operacionais, dos indicadores, dados e critérios de reporte necessários à monitorização do desempenho SHEQ.
Estruturação, harmonização e validação de dados provenientes de diferentes empresas, geografias e sistemas, assegurando a sua qualidade, consistência e comparabilidade.
Automatização dos processos de recolha, consolidação e tratamento de dados, promovendo a fiabilidade da informação.
Colaboração no desenvolvimento e melhoria contínua de plataformas, ferramentas de reporte e soluções digitais de suporte aos processos SHEQ.
Integração e análise de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, identificando tendências, desvios, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria.
Desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos corporativos, assegurando a qualidade e atualização da informação.
Produção de análises e insights sobre indicadores SHEQ, incluindo incidentes, auditorias, inspeções, não conformidades, ações corretivas e desempenho ambiental.
Implementação de mecanismos de monitorização da qualidade dos dados e promoção de boas práticas de governação da informação.
Apoio à identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria através da análise de tendências e do cruzamento de dados entre processos e unidades de negócio.
Exploração de soluções de análise avançada, inteligência artificial e modelos preditivos aplicados à melhoria do desempenho SHEQ.
Apoio à realização de auditorias internas e externas.


Perfil de competências


Pensamento analítico e rigor, com preocupação pela qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados.
Capacidade de comunicar através dos dados, traduzindo análises complexas em informação clara, útil e orientada à decisão.
Visão de negócio e sensibilidade SHEQ, compreendendo os processos operacionais e as necessidades de informação que suportam a tomada de decisão.
Autonomia e proatividade, com capacidade para propor soluções e promover a melhoria contínua.
Colaboração e relacionamento interpessoal, trabalhando em articulação com equipas SHEQ, IT, outras áreas corporativas e operacionais das diferentes unidades de negócio.
Curiosidade técnica e aprendizagem contínua, acompanhando a evolução das ferramentas de dados, automação e análise avançada.
Adaptabilidade e sensibilidade intercultural, essenciais num contexto internacional e multissetorial.
Orientação para o impacto, contribuindo para a melhoria do desempenho SHEQ e para a criação de valor para o Grupo.


O que oferecemos


Integração num Grupo multinacional de referência, com presença internacional e projetos em diferentes setores e geografias.
Oportunidade de desempenhar uma função com impacto direto na forma como a informação SHEQ é recolhida, analisada e utilizada para suportar a tomada de decisão.
Participação em iniciativas de transformação digital, contribuindo para a evolução dos sistemas de informação, indicadores e ferramentas de gestão SHEQ.
Trabalho com dados provenientes de diferentes projetos, empresas e geografias, proporcionando uma visão abrangente do negócio e dos seus desafios operacionais.
Colaboração com equipas multidisciplinares das áreas SHEQ, Operações, Tecnologia e Gestão.
Possibilidade de aplicar e desenvolver competências em análise de dados, automação, Business Intelligence e análise avançada.
Ambiente de aprendizagem contínua, com contacto com diferentes realidades operacionais, culturas e práticas de gestão.

Title: Finance/Data Anlayst
Description:
Who are we ?




Quanteam, founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, is a consulting firm specialized in Banking and Financial Services. With more than 1200 consultants across 10 countries, we combine business and IT expertise to support leading institutions in transformation projects.

Our core areas:

➡Quantitative Finance

➡Risk & Compliance

➡Operations & Finance

➡Transformation & Organization

➡ Information Systems.




🔎 We are looking for a Finance/Data Anlayst




We are looking for a Financial Data Analyst / BI Analyst to join our team in Porto, combining strong analytical skills with a solid understanding of Finance. The role has an approximately 50/50 split between Data & BI and Finance, with a strong focus on Power BI, data modelling, reporting, reconciliation and internal stakeholder support:




Main Tasks

Aggregate and consolidate data from multiple sources, ensuring data quality, consistency and reliability.
Build data models and Power BI dashboards from scratch, translating business and financial needs into clear and actionable reporting solutions.
Develop and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards, using Power Query and DAX to transform data and create relevant KPIs and metrics.
Support financial closing and reconciliation activities, analysing discrepancies and ensuring the accuracy of financial information.
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, understanding their needs and providing data-driven insights and reporting solutions.




Requirements

3–4 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Finance Analytics, Controlling or a related field.
Strong experience with Power BI, including DAX and Power Query, with the ability to develop dashboards and data models independently.
Advanced Excel skills and a strong analytical mindset; some exposure to Python is valued.
Academic background in Finance, Economics, Business, IT, Data Analytics, or a related field combining Finance and Technology.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proactive and business-oriented approach.
Hybrid model in Porto Office




🎁 WHAT WE OFFER

This role offers a gross annual salary between 22.500€ to 37.000€, defined according to the candidate’s experience and competencies.
Permanent contract (CTI).
Meal allowance.
Health Insurance.
Extra holiday: Christmas Eve or New Year’s Eve.
Access to Quanteam Academy for continuous learning and certifications.
Elevate Program to support professional development and career growth.
Career progression plan.
Ongoing follow-up and technical support provided by a Consultant Expert.

Awareness of Agile culture.
French (B2)

Enable and support end-users and proactively manage all involved stakeholders and relevant communication flows

Title: Customer Data Specialist - F/M/NB
Description:
Cegid is a European leader in cloud management solutions for professionals in the fields of finance (treasury, taxation, ERP), human resources (payroll, talent management), accounting expertise, retail, and entrepreneurship.

In a constantly evolving world, our 5,000 employees help expand the realm of possibilities by supporting our 750,000 clients in realizing their projects and ambitions through useful and innovative solutions.

"Together, expanding possibilities" is the principle that guides our actions. It reflects our identity, our approach, and our motivation to serve our clients. Thanks to this, we can assert that we work every day to shape your future, ours, and that of our clients.

For years, we have been inventing solutions that revolutionize the way our clients work, with a focus on sustainable performance.

Data Specialist – Voice of Customer Program

As a Data Specialist, you will play a crucial role in supporting our Customer Experience team by analyzing and interpreting data to drive strategic decision-making. Your primary responsibility will be to lead and maintain a comprehensive Voice of Customer program, providing actionable insights and recommendations based on data analysis. You will integrate a cross-responsibility team and collaborate closely with the multiple business teams to identify key performance indicators on customer satisfaction to uncover opportunities for improvement.

Key Responsibilities


Collect, consolidate, and validate customer feedback from multiple sources
Perform in-depth analysis of data to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
Analyze customer feedback to identify trends, patterns, and pain points
Generate actionable recommendations from data findings
Create reports and visualizations to communicate key insights to stakeholders
Assist in designing customer feedback surveys and collection channels
Prepare and maintain customer contact databases; ensure data quality and completeness
Track program performance and support regular reviews
Collaborate with cross functional teams to prioritize and address top customer priorities
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, and analyze significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Proficiency in creating interactive dashboards and reports using Excel and PowerBI.
Familiar with survey tools such as Qualtrics (pref) or Survey Monkey and CRM tools such as Salesforce or MS Dynamics.
Knowledge on Python and SQL for data extraction, manipulation and automation is highly desirable.
Prompt engineering for extracting insights from customer feedback
Familiar with Customer Experience fundamentals and Voice of Customer methodologies and metrics (e.g., NPS, CSAT, Churn)
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex data findings in a clear and concise manner to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent in English and Spanish


> Attractive and transparent remuneration from recruitment > Hybrid work model and flexible working hours > 22 days of vacation per year > Health insurance > Access to online learning platforms and internal academy > Integration into a dynamic, enthusiastic, and constantly growing team

Title: HR Data Analyst
HTML:
A MO é uma marca de moda portuguesa com 30 anos de existência, com mais de 150 pontos de venda internacionais e mais de 120 lojas em Portugal. As nossas coleções destacam-se por serem sinónimo de inspiração e tendência.


Vivemos o princípio Play to Win, desafiando o status quo com coragem, ambição e inovação. Somos colaborativos, diversos e autênticos, e apoiamos o crescimento contínuo das nossas pessoas. É este espírito que procuramos em quem se junta a nós.


Para integrar a equipa de People & Talent da MO e da ZIPPY, na Maia, procuramos um(a):


HR DATA ANALYST


O teu desafio


  • Desenvolver e consolidar relatórios de RH para reporte interno;
  • Assegurar a execução de processos de Talento/RH, nomeadamente avaliação de desempenho, orçamento, revisão salarial, clima organizacional, etc.;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua, otimização e automatização de ferramentas e processos de RH, promovendo uma maior eficiência;
  • Extrair, tratar, analisar e apresentar dados de RH, gerando insights que apoiem as decisões estratégicas e táticas da empresa;
  • Participar na criação de dashboards que ofereçam insights valiosos para diferentes áreas do negócio;
  • Desenvolver projetos estratégicos de RH, de acordo com os objetivos organizacionais e de impacto no negócio;
  • Acompanhar KPIs de RH e propor soluções e iniciativas suportadas por dados, com vista à melhoria da eficácia dos processos


Requisitos


  • Formação Académica: Licenciatura em Economia, Gestão, Engenharia e Gestão Industrial ou áreas afins
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência, preferencialmente em funções similares na área dos Recursos Humanos;
  • Conhecimentos avançados de Excel e experiência no manuseamento de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas de análise como Access, SQL, Power BI (preferencial);
  • Conhecimentos da ferramenta SAP/Success Factors (preferencial);
  • Espírito colaborativo e capacidade de interação e comunicação com diversos stakeholders;
  • Proatividade, rigor e uma abordagem orientada para a melhoria contínua;
  • Forte sentido crítico e atenção ao detalhe;
  • Excelente capacidade de organização e capacidade de gerir vários projetos simultaneamente.


Celebramos o teu compromisso, e, por isso, oferecemos:


  • Integração num contexto de fast-fashion retail, caracterizado por uma cultura dinâmica, informal e de inovação alimentada pela singularidade de cada uma das nossas pessoas;
  • Medidas de flexibilidade atrativas e adaptadas à natureza da função, como modelo de trabalho híbrido e horários de entrada e saída flexíveis;
  • Desconto para compra das últimas tendências na MO e na Zippy;
  • Desconto adicional para as marcas: Salsa e Continente;
  • Oportunidades de formação contínua e e-learning;
  • Valorização do talento interno através de programas de mobilidade;
  • Fruta e café gratuitos diariamente nos nossos escritórios.


Made for MOre

Title: Marketing Data & Operations Analyst
Description:
About the role

We're building the operational backbone of our Marketing division, and we're looking for someone who combines analytical rigour with hands-on execution. If you enjoy working where data, process and commercial impact meet, and you're as comfortable in Excel as you are presenting to leadership, this role is for you.

You'll work across our Mobile & Internet products, supporting performance analysis, reporting, CRM operations and marketing content, with real ownership from day one.




Before you apply

We can only consider candidates already based in Portugal. Non-EU citizens must hold a valid work authorisation for full-time employment in Portugal, along with NIF and NISS numbers. Please send your CV in English.




What you'll do

Track and analyse weekly competitive benchmarks across Mobile & Internet
Own Marketing and Sales reporting on a weekly and monthly cadence
Run ad-hoc performance analyses in Excel or Power BI and propose optimisation recommendations
Help prepare executive-level Marketing and Sales presentations in PowerPoint
Cross-check partner reports and prepare the corresponding Credit Notes and Invoices
Transform customer data files into batch-ready formats and run batch operations
Make customer offer adjustments directly in the CRM
Create Device and Product Factsheets and set up new devices in the CRM (images, factsheets)
Audit device prices across channels after each pricing update




What you bring

Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field
3+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, ideally in telecommunications
A sharp analytical mindset, strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy
Advanced Excel, Power BI and PowerPoint skills
Comfort using AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini or similar)
Ability to work autonomously, take ownership and collaborate across teams
Strong organisational and project management skills
Fluent English (C2)
Nice to have: French, SQL




What we offer

Meal and transportation allowances
Health insurance (from month 6)
Hybrid work model after the trial period
Real opportunities to grow professionally in a motivated, collaborative team







If this sounds like your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: SAP Business Intelligence & Data Analytics Specialist (m/f/d)
Description:
Your role in our team

As a Data Scientist (m/f/d), you will drive data-driven decision-making across our organization. You will design and develop new data products for our service business, with a particular focus on company-wide reporting. In the future, you will also support organizational development through the introduction and application of process mining tools for process analysis and optimization.

In addition, you will be responsible for further data-related development initiatives and provide valuable insights through your analyses to support strategic decision-making. Your work will strengthen a data-driven culture and enable data-powered services, giving you a direct impact on the success of the entire organization.



Design and develop data models based on SAP Datasphere
Create analytical dashboards and reports with defined KPIs in SAP Analytics Cloud and identify optimization opportunities based on the results
Implement, document, and roll out developed data models
Lead data-driven projects and initiatives as a Project Manager or Program Manager
Build and implement a Process Mining solution to enable root cause analyses



Your profile



Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, or a related field
Strong passion for data, analytics, and business processes, combined with excellent conceptual thinking skills
Strong technical capabilities and the ability to solve complex business challenges in a structured manner
Good understanding of business contexts and the ability to identify opportunities where data analytics can improve processes and performance
Solid knowledge of data analysis methods and models
Confident working with large datasets and experienced in using databases and data visualization tools
Proficient to advanced knowledge of SQL and practical experience with SAP; knowledge of Python is an advantage
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present findings clearly, persuasively, and in a stakeholder-oriented manner



Your Benefits



Thrive in an international, collaborative and fun work environment
Meaningful and challenging responsibilities that make a difference in a fast-growing industry
Diverse opportunities for further development
Competitive compensation package
Modern office, flexible working time and remote work option

Title: Data Engineer & Analyst
Description:
Snapshot of your day

At Siemens Energy, we are building the next-generation HR Data Platform - a global foundation for data consolidation, governance, and analytics. We are looking for a hybrid Data Engineer & Analyst who can bridge the gap between raw data infrastructure and business intelligence.

In this role, you will own the full data lifecycle: from maintaining the consolidation layer and pipelines of our HR Data Hub to designing the final reporting solutions that empower strategic workforce decisions. You will ensure our data is not only technically sound but also accessible and insightful for business stakeholders.

How You’ll Make a Difference


Data Pipeline & Transformation Management: Design and maintain the transformation layer (using dbt and SQL) for the Internal Platform, ensuring raw data is effectively consolidated and modeled for downstream use
Analytics & Dashboarding: Develop and optimize dashboards (PowerBI) to provide key insights for HR and Operations units, directly supporting strategic business decisions
Data Quality & Governance: Act as a guardian for data integrity by implementing governance practices and monitoring data quality patterns to find and fix common issues in structured and unstructured data
Legacy Migration & Optimization: Lead or support migration projects to move legacy data pipelines to modern cloud infrastructure, aiming to eliminate technical debt, reduce costs, and restore stakeholder trust
Process Automation: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive data processing and reporting tasks (using Python or SQL procedures), reducing manual handling time for the HR team
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Establish clear documentation for data models and processes, creating a central knowledge base to ensure continuity and team alignment



What You Bring


Hybrid Experience: Proven cross-industry experience acting as both a Data Engineer and Data Analyst, with the ability to navigate complex pipelines and deliver business-facing insights
Core Engineering Stack: Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and Python for data manipulation, along with experience in modern Data Warehousing (Snowflake)
Transformation & Visualization: Proficiency with dbt for data transformation and major visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar)
Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to troubleshooting, with experience in navigating complex or legacy data environments and driving infrastructure improvements
Communication: Fluent in English (C2 level preferred) with the ability to translate technical data concepts into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders
Education: Background in Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field



About The Team

You will be working within the Human Resources function – People Systems and Services, a truly global and diverse team of specialists with an open mindset, responsible for guaranteeing operational performance and budget alignment of HR Systems & Services, ensuring, and maintaining fit-for-purpose HR systems and processes, safeguarding end-to-end delivery while promoting Siemens Energy digital transformation. You will get all the trust and empowerment to be successful.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits


Competitive salary and meal allowance
Fair compensation for international work
Health insurance coverage
Remote work permitted within the country
Additional 5 “Pontes” days off and Birthday off if it falls on a weekday, when not abroad (only applies for Portugal)
Among others



https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

Title: Advanced Analytics Consultant - Braga
HTML:
Queres integrar uma das maiores organizações na prestação de serviços profissionais do mercado?

Então a Deloitte é para ti. Aqui, vais ter a possibilidade de potenciar a tua carreira e de reforçar as tuas competências no nosso universo tecnológico.

Somos um Tech Hub internacional e estamos à procura dos melhores especialistas em Data para se juntarem aos nossos centros de excelência e à nossa comunidade. Na Deloitte, vais transformar o mundo como o conhecemos e desenvolver soluções únicas e inovadoras nos mais variados e complexos projetos de transformação, de Portugal para o mundo. Vamos reforçar a nossa área de Analytics e procuramos profissionais experientes que tenham gosto e aptidão natural para trabalhar em equipa e em ambiente multi-projeto. Podes descobrir todas as funções que vais desempenhar, de acordo com o teu perfil, para assim dares um salto na tua carreira!

Juntas-te a nós? Estamos à tua espera.

O teu dia a dia e responsabilidades:

  • Planear e executar com autonomia as atividades a realizar na elaboração dos diversos outputs no âmbito de um projeto;
  • Gerir responsavelmente e de acordo com a sua esfera de atuação as relações diárias com o cliente.


És tu quem procuramos?

  • Formação superior nas áreas de Engenharia Informática, Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores ou similar;
  • Anos de experiência: 2 a 5 anos em consultoria e em Business Intelligence/ Analytics;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em data mining & Machine Learning;
  • Conhecimentos técnicos em R, Python, SAS Machine Learning e IBM Watson ou ferramentas similares;
  • Conhecimento da língua inglesa no domínio falado e escrito;
  • Conhecimento da língua portuguesa no domínio falado e escrito;
  • Orientação para o cliente e para resultados;
  • Comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal, trabalho em equipa e colaboração;
  • Resolução de problemas, capacidade analítica e espírito crítico;
  • Organização, planeamento e orientação para a qualidade dos projetos;
  • Orientação para o cliente e para resultados;
  • Residência em Portugal obrigatória.


Desenvolve uma carreira à tua medida

  • Num contexto de trabalho diverso que permite um desenvolvimento e aprendizagem contínuos;
  • Através de um plano de desenvolvimento de carreira personalizado (skills/ oportunidades técnicas e funcionais), adequado ao momento, às tuas necessidades e objetivos;
  • Participando em projetos nacionais e internacionais, com dimensão e impacto relevante nesta área de especialização;
  • Acesso ilimitado às maiores plataformas de aprendizagem online (Linkedin Learning e Udemy);
  • Oportunidade de formações e certificações nas mais recentes tecnologias, nomeadamente em tecnologias Cloud.


Vive uma cultura de união

  • Uma cultura de inovação e excelência que nos torna líderes e precursores de tendências;
  • Um ambiente amigável, de respeito, confiança, transparência e informalidade;
  • Uma rede para a vida que te faz estar ligado ao melhor conhecimento ao lado de líderes e especialistas;
  • Uma oportunidade para fazeres parte das nossas comunidades (de Tech, inovação, desporto e outros interesses) e para participares ativamente em projetos de responsabilidade social.


Sobre a Deloitte

Na Deloitte nunca trabalharás sozinho. Terás a oportunidade de integrar diversos projetos de transformação e fazer parte de uma equipa que te vai inspirar e ajudar a desenvolver soluções diferenciadoras, num ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde podes dar o melhor de ti e beneficiar das nossas iniciativas de bem-estar e flexibilidade. Somos mais de 5.500 pessoas em Portugal, das quais mais de 2.600 trabalham em áreas tecnológicas, a partir de escritórios e Digital Studios em Lisboa, Porto, Braga, Viseu, Coimbra e Faro e de polos tecnológicos em Braga. Além disso, as nossas equipas em Portugal têm projeção internacional, o que demonstra a nossa forte liderança global em low code/no code, em engenharia de redes de telecomunicações, em plataformas tecnológicas de transformação organizacional (ServiceNow e Apptio) e na indústria de serviços financeiros (Finastra, TIA e Guidewire).

Se tens interesse em explorar e desenvolver as tuas competências nalguma destas áreas em soluções tecnológicas – engenharia de software, cloud, integração de sistemas, data analytics & data science, cyber risk, engenharia de redes telecomunicações, UX design - e gostarias de trabalhar com tecnologias como AWS, Google, Oracle, Salesforce, SAP, Mulesoft, Feedzai e SAS, entre outras, então estás no lugar certo!

Title: Business Analyst & Advisor
HTML:
Somos uma empresa de todos e para todos. Na MC, colocamos as pessoas no centro: clientes, colaboradores e comunidade. Criamos valor juntos, inovamos a cada passo e lideramos de forma próxima, reconhecendo as qualidades de cada um. Diferentes histórias e ideias unem-nos no mesmo propósito: crescer e chegar à melhor versão de nós próprios. Porque tudo o que somos, conseguimos juntos.


Temos experiências, perspetivas e percursos diferentes, mas partilhamos a mesma ambição: construir melhores soluções para os nossos clientes e alcançar, juntos, a nossa melhor versão.


Por isso, junta-te a nós!


Estamos à procura de Business Analyst & Advisor para a nossa equipa de Assortment Analytics (CoE), em Matosinhos, e acreditamos que seremos #betterwithyou!


Integrarás o Centro de Excelência de Assortment, uma equipa que trabalha em estreita colaboração com as áreas Comerciais e de Operações para garantir a definição e otimização das gamas de produtos nas nossas lojas. Terás um papel ativo na geração de insights, na análise de dados e na recomendação de soluções que contribuam para decisões estratégicas centradas no cliente e no crescimento sustentável do negócio.

Title: Product Analytics Team Lead
Description:
HEY THERE

You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half.

Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.

You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION

Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:


Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next
Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on
Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up
Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it
Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before
Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool
Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions


YOUR PROFILE

You'll feel at home here if:


You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course
You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself
Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways
You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through
You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data
When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it


Bonus points for:


Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)
A strong statistics background
Dagster or Airflow for scheduling
Data catalogues like DataHub


OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we run in production:


Warehouse: Snowflake
Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster
Experimentation: GrowthBook
Self-service analytics: Omni
ML workflows: Prefect
GenAI: Claude


If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.

WHY US?


An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating
A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year
30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you
A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!
A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement
A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks
Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development
A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:


Your CV in English
Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



The HR Reporting and Analytics Manager is responsible for managing HR data and analytics to deliver actionable insights that support strategic business decisions.
This role ensures the accuracy, security, and accessibility of HR data across systems, collaborates with key stakeholders to align reporting capabilities with business needs, and drives continuous improvement in data reporting, visualization, and analytics.



Responsibilities



Oversee the collection, organization, and validation of HR data across multiple platforms to ensure accuracy and integrity. Develop and maintain HR dashboards, reports, and analytics tools that provide high-quality, actionable insights to support decision-making at all levels.
Partner with HR leadership and the HRIS team to align reporting and analytics strategies with broader HR and business goals, ensuring that reporting capabilities meet evolving organizational needs and support workforce planning, performance metrics, and other strategic initiatives.
Work closely with IT, Digital, and HR teams to enhance data integration, improve reporting processes, and ensure data accessibility. Act as the primary liaison for data analytics-related initiatives, promoting a data-driven culture within HR.
Identify and implement improvements to reporting and analytics processes, leveraging new tools, technology, and best practices to enhance data-driven decision-making across HR functions. Drive the adoption of advanced analytics techniques to anticipate trends and support predictive insights.
Ensure all HR data management and reporting practices adhere to internal governance standards, regulatory requirements, and data privacy regulations, and other applicable laws.
Lead and mentor HR Reporting and Analytics team, ensuring effective task assignment, skills development and alignment with team and business goals. Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and professional growth within the team.



Education



Bachelor’s degree in HR, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.



Experience



Proven experience in HR reporting, data analytics, and data management within a corporate environment.
Strong knowledge of HR systems (such as SAP SuccessFactors), data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and data governance practices.
Demonstrated ability to interpret complex data, communicate insights effectively, and align reporting strategies with business objectives.
Excellent leadership and project management skills, with a focus on driving results and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Tools and data governance

Digital savvy

Innovation

A nossa equipa de Supply Chain está a crescer!

A hôma procura um(a) Inventory Analyst, com reporte direto à Supply Chain Planning Manager, para garantir a gestão eficiente e otimizada dos níveis de stock. Esta função será responsável por analisar e monitorizar inventários em armazéns e lojas, definir parâmetros de reaprovisionamento e otimizar a distribuição de stock entre localizações, assegurando disponibilidade e evitando excessos.

  • Analisar e monitorizar os níveis de stock nos armazéns e lojas para garantir disponibilidade e evitar excessos;
  • Definir parâmetros de reaprovisionamento e otimizar a distribuição dos stocks entre as localizações;
  • Produzir relatórios de performance de inventário, identificando desvios e propondo ações corretivas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização de inventário;
  • Colaborar com a Logística para assegurar a distribuição atempada de stocks;
  • Suportar a precisão dos dados mestre relacionados com inventário e supply chain;
  • Apoiar a definição de políticas de gestão de stocks e melhoria contínua;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipas de Supply Planning e Demand Planning para garantir alinhamento estratégico.

O que vamos valorizar no teu perfil…

  • Licenciatura em Gestão, Engenharia Industrial, Estatística ou similar;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em análise de inventário, supply chain ou funções semelhantes;
  • Proficiência avançada em Excel, Power BI e ferramentas de análise de dados;
  • Fluência em inglês e/ou francês (valorizado);
  • Atenção ao detalhe e capacidade de interpretar grandes volumes de dados;
  • Excelentes competências analíticas e de resolução de problema.

Se procuras um desafio onde possas ter um impacto direto na eficiência da gestão de inventário e na otimização da cadeia de abastecimento, e onde o teu trabalho diário contribui para garantir a disponibilidade de produto e uma operação mais eficiente, então queremos conhecer-te!

Title: Marketing Data Scientist
Description:
About Us 🚀

Hostelworld is the world's leading Social Travel platform - a social network-powered OTA on a mission to help travellers find their people and create unforgettable moments together. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Ireland, we're a team of around 270 people serving hostel partners across more than 180 countries.

Since launching our social network in 2022, we've welcomed over 3.4 million social members who aren't just booking trips, they're messaging, finding events, meeting up and becoming powerful brand advocates. This community generates a rich proprietary dataset of 16 million+ chat messages and 17 million bookings, powering AI-driven personalisation and network effects that no generalist OTA can replicate.

We are not just another OTA - we created an entirely new category – Social Travel. If you want to shape the future of travel by putting people and shared experiences at the heart of it, you'll fit right in here - Learn more about our Team!

Our Culture

At Hostelworld, our culture is a direct reflection of our customers: adventurous, curious, and social. We have a shared love of travel that fuels our work and connects us on a deeper level. It’s a fast-paced environment that blends the agility and "scrappy" resourcefulness of a start-up with the experience and ambition of a global, publicly listed company.

We are a team of pragmatic optimists who are data-obsessed and results-driven. We value a ‘test and learn’ mindset, encouraging experimentation and empowering our teams to take calculated risks. We believe in doing the right thing—for our customers, our partners, and each other. We foster a supportive and collaborative atmosphere where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and where every team member has the opportunity to make a significant impact on our journey. We embrace the journey, not just the destination, and we seek leaders who will thrive in a dynamic environment and inspire their teams to do the same.

LOCATION🌍

This role is based in Portugal. We have an office hub in Porto available for those who prefer a hybrid model where you can spend time with colleagues in-person. You will need to be able to commute to our office hub as required from time to time.

Who You'll Work With 👨🏽‍🤝‍👨🏼

You will play a key role in a diverse, highly-talented Analytics & Insights team providing insights across a number of growth units including paid marketing, customer analytics and app analytics to support decision making at C and senior management level. The Marketing Data Scientist will play a pivotal role in driving data-informed marketing strategies and decisions, with a particular emphasis on managing and optimising Google Ads bidding algorithms. As a key member of the Analytics and Insights team, this role will involve close collaboration with paid marketing, app marketing, and data teams to uncover insights, optimise campaigns, and contribute to business growth.

What You'll Do 👩‍💻

You will hone and develop a wide range of technical skills in managing our data analytics and data science products. The paid analytics team require a person who is flexible, adaptable and able to translate business needs into measurable results. It’s a rewarding experience with exciting diverse work:

Bidding & spend optimisation


Develop, manage and optimise bidding algorithms for Google Ads campaigns (Search and Hotel Price Ads) using Python, translating business objectives into bidding logic that maximises profitability (Direct Margin).
Optimise budget allocation across channels, markets and campaigns using elasticity and response-curve models to improve profitability.
Continuously monitor campaign performance, identify inefficiencies and evolve the bidding logic accordingly.


Marketing measurement & incrementality


Design, run and analyse incrementality tests (geo-lift / holdout experiments) using causal inference methods such as synthetic control, Bayesian structural time series and difference-in-differences to quantify the true incremental impact of paid channels.
Build and maintain marketing mix models (MMM) to estimate channel contribution, saturation and diminishing returns, and translate the outputs into budget recommendations.
Own and improve our attribution framework — evaluating multi-touch attribution against experimental results and platform-reported figures, and reconciling the gaps.
Design, implement and analyse A/B tests and other experiments to assess the impact of marketing initiatives, including sample-size, power and pre-registration standards.


Insight & influence


Provide data-driven recommendations on marketing spend, customer acquisition, retention and lifetime value to C-level and senior management.
Serve as a subject-matter expert on data science and measurement best practices within the Analytics & Insights team, and productionise analyses into reusable tools and recurring reports.


What We’re Looking For 👀

Experience & Qualifications:


Minimum 3 years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science role, preferably within a marketing department.
Advanced skills in SQL, Python, R, or similar programming languages.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Communicate clearly and with purpose, working effectively with team members and stakeholders across the organisation.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.


Essential Skills


Competency in Python/R.
SQL (preferably BigQuery, Snowflake).
Strong proficiency in statistical analysis, machine learning, and predictive modelling techniques.


Desirable Skills


Experience with marketing measurement: incrementality / geo-lift testing, holdout experiments.
Applied causal inference: synthetic control, difference-in-differences, Bayesian structural time series (e.g. CausalPy, CausalImpact, PyMC, linearmodels).
Understanding of attribution modelling (multi-touch, data-driven attribution) and its limitations relative to experimental measurement.
Understanding of digital marketing metrics, SEO, SEM and customer-journey analysis.
Experience with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) or building lightweight apps (Streamlit).
Familiarity with orchestration and ETL/ELT tools (Apache Airflow, dbt).
Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative code review.


What We Offer 💯


Competitive salary & benefits
Enhanced annual leave plus 3 Wellbeing Days per year
Paid family leave (maternity, paternity, surrogacy & adoption)
Agile working (plus a Working from Abroad Policy!)
Support for your ongoing growth & development
Inclusive people policies (sickness, menopause, compassionate and fertility leave)
A chance to give back to your local community with 5 paid volunteering days


OUR BEHAVIOURS 🏆


Grow others - We fundamentally believe that investing in growing others benefits everyone, whether it's helping them develop hard or soft skills. We want learning and growing to be part of our DNA to help makes us a better team, together.
Master it - We are obsessed with our area of expertise and enjoy developing our skills. We rarely take things at face value; we investigate, interrogate, and always look for ‘the why,’ and wherever possible, we use data to find the best solution.
Collaborate - We are in it together, for the tough stuff and the celebrations too. To achieve the best results, we need expertise from all areas of the organisation, and we wholeheartedly welcome diverse thinking.
Adapt - We work fluidly, adapting to new information and the evolving environment while staying committed to our goals. Innovation and experimentation fuel our projects and we’re never afraid to pivot.
Deliver - Our focus is always on the end result; we value outcomes over activity. We collaborate to deliver work at speed without dropping any of our other behaviours.


We believe in talented and diverse teams that reflect the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we operate. Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences. We lay out the above requirements to guide applicants to the experiences that we believe will allow you to be successful in the role. If you don’t meet them all, please consider applying if you think you can still perform the role as described.

Hostelworld Group plc is a ground-breaking social network-powered Online Travel Agent ("OTA") with a clear mission to help travellers find people to hang out with.

Our mission is founded on the insight that most travellers go hostelling to meet other people. Our platform connects travellers through a range of social features, including city and hostel chat rooms, AI-powered recommendations, and event discovery, facilitating real-world interactions before, during and after their trips.

Hostelworld's vision is to be the world's leading social travel platform. Since launching its social network in 2022, the Group has welcomed over 4.0 million social members, with engagement growing faster than stays booked. Social members book approximately twice as frequently as non-members and are three times more likely to use the app, demonstrating the platform's utility and its contribution to customer lifetime value.

Our proprietary dataset, spanning over 4.0 million social members, 19.0 million chat messages and 19.0 million bookings since launch, strengthens our ability to understand traveller behaviour, personalise experiences, and build network effects that differentiate Hostelworld from generalist OTAs. This data asset, which is exclusively ours and compounds in value as our community grows, underpins our AI-powered matching and recommendation capabilities.

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Ireland, Hostelworld is a recognised brand with around 275 employees, hostel and accommodation partners across more than 180 countries, and a growing suite of products including budget accommodation and Social Passes that extend the platform well beyond the traditional hostelling category.

Hostelworld has a long-standing commitment to improving the sustainability of the hostelling industry. The Group has introduced a hostel-specific Staircase to Sustainability framework, accredited by the Global Sustainable Tourism Council, which helps partners adopt more sustainable practices while giving travellers clearer information for decision-making. Customers can choose to offset trip emissions, and for the fifth consecutive year the Group has retained the 'Taking Climate Action' label from South Pole.
