It’s a fast-paced environment that blends the agility and "scrappy" resourcefulness of a start-up with the experience and ambition of a global, publicly listed company.

We are a team of pragmatic optimists who are data-obsessed and results-driven. We value a ‘test and learn’ mindset, encouraging experimentation and empowering our teams to take calculated risks. We believe in doing the right thing—for our customers, our partners, and each other. We foster a supportive and collaborative atmosphere where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and where every team member has the opportunity to make a significant impact on our journey. We embrace the journey, not just the destination, and we seek leaders who will thrive in a dynamic environment and inspire their teams to do the same.

LOCATION🌍

This role is based in Portugal. We have an office hub in Porto available for those who prefer a hybrid model where you can spend time with colleagues in-person. You will need to be able to commute to our office hub as required from time to time.

Who You'll Work With 👨🏽‍🤝‍👨🏼

You will play a key role in a diverse, highly-talented Analytics & Insights team providing insights across a number of growth units including paid marketing, customer analytics and app analytics to support decision making at C and senior management level. The Marketing Data Scientist will play a pivotal role in driving data-informed marketing strategies and decisions, with a particular emphasis on managing and optimising Google Ads bidding algorithms. As a key member of the Analytics and Insights team, this role will involve close collaboration with paid marketing, app marketing, and data teams to uncover insights, optimise campaigns, and contribute to business growth.

What You'll Do 👩‍💻

You will hone and develop a wide range of technical skills in managing our data analytics and data science products. The paid analytics team require a person who is flexible, adaptable and able to translate business needs into measurable results. It’s a rewarding experience with exciting diverse work:

Bidding & spend optimisation

  • Develop, manage and optimise bidding algorithms for Google Ads campaigns (Search and Hotel Price Ads) using Python, translating business objectives into bidding logic that maximises profitability (Direct Margin).
  • Optimise budget allocation across channels, markets and campaigns using elasticity and response-curve models to improve profitability.
  • Continuously monitor campaign performance, identify inefficiencies and evolve the bidding logic accordingly.

Marketing measurement & incrementality

  • Design, run and analyse incrementality tests (geo-lift / holdout experiments) using causal inference methods such as synthetic control, Bayesian structural time series and difference-in-differences to quantify the true incremental impact of paid channels.
  • Build and maintain marketing mix models (MMM) to estimate channel contribution, saturation and diminishing returns, and translate the outputs into budget recommendations.
  • Own and improve our attribution framework — evaluating multi-touch attribution against experimental results and platform-reported figures, and reconciling the gaps.
  • Design, implement and analyse A/B tests and other experiments to assess the impact of marketing initiatives, including sample-size, power and pre-registration standards.

Insight & influence

  • Provide data-driven recommendations on marketing spend, customer acquisition, retention and lifetime value to C-level and senior management.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on data science and measurement best practices within the Analytics & Insights team, and productionise analyses into reusable tools and recurring reports.

What We’re Looking For 👀

Experience & Qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science role, preferably within a marketing department.
  • Advanced skills in SQL, Python, R, or similar programming languages.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Communicate clearly and with purpose, working effectively with team members and stakeholders across the organisation.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Essential Skills

  • Competency in Python/R.
  • SQL (preferably BigQuery, Snowflake).
  • Strong proficiency in statistical analysis, machine learning, and predictive modelling techniques.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with marketing measurement: incrementality / geo-lift testing, holdout experiments.
  • Applied causal inference: synthetic control, difference-in-differences, Bayesian structural time series (e.g. CausalPy, CausalImpact, PyMC, linearmodels).
  • Understanding of attribution modelling (multi-touch, data-driven attribution) and its limitations relative to experimental measurement.
  • Understanding of digital marketing metrics, SEO, SEM and customer-journey analysis.
  • Experience with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) or building lightweight apps (Streamlit).
  • Familiarity with orchestration and ETL/ELT tools (Apache Airflow, dbt).
  • Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative code review.

What We Offer 💯

  • Competitive salary & benefits
  • Enhanced annual leave plus 3 Wellbeing Days per year
  • Paid family leave (maternity, paternity, surrogacy & adoption)
  • Agile working (plus a Working from Abroad Policy!)
  • Support for your ongoing growth & development
  • Inclusive people policies (sickness, menopause, compassionate and fertility leave)
  • A chance to give back to your local community with 5 paid volunteering days

OUR BEHAVIOURS 🏆

  • Grow others - We fundamentally believe that investing in growing others benefits everyone, whether it's helping them develop hard or soft skills. We want learning and growing to be part of our DNA to help makes us a better team, together.
  • Master it - We are obsessed with our area of expertise and enjoy developing our skills. We rarely take things at face value; we investigate, interrogate, and always look for ‘the why,’ and wherever possible, we use data to find the best solution.
  • Collaborate - We are in it together, for the tough stuff and the celebrations too. To achieve the best results, we need expertise from all areas of the organisation, and we wholeheartedly welcome diverse thinking.
  • Adapt - We work fluidly, adapting to new information and the evolving environment while staying committed to our goals. Innovation and experimentation fuel our projects and we’re never afraid to pivot.
  • Deliver - Our focus is always on the end result; we value outcomes over activity. We collaborate to deliver work at speed without dropping any of our other behaviours.

We believe in talented and diverse teams that reflect the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we operate. Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences. We lay out the above requirements to guide applicants to the experiences that we believe will allow you to be successful in the role. If you don’t meet them all, please consider applying if you think you can still perform the role as described.

Hostelworld Group plc is a ground-breaking social network-powered Online Travel Agent ("OTA") with a clear mission to help travellers find people to hang out with.

Our mission is founded on the insight that most travellers go hostelling to meet other people. Our platform connects travellers through a range of social features, including city and hostel chat rooms, AI-powered recommendations, and event discovery, facilitating real-world interactions before, during and after their trips.

Hostelworld's vision is to be the world's leading social travel platform. Since launching its social network in 2022, the Group has welcomed over 4.0 million social members, with engagement growing faster than stays booked. Social members book approximately twice as frequently as non-members and are three times more likely to use the app, demonstrating the platform's utility and its contribution to customer lifetime value.

Our proprietary dataset, spanning over 4.0 million social members, 19.0 million chat messages and 19.0 million bookings since launch, strengthens our ability to understand traveller behaviour, personalise experiences, and build network effects that differentiate Hostelworld from generalist OTAs. This data asset, which is exclusively ours and compounds in value as our community grows, underpins our AI-powered matching and recommendation capabilities.

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Ireland, Hostelworld is a recognised brand with around 275 employees, hostel and accommodation partners across more than 180 countries, and a growing suite of products including budget accommodation and Social Passes that extend the platform well beyond the traditional hostelling category.

Hostelworld has a long-standing commitment to improving the sustainability of the hostelling industry. The Group has introduced a hostel-specific Staircase to Sustainability framework, accredited by the Global Sustainable Tourism Council, which helps partners adopt more sustainable practices while giving travellers clearer information for decision-making. Customers can choose to offset trip emissions, and for the fifth consecutive year the Group has retained the 'Taking Climate Action' label from South Pole.

For years, we have been inventing solutions that revolutionize the way our clients work, with a focus on sustainable performance.

Data Specialist – Voice of Customer Program

As a Data Specialist, you will play a crucial role in supporting our Customer Experience team by analyzing and interpreting data to drive strategic decision-making. Your primary responsibility will be to lead and maintain a comprehensive Voice of Customer program, providing actionable insights and recommendations based on data analysis. You will integrate a cross-responsibility team and collaborate closely with the multiple business teams to identify key performance indicators on customer satisfaction to uncover opportunities for improvement.

Collect, consolidate, and validate customer feedback from multiple sources
Perform in-depth analysis of data to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
Analyze customer feedback to identify trends, patterns, and pain points
Generate actionable recommendations from data findings
Create reports and visualizations to communicate key insights to stakeholders
Assist in designing customer feedback surveys and collection channels
Prepare and maintain customer contact databases; ensure data quality and completeness
Track program performance and support regular reviews
Collaborate with cross functional teams to prioritize and address top customer priorities

Proficiency in creating interactive dashboards and reports using Excel and PowerBI.
Familiar with survey tools such as Qualtrics (pref) or Survey Monkey and CRM tools such as Salesforce or MS Dynamics.
Knowledge on Python and SQL for data extraction, manipulation and automation is highly desirable.
Prompt engineering for extracting insights from customer feedback
Familiar with Customer Experience fundamentals and Voice of Customer methodologies and metrics (e.g., NPS, CSAT, Churn)
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex data findings in a clear and concise manner to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Fluent in English and Spanish

Title: Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI
Description:
Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

Natixis in Portugal is currently seeking a Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI to join its BPCE SI (BPCE Solutions Informatiques) team, within the IT (Information Technologies) department, to work in a hybrid work model in the Porto office, to join a data team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business requirements and our Data teams (Data Engineers, Data Analysts). To succeed in this mission, you will not just gather requirements: you will actively dive into the data by writing queries and analyzing our Oracle database tables to understand their structure, quality, and underlying logic.

Key Responsibilities


Write SQL queries to directly query and analyze tables within our database.
Explore and profile raw data to understand its structure, underlying business rules, and to identify potential anomalies.
Work closely with Data teams (Data Engineers, BI, and Analytics) to translate functional business rules into technical requirements.
Draft clear functional and technical specifications (source-to-target data mapping).
Assist business stakeholders in defining their requirements by providing a realistic view of the data actually available in the Oracle systems.
Design and execute test plans (both functional and technical data reconciliation).


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL (Essential): Strong ability to write complex queries (JOINs, subqueries, analytical functions, etc.) to query databases.
5+ years of solid experience as business analyst.
Oracle Environment: Proven experience working with Oracle databases (using tools such as PL/SQL Developer, TOAD, DBeaver, or SQL Developer).
Data Analysis: Ability to analyze data models (tables, views, primary/foreign keys).
Data Modeling: Basic understanding of data architecture concepts (Data Warehouse, Data Marts).
French: Minimum C1 level (fluent/advanced) is required, as you will interact closely with French-speaking business stakeholders and write functional specifications in French. A good level of English is also required.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are committed to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

Title: Data Engineer & Analyst
Description:
Snapshot of your day

At Siemens Energy, we are building the next-generation HR Data Platform - a global foundation for data consolidation, governance, and analytics. We are looking for a hybrid Data Engineer & Analyst who can bridge the gap between raw data infrastructure and business intelligence.

In this role, you will own the full data lifecycle: from maintaining the consolidation layer and pipelines of our HR Data Hub to designing the final reporting solutions that empower strategic workforce decisions. You will ensure our data is not only technically sound but also accessible and insightful for business stakeholders.

How You’ll Make a Difference


Data Pipeline & Transformation Management: Design and maintain the transformation layer (using dbt and SQL) for the Internal Platform, ensuring raw data is effectively consolidated and modeled for downstream use
Analytics & Dashboarding: Develop and optimize dashboards (PowerBI) to provide key insights for HR and Operations units, directly supporting strategic business decisions

You will work with our BI platform team with the BI data science unit . You will build and maintain scalable, high-quality analytical data products that power decision-making across the company. You will enable teams through reliable data models, standardized metrics, and strong data quality, working on large-scale datasets for a global product used by billions of users worldwide.

Responsibilities


Maintain and improve data applications that optimize various business processes
Act as a key interface between platform analytics and data consumers, understanding their needs and translating them into reusable data assets
Ensure data quality, reliability, and freshness through testing, monitoring, and validation
Design and maintain standardized business metrics and KPIs to analyze trends, identify issues, and measure performance across key company activities
Optimize data warehouse pipelines and processes to efficiently handle large-scale datasets for a product used by 2+ billion users worldwide
Diagnose and resolve data issues and outages, participate in on-call rotations, contribute to post-mortems, and proactively suggest improvements to engineering excellence


Requirements


University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience with a strong data focus
3 - 5 years of relevant professional experience in Data, Analytics, or Engineering roles
Strong SQL expertise, including writing complex and performant queries
Basic knowledge of Python for data processing or automation
Hands-on experience delivering data handling and analysis projects
Familiarity with modern software engineering practices applied to data, including testing, modularity, and code reviews
Strong problem-solving skills and high motivation to tackle complex challenges collaboratively
Ability to communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders
Fluency in English with strong communication skills


Nice to Have


Hands-on experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks
Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift)
Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker or Tableau
Experience working with version control systems like Git

Onsite Onboarding in our HQ office for an optimal start

Public transport friendly offices
Option to lease an e-bike (Germany only)
Special terms for local gyms
Access to Corporate Benefits platform with many discounts
Regular Team events and company-wide celebrations
Open door policy, no dress code rules, frequent all Hands and Leadership Lunches
Hybrid and Flexible work time with up to 50% home office
Work From Abroad Program allowing up to 40 days of work outside your contracting country

Description:
Randstad Digital is hiring a Senior HR Business Analyst for direct integration, in a company located in Porto.




Hybrid work model (3 days on-site; 2 days remote / week).




The Senior HR Business Analyst partners closely with HR and business stakeholders to understand their needs and convert them into well‑defined system requirements, data models, and reporting specifications.
The role combines deep HR process expertise with strong analytical skills to interpret data, extract insights, and communicate them in a clear, straightforward, and audience‑aligned manner.
By aligning business priorities with HR technology capabilities, the Senior HR BA ensures that solutions are effective, scalable, and grounded in real operational needs.

Responsible of the design and implementation of the report.
Ensure the proper distribution and process animation.
Ensure that consistent and reliable data is available when needed.

Ensure alignment with external and Company best practices regarding data models, systems and tools as well as governance rules of models, data and reports.
Ensure compliance with the Data & Information Management Framework.
Drive continuous improvements of the data models, systems and tools, based on feedback from stakeholders or identified gaps.
Understand how internal and external events and/or changes will affect systems, tools, data models and relevant reports and recommend necessary actions.
Coordinate activities performed by external parties and monitor the associated deliverables.
Provide data quality checks, analysis and recommendations.

Experience working in Power BI (2+ years), PowerApps, & Microsoft Office Suite (Preferred);
Experience with SAP SF or HCM is a plus:
Interest / understanding of ETL/data aggregation processes, data warehouse;

Title: Data Collection Analyst (Performance Data)
Description:
Overview

Stats Perform is the market leader in sports tech.  We provide the most trusted sports data to some of the world's biggest organizations, across sports, media, and broadcasting.  

Through the latest AI technologies and machine learning, we combine decades' worth of data with the latest in-game happenings. We then offer coaches, teams, professional bodies, and media channels around the world, access to the very best data, content, and insights.  In turn, improving how sports fans interact with their favourite sports teams and competitions.

How do we add value?


Media outlets add a little magic to their coverage with our stats and graphics packages.
Sportsbooks can offer better predictions and more accurate odds.
The world's top coaches are known to use our data to make critical team decisions.
Sports commentators can engage with fans on a deeper level, using our stories and insights.


Anywhere you find sport, Stats Perform is there.  However, data and tech are only half of the package. We need great people to fuel the engine.

We succeeded thanks to a team of amazing people. They spend their days collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from a wide range of live sporting events. If you combine this real-time data with our 40-year-old archives, elite journalists, camera operators, copywriters, the latest in AI wizardry, and a host of 'behind the scenes' support staff, you've got all the ingredients to make it a magical experience!

Responsibilities


WHAT’S YOUR NEW ROLE ABOUT?
Deliver live coverage within our highest standard measures.
Post-match checks applied through the correct guideline procedures.
Expert knowledge in Performance soccer definitions and processes.
Adept at making carefully considered decisions having consulted stakeholders and weighed up


risks with minimal delays.


High knowledge in betting games processes and definitions.
Responsibility for freelancers: support on re-training, definitions and help to improve KPIs.


Required Qualifications:


DO YOU HAVE THESE ESSENTIALS?
Experience as Soccer Performance Analyst.
Excellent organization and communication skills.
English skills.
Complete understanding of collection tools and processes.
Specialist knowledge of worldwide soccer leagues and competition


Desired Qualifications:


IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAD THESE DESIRABLES TOO
Spanish and Portuguese Skills and other languages.
Specialist knowledge of worldwide soccer leagues and competitions.
Organizes own and teamwork by taking into account deadlines and following the established


procedures.


Working collaboratively with a group of people in order to accomplish a task or achieve a goal.


Treats all team members in a respectful, courteous and professional manner; supports team

despite different points of views or setbacks.


Ability to engage and enable people to perform at their best.
Self–motivated and driven to succeed, focused on results and passionate about the job.
On-going learning and development and ability to apply new knowledge.
Ability to adapt to changing business needs, cultures, conditions and work responsibilities.


Why work at Stats Perform?

We love sports, but we love diverse thinking more!

We know that diversity brings creativity, so we invite people from all backgrounds to join us.  At Stats Perform you can make a difference, by using your skills and experience every day, you'll feel valued and respected for your contribution.  

We take care of our colleagues

We like happy and healthy colleagues. You will benefit from things like Mental Health Days Off, ‘No Meeting Fridays,’ and flexible working schedules.

We pull together to build a better workplace and world for all.

We encourage employees to take part in charitable activities, utilize their 2 days of Volunteering Time Off, support our environmental efforts, and be actively involved in Employee Resource Groups.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Stats Perform

By joining Stats Perform, you'll be part of a team that celebrates diversity. A team that is dedicated to creating an inclusive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and welcome. All employees are collectively responsible for developing and maintaining an inclusive environment. That is why our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals underpin our core values.

With increased diversity comes increased innovation and creativity. Ensuring we're best placed to serve our clients and communities. Stats Perform is committed to seeking diversity, equity, and inclusion in all we do.

Title: Risk Analyst - Counterparty

About The Job


The mission of RISK Market & Financial Institutions (“RISK MFI”) is to provide the Senior Management of the Group, of the RISK Function and of Global Markets (“GM”) and of Securities and Services with full transparency and dynamic analysis and monitoring of market, counterparty, valuation and liquidity risks originated and managed by CIB and of credit risks on Financial Institutions in order to assist them in their risk decision making and monitoring. The Management & Supervisory Information Counterparty Risk Team (MSI CCR) is responsible for the identification, measurement and analysis of main credit counterparty risks across asset classes, and the continuing evolution of the MI framework to deliver this. This includes counterparty risk metrics and analysis contributions to the forum between Front Office and RISK Management as well as Senior Management committee. The role is ideal for collaborative individuals with data analysis skills, financial risk interest and attention to detail. It gives the opportunity to gain a holistic and transversal view of counterparty risk originated from different activities while engaging with multiple teams inside and outside RISK


Your main activities are


Production and Analysis of Counterparty and Credit Risk metric of the trading activities of the Group to be included in the (Counterparty Credit Risk) CCR Main Positions documents
Contribute to production of Credit and Counterparty elements of the monthly FMRC documentation, including key highlights or focus papers in order to meet management needs
Contribute to regulatory demands, such as ad-hoc or periodic regulatory demands (e.g. Datagaps I-I, PRA, JST) and related data quality tasks
Identify important metrics or topics, which would be of interest to senior management, contributing to the analysis on specific points of attention
Ensure the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the Counterparty risk metrics and propose improvements when relevant.
Contribute to requests from the Businesses and RISK Management, as well as requests from ratings agencies, regulators and auditors
Understand and being able to explain the Counterparty risk arising from Trading activities and products
Improve existing processes in order to optimize efficiency through automation, improve transparency, enhance functionality and ensure optimal quality of reporting
Adhere to procedures, performing and enhancing controls, data quality processes


Profile And Skills To Succeed


Master degree in Economics, Science or Finance.
2+ years of experience at least in Risk and Controls / Data Analytics or similar
Risk Management - Risk Analysis
Analytical Ability
Attention to detail / rigor
MS Office Pack Microsoft Excel (Proficient)
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Critical Thinking
Ability to develop and adapt a process
Ability to develop and leverage networks
Communication skills, both written and oral

BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner


Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities;
Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses;

Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centers providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees;

Title: Marketing Data Scientist
Description:
About Us 🚀

Hostelworld is the world's leading Social Travel platform - a social network-powered OTA on a mission to help travellers find their people and create unforgettable moments together. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Ireland, we're a team of around 270 people serving hostel partners across more than 180 countries.

Since launching our social network in 2022, we've welcomed over 3.4 million social members who aren't just booking trips, they're messaging, finding events, meeting up and becoming powerful brand advocates. This community generates a rich proprietary dataset of 16 million+ chat messages and 17 million bookings, powering AI-driven personalisation and network effects that no generalist OTA can replicate.

We are not just another OTA - we created an entirely new category – Social Travel. If you want to shape the future of travel by putting people and shared experiences at the heart of it, you'll fit right in here - Learn more about our Team!

Our Culture

At Hostelworld, our culture is a direct reflection of our customers: adventurous, curious, and social. We have a shared love of travel that fuels our work and connects us on a deeper level. It’s a fast-paced environment that blends the agility and "scrappy" resourcefulness of a start-up with the experience and ambition of a global, publicly listed company.

We are a team of pragmatic optimists who are data-obsessed and results-driven. We value a ‘test and learn’ mindset, encouraging experimentation and empowering our teams to take calculated risks. We believe in doing the right thing—for our customers, our partners, and each other. We foster a supportive and collaborative atmosphere where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and where every team member has the opportunity to make a significant impact on our journey. We embrace the journey, not just the destination, and we seek leaders who will thrive in a dynamic environment and inspire their teams to do the same.

LOCATION🌍

This role is based in Portugal. We have an office hub in Porto available for those who prefer a hybrid model where you can spend time with colleagues in-person. You will need to be able to commute to our office hub as required from time to time.

Who You'll Work With 👨🏽‍🤝‍👨🏼

You will play a key role in a diverse, highly-talented Analytics & Insights team providing insights across a number of growth units including paid marketing, customer analytics and app analytics to support decision making at C and senior management level. The Marketing Data Scientist will play a pivotal role in driving data-informed marketing strategies and decisions, with a particular emphasis on managing and optimising Google Ads bidding algorithms. As a key member of the Analytics and Insights team, this role will involve close collaboration with paid marketing, app marketing, and data teams to uncover insights, optimise campaigns, and contribute to business growth.

What You'll Do 👩‍💻

You will hone and develop a wide range of technical skills in managing our data analytics and data science products. The paid analytics team require a person who is flexible, adaptable and able to translate business needs into measurable results. It’s a rewarding experience with exciting diverse work:

Bidding & spend optimisation


Develop, manage and optimise bidding algorithms for Google Ads campaigns (Search and Hotel Price Ads) using Python, translating business objectives into bidding logic that maximises profitability (Direct Margin).
Optimise budget allocation across channels, markets and campaigns using elasticity and response-curve models to improve profitability.
Continuously monitor campaign performance, identify inefficiencies and evolve the bidding logic accordingly.


Marketing measurement & incrementality


Design, run and analyse incrementality tests (geo-lift / holdout experiments) using causal inference methods such as synthetic control, Bayesian structural time series and difference-in-differences to quantify the true incremental impact of paid channels.
Build and maintain marketing mix models (MMM) to estimate channel contribution, saturation and diminishing returns, and translate the outputs into budget recommendations.
Own and improve our attribution framework — evaluating multi-touch attribution against experimental results and platform-reported figures, and reconciling the gaps.
Design, implement and analyse A/B tests and other experiments to assess the impact of marketing initiatives, including sample-size, power and pre-registration standards.


Insight & influence


Provide data-driven recommendations on marketing spend, customer acquisition, retention and lifetime value to C-level and senior management.
Serve as a subject-matter expert on data science and measurement best practices within the Analytics & Insights team, and productionise analyses into reusable tools and recurring reports.


What We’re Looking For 👀

Experience & Qualifications:


Minimum 3 years of experience in a Data Analytics or Data Science role, preferably within a marketing department.
Advanced skills in SQL, Python, R, or similar programming languages.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Communicate clearly and with purpose, working effectively with team members and stakeholders across the organisation.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.


Essential Skills


Competency in Python/R.
SQL (preferably BigQuery, Snowflake).
Strong proficiency in statistical analysis, machine learning, and predictive modelling techniques.


Desirable Skills


Experience with marketing measurement: incrementality / geo-lift testing, holdout experiments.
Applied causal inference: synthetic control, difference-in-differences, Bayesian structural time series (e.g. CausalPy, CausalImpact, PyMC, linearmodels).
Understanding of attribution modelling (multi-touch, data-driven attribution) and its limitations relative to experimental measurement.
Understanding of digital marketing metrics, SEO, SEM and customer-journey analysis.
Experience with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) or building lightweight apps (Streamlit).
Familiarity with orchestration and ETL/ELT tools (Apache Airflow, dbt).
Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative code review.


What We Offer 💯


Competitive salary & benefits
Enhanced annual leave plus 3 Wellbeing Days per year
Paid family leave (maternity, paternity, surrogacy & adoption)
Agile working (plus a Working from Abroad Policy!)
Support for your ongoing growth & development
Inclusive people policies (sickness, menopause, compassionate and fertility leave)
A chance to give back to your local community with 5 paid volunteering days


OUR BEHAVIOURS 🏆


Grow others - We fundamentally believe that investing in growing others benefits everyone, whether it's helping them develop hard or soft skills. We want learning and growing to be part of our DNA to help makes us a better team, together.
Master it - We are obsessed with our area of expertise and enjoy developing our skills. We rarely take things at face value; we investigate, interrogate, and always look for ‘the why,’ and wherever possible, we use data to find the best solution.
Collaborate - We are in it together, for the tough stuff and the celebrations too. To achieve the best results, we need expertise from all areas of the organisation, and we wholeheartedly welcome diverse thinking.
Adapt - We work fluidly, adapting to new information and the evolving environment while staying committed to our goals. Innovation and experimentation fuel our projects and we’re never afraid to pivot.
Deliver - Our focus is always on the end result; we value outcomes over activity. We collaborate to deliver work at speed without dropping any of our other behaviours.


We believe in talented and diverse teams that reflect the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we operate. Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences. We lay out the above requirements to guide applicants to the experiences that we believe will allow you to be successful in the role. If you don’t meet them all, please consider applying if you think you can still perform the role as described.

Hostelworld Group plc is a ground-breaking social network-powered Online Travel Agent ("OTA") with a clear mission to help travellers find people to hang out with.

Our mission is founded on the insight that most travellers go hostelling to meet other people. Our platform connects travellers through a range of social features, including city and hostel chat rooms, AI-powered recommendations, and event discovery, facilitating real-world interactions before, during and after their trips.

Hostelworld's vision is to be the world's leading social travel platform. Since launching its social network in 2022, the Group has welcomed over 4.0 million social members, with engagement growing faster than stays booked. Social members book approximately twice as frequently as non-members and are three times more likely to use the app, demonstrating the platform's utility and its contribution to customer lifetime value.

Our proprietary dataset, spanning over 4.0 million social members, 19.0 million chat messages and 19.0 million bookings since launch, strengthens our ability to understand traveller behaviour, personalise experiences, and build network effects that differentiate Hostelworld from generalist OTAs. This data asset, which is exclusively ours and compounds in value as our community grows, underpins our AI-powered matching and recommendation capabilities.

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Ireland, Hostelworld is a recognised brand with around 275 employees, hostel and accommodation partners across more than 180 countries, and a growing suite of products including budget accommodation and Social Passes that extend the platform well beyond the traditional hostelling category.

Hostelworld has a long-standing commitment to improving the sustainability of the hostelling industry. The Group has introduced a hostel-specific Staircase to Sustainability framework, accredited by the Global Sustainable Tourism Council, which helps partners adopt more sustainable practices while giving travellers clearer information for decision-making. Customers can choose to offset trip emissions, and for the fifth consecutive year the Group has retained the 'Taking Climate Action' label from South Pole.

Hostelworld Group plc is a ground-breaking social network-powered Online Travel Agent ("OTA") with a clear mission to help travellers find people to hang out with.

Our mission is founded on the insight that most travellers go hostelling to meet other people. Our platform connects travellers through a range of social features, including city and hostel chat rooms, AI-powered recommendations, and event discovery, facilitating real-world interactions before, during and after their trips.

Hostelworld's vision is to be the world's leading social travel platform. Since launching its social network in 2022, the Group has welcomed over 4.0 million social members, with engagement growing faster than stays booked. Social members book approximately twice as frequently as non-members and are three times more likely to use the app, demonstrating the platform's utility and its contribution to customer lifetime value.

Our proprietary dataset, spanning over 4.0 million social members, 19.0 million chat messages and 19.0 million bookings since launch, strengthens our ability to understand traveller behaviour, personalise experiences, and build network effects that differentiate Hostelworld from generalist OTAs. This data asset, which is exclusively ours and compounds in value as our community grows, underpins our AI-powered matching and recommendation capabilities.

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Ireland, Hostelworld is a recognised brand with around 275 employees, hostel and accommodation partners across more than 180 countries, and a growing suite of products including budget accommodation and Social Passes that extend the platform well beyond the traditional hostelling category.

Hostelworld has a long-standing commitment to improving the sustainability of the hostelling industry. The Group has introduced a hostel-specific Staircase to Sustainability framework, accredited by the Global Sustainable Tourism Council, which helps partners adopt more sustainable practices while giving travellers clearer information for decision-making. Customers can choose to offset trip emissions, and for the fifth consecutive year the Group has retained the 'Taking Climate Action' label from South Pole.
